articleTitle: Long-haul analog links tutorial
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: analog versus digital fibre optics; applications of long-haul RF photonics; components and IMDD metrics; single channel fibre effects; alternate modulation format; transmitter linearization techniques; and photodiode nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: (Actual presentation will be subset of these slides-most recent version will be available from http://photonics.intec.ugent.be/download)

articleTitle: Tunable microwave photonic filter with programmable apodization based on optical comb
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the application of optical combs to implement microwave photonic filters with large number of taps. By utilizing optical delay and line-by-line pulse shaping we are able to tune and program the filter's bandpass.

articleTitle: Architectural design exploration of chip-scale photonic interconnection networks using physical-layer analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We conduct an architectural exploration of three chip-scale photonic interconnection networks in a novel simulation environment, exploring insertion loss, crosstalk, and energy. The impact of these metrics is evaluated in the context of network performance.

articleTitle: Packet and circuit network convergence with OpenFlow
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: IP and Transport networks are controlled and operated independently today, leading to significant Capex and Opex inefficiencies for the providers. We discuss a unified approach with OpenFlow, and present a recent demonstration of a unified control plane for OpenFlow enabled IP/Ethernet and TDM switched networks.

articleTitle: Optics for high-performance servers and supercomputers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the optical interconnect for POWER7-IH systems, which provides high-BW, low-latency connectivity for 100,000s of high-performance CPU cores by leveraging dense transceiver and connector technologies to construct chip module optical IOs.

articleTitle: High-performance 850 nm VCSEL and photodetector arrays for 25 Gb/s parallel optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We design, fabricate and demonstrate 850 nm VCSEL and PD arrays which operate at 25 Gb/s per channel, up to 600 Gb/s with 24 channels, for low-power parallel optical module applications. We also report a complete 25 Gb/s VCSEL to PD back-to-back link.

articleTitle: Coded polarization-multiplexed iterative polar modulation (PM-IPM) for beyond 400 Gb/s serial optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a coded polarization-multiplexed iterative polar modulation (PM-IPM) as an enabling coded-modulation scheme for beyond 400 Gb/s serial optical transmission. We demonstrate that the proposed scheme can achieve 400 Gb/s optical transmission over 2250 km (for M = 3D16).

articleTitle: A novel optical fast OFDM with reduced channel spacing equal to half of the symbol rate per carrier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel discrete-cosine-transform based optical fast OFDM (FOFDM) to reduce the channel spacing to half of the symbol rate per carrier, and numerically evaluate the performance of 20Gbaud PSK and bipolar 4-ASK FOFDM.

articleTitle: Photonic terabit routers: The IRIS project
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present results of the IRIS project, a DARPA-MTO funded program to develop a router with an all-optical data plane and a total capacity of more than 100 Tb/s.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of OpenFlow control of packet and circuit switches
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: OpenFlow is presented as a unified control plane and architecture for packet and circuit switched networks. We demonstrate a simple proof-of-concept testbed, where a bidirectional wavelength circuit is dynamically created to transport a TCP flow.

articleTitle: A triple-concatenated FEC using soft-decision decoding for 100 Gb/s optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel triple-concatenated forward error correction for 100 Gb/s transmission. Simulation shows that a net coding gain of 10.8 dB is obtained by a soft-decision LPDC code concatenated with the enhanced FEC listed in G.975.1.

articleTitle: Low power and high density optical interconnects for future supercomputers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Increasing performance in supercomputers requires a concomitant increase in intrasystem interconnect bandwidth. We review the status and prospects of technologies required to build low power, high density board and chip level interconnects.

articleTitle: Reduction of crosstalk by quasi-homogeneous solid multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Power-conversion efficiency reduction on a quasi-homogeneous solid multi-core fiber is numerically investigated. The fiber length dependence of measured crosstalk of fabricated fibers is in good agreement of simulation result by power-coupled equation.

articleTitle: Distance-adaptive spectrum allocation in elastic optical path network (SLICE) with bit per symbol adjustment
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a concept of spectrally-efficient optical networking with distance-adaptive spectral allocation by adjusting the number of modulation levels. We demonstrate it by routing 40 Gb/s optical paths using short-reach, narrow-spectrum 16APSK and long-reach QPSK.

articleTitle: Continuously-interleaved BCH (CI-BCH) FEC delivers best in class NECG for 40G and 100G metro applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We provide 40 G OTU 3 performance results for Continuously-Interleaved concatenated BCH (CI-BCH) FEC, demonstrating best-in-class performance for a 7% overhead hard-decision FEC and offers option to tradeoff coding gain for reduced FEC decode latency.

articleTitle: On the spectrum-efficiency of bandwidth-variable optical OFDM transport networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigated the high spectrum efficiency property of the bandwidth-variable optical OFDM (BV-OOFDM) transport networks. In contrast to mixed-line-rate (MLR) networks, BV-OOFDM enables flexible allocation and efficient utilization of the spectral resource.

articleTitle: Demonstration of bit rate variable ROADM functionality on an optical OFDM superchannel
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a bit rate variable add- and drop function performed on an optical OFDM superchannel signal by optical filtering and superposition of OFDM subbands and the application of different modulation formats for dynamic networks.

articleTitle: Nonlinear polarization crosstalk canceller for dual-polarization digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel method is proposed to compensate polarization crosstalk induced by interchannel nonlinearity. Experiments have demonstrated that the proposed method provides over 1 dB performance improvement for 112 Gb/s dual-polarization QPSK coherent receivers.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency symmetric signals from a BPSK input for phase sensitive amplification
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a novel system for simultaneous carrier recovery and frequency symmetric signals generation from a NRZ-BPSK input by exploiting FWM in HNLF for phase sensitive amplification.

articleTitle: Investigation on multi-core fibers with large Aeff and low micro bending loss
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For large Aeff Multi-Core Fibers (MCFs), advantages of using holey fibers as well as effective ways with solid fibers were confirmed. The solid MCFs with Aeff >100 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and suppressed micro bending loss were actually fabricated.

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed 16-QAM long-haul transmission over 3,123 km using digital coherent receiver with digital PLL based frequency offset compensator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 160-Gb/s PDM 16-QAM single channel transmission over the longest distance yet to be reported, of 3123.9 km. The coherent receiver employs a frequency offset compensator based on a digital PLL.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of coherent MAP detection for nonlinearity mitigation in long-haul transmissions
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We implemented a maximum a posteriori probability (MAP) detection scheme for mitigating nonlinear phase distortion. We demonstrated 1 dB improvement in system performance and ~2dB higher nonlinearity tolerance after 6,000 km transmission.

articleTitle: Design and demonstration of an all-optical hybrid packet and circuit switched network platform for next generation data centers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The design of a reconfigurable 4 × 4 photonic switch simultaneously supporting both packet and circuit switching is proposed and experimentally validated. Error-free operation and routing correctness is verified for pseudorandom 4 × 10-Gb/s packets and a 10-Gb/s stream.

articleTitle: Frequency domain chromatic dispersion estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The low complexity, robust, and precise algorithm solely employs a simplified autocorrelation function of the signal spectrum for blind chromatic dispersion estimation to adapt frequency domain compensation functions in digital coherent receivers.

articleTitle: Transparent WDM network with bitrate tunable optical OFDM transponders
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Reach estimations for several variable-bitrate OFDM schemes are presented and discussed in the framework of a transparent EU core network scenario. 44% reduction on OE interfaces is found compared to a fixed-bitrate 40 Gb/s network.

articleTitle: Results from EU project SARDANA on 10G extended reach WDM PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The presented "Scalable Advanced Ring-based passive Dense Access Network Architecture" transparently integrates WDM metro and PON access technologies, implementing ring protection, 100 Km reach and up to 1024 users served at 10 Gbps, with passive highly-shared infrastructure.

articleTitle: System requirements for WSS filter shape in cascaded ROADM networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the impact of passband shape and random center frequency variations on the bandwidth narrowing caused by successive filtering in concatenated wavelength-selective switches. Passband flatness is extremely important for broadband signals at 40 Gb/s and beyond.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency limits of load adaptive networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Based on traffic models the energy consumption of adaptive networks is compared to networks with constant power consumption. The results show that adaptive network resource allocation serves to reduce the energy consumption of networks significantly.

articleTitle: RSOA-based 10G WDM PON using FEC and MLSE equalizers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Achieving the 10 Gbit/s transmission in RSOA-based WDM PON systems is one of the important challenges because of its strict modulation bandwidth. This paper describes various state-of-the-art techniques to overcome this issue.

articleTitle: Investigation of the impact of ultra-narrow carrier spacing on the transmission of a 10-carrier 1Tb/s superchannel
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the impact of ultra-narrow carrier spacing on the transmission of a 1Tb/s superchannel comprising 10×100Gb/s PM-QPSK carriers. We demonstrate 2200km over installed SMF fibre with a carrier spacing of 1.1 the Baud rate.

articleTitle: Bridge-and-roll demonstration in GRIPhoN (globally reconfigurable intelligent photonic network)
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a ROADM architecture for a dynamically reconfigurable photonic network and demonstrate the performance of a photonic-layer bridge-and-roll that could improve the operational flexibility of optical transport networks.

articleTitle: Transceivers and optical engines for computer and datacenter interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Technological and manufacturing advances are enabling optical solutions to meet demanding density, bandwidth, and cost metrics. We describe these solutions with respect to different system architectures and applications.

articleTitle: RF-assisted optical dual-carrier 112 Gbit/s polarization-multiplexed 16-QAM transmitter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optical multi-carrier transmitter is demonstrated based on RF sub-carrier modulation with subsequent optoelectronic conversion. 16-QAM modulation of dual RF carriers together with polarization multiplexing to obtain 112 Gbit/s is presented.

articleTitle: Soft decision FEC for 100G transport systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A practical implementation of soft decision based FEC for 100 G transport systems is discussed. The keys are a stronger coding gain using triple-concatenated FEC and a multi-lane distribution architecture to improve the error correction capability.

articleTitle: 56Gs/s ADC : Enabling 100GbE
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 100 G coherent receiver needs 4 56 Gs/s ADCs and a tera-OPs DSP which dissipate only tens of watts. This paper discusses the forces pushing towards a single-chip CMOS solution, and the challenges in realising this.

articleTitle: MIMO enabled 40 Gb/s transmission using mode division multiplexing in multimode fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transmission of 40 Gb/s intensity modulated NRZ data over 1.1 km of multimode fiber has been experimentally demonstrated using modal diversity and receiver based 2 × 2 MIMO digital signal processing with direct detection.

articleTitle: Raman extended GPON using 1240 nm semiconductor quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an experimental demonstration of GPON reach extension to 50 km with a 32-way PON split using Raman amplification of the upstream signal with 1240 nm quantum-dot pump lasers.

articleTitle: A 30 GHz bandwidth, 80 GS/s sample rate real-time waveform digitizing system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A method employing a unique mixture of microwave and digital signal processing is described that provides for large bandwidth increases in waveform digitizers. Such digitizers are a critical component of 100+ Gb/s optical transmission systems.

articleTitle: OSNR-enhancing pure-silica-core fiber with large effective area and low attenuation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Pure-silica-core fiber with large Aeff of 134 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is designed to enhance OSNR considering splice loss to SSMF, and realized by appropriate depressed cladding profile and soft primary coating. It also exhibits low attenuation of 0.169 dB/km.

articleTitle: Energy-awareness in dynamic traffic grooming
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce an energy-efficient traffic grooming scheme for promoting greener optical networks. The scheme considers a modular node architecture, reuses already active components during request allocations, and conserves total energy consumption in the network.

articleTitle: The convergence of wired and wireless services delivery in access and home networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Radio-over-fiber, backhauling and femtonodes are considered for delivering mobile communication services over access and home networks. The RoF overlay is an attractive alternative for optical access, whereas femtonodes are a justified option for home networks.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 11-Gb/s, 20-km reach WDM PON using directly-modulated RSOA with 4-ary PAM signal
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the error-free transmission of 11-Gb/s 4-ary PAM signal obtained by using a directly modulated RSOA over 20 km of SMF for the cost-effective realization of highspeed WDM PONs.

articleTitle: Designing in-building optical fiber networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: Optical fiber in-building networks carrying wired and wireless services can outperform CAT-5E networks regarding versatility and installation costs. POF-based point-to-point architectures are optimum for small buildings, and (optically routed) SMF-based bus architectures for larger buildings.

articleTitle: Single source optical OFDM transmitter and optical FFT receiver demonstrated at line rates of 5.4 and 10.8 Tbit/s
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: OFDM data with line rates of 5.4 Tbit/s or 10.8 Tbit/s are generated and decoded with a new real-time all-optical FFT receiver. Each of 75 carriers of a comb source is encoded with 18 GBd QPSK or 16-QAM.

articleTitle: Concatenated QC-LDPC and SPC codes for 100 Gbps ultra long-haul optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and investigate a novel FEC coding scheme based on a concatenation of QC-LDPC with single-parity-check codes. High performance of a Q-limit of 5.8 dB with 20.5% overhead has been achieved with FPGA-based simulations.

articleTitle: Frequency domain equalization with minimum complexity in coherent optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For chip-design of a frequency-domain equalizer, a simple procedure to minimize the number of multiplications is shown. Considerations include recent improvements of FFT-algorithms.

articleTitle: Optical packet add/drop systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Sub-wavelength add/drop multiplexers are pragmatic and efficient systems that could drive the next generation of networks. In this paper we will discuss on the potential of this new technology and on its perspectives.

articleTitle: A programmable optical filter unit cell element for high resolution RF signal processing in silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first reconfigurable, cascadable silicon photonics unit cell fabricated in commercial wafer-scale processes using a single 500 ps delay line and allowing independent FIR and IIR response for high-resolution RF filtering and correlation applications.

articleTitle: Massively-scaleable highly-dynamic optical node design
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a node architecture capable of supporting a highly-dynamic, multi-terabit core network. Design trade-offs, performance and hardware requirements are all discussed.

articleTitle: First demonstration of 10G-EPON and GE-PON co-existing system employing dual-rate burst-mode 3R transceiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel 10G-EPON dual-rate burst-mode 3R transceiver with receiver sensitivity of -31.2dBm for 10.3Gb/s and -35.6dBm for 1.25Gb/s was developed. 10G-EPON and GE-PON coexisting system of 32x ONUs with loss budget of 33.5dB was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficient frequency domain chromatic dispersion compensation in a coherent Polmux QPSK-receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate frequency domain chromatic dispersion equalization in an ASIC for digital coherent signal processing. Improved chromatic dispersion tolerance can be achieved by using modified coefficients, which utilize the equalizer more efficiently.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s over 25 m plastic optical fiber as a way for extremely low-cost optical interconnection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper we demonstrate for the first time that large diameter (½ to 1 mm) step index POF can be used for 10 Gbit/s transmission over up to 25 m with very low-cost components and DMT modulation. The use of bend insensitive multi-core POF reduces the bending radius to 2.5 mm without any signal distortion resulting in a very robust installation.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of centralized and distributed impairment-aware control plane schemes for dynamic transparent optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate and compare distributed and centralized impairment-aware control plane schemes for transparent optical networks with dynamic traffic. Experimental results show that distributed scheme yields one fifth of setup time required by previously reported alternatives.

articleTitle: On the energy efficiency of mixed-line-rate networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an approach to evaluate energy efficiency of mixed-line-rate (MLR) optical networks. A comparative study of energy efficiency of MLR and single-line-rate (SLR) networks shows that MLR is more energy efficient than SLR networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive IP/optical OFDM networking design
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new networking approach based on IP/optical OFDM technologies is proposed, providing an adaptive mechanism of bandwidth provisioning and pipe resizing for dynamic traffic flows. A comparison study is presented to demonstrate its advantages.

articleTitle: 25 GHz operation of silicon optical modulator with projection MOS structure
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a high-speed and compact silicon optical modulator based on the free carrier plasma dispersion in a silicon rib waveguide with a MOS (metal-oxide-semiconductor) junction structure. To achieve high-speed and high-efficiency performance, an improved structure of a very small rib waveguide including a projection MOS junction was studied. We demonstrated high speed of 25 GHz operation in case of 120-200 μm phase-shift length and high optical modulation efficiency of 0.5-0.67 Vcm for V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L by using a projection MOS junction structure. According to the carrier-density simulation, higher operation bandwidth up to 40 GHz can be realized.

articleTitle: High-power and low phase noise full-band tunable LD for coherent applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High output power and low noise performances of CSG-DR-LD have been investigated. Kink-free fiber output power > 60mW over C-band with high SMSR have been demonstrated. Measured phase noise is lower than 170 kHz, exhibiting excellent noise properties as a monolithic and single stripe tunable LD. These characteristics reveal that CSG-DR-LD is a promising light source for the future digital coherent applications.

articleTitle: 24 channels colorless WDM-PON with L-band 10 Gb/s downstream and C-band 2.5 Gb/s upstream using multiple-wavelengths seeding sources based on mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel WDM-PON delivering 10-Gb/s downstream based on L-band loss-less reflective-amplified-modulator and 2.5-Gb/s upstream based on C-band injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser is experimentally demonstrated for 24 channels over 25-km, using quantum-dash mode-locked laser-based multiple-wavelengths seeding sources.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multi-rate thresholded preamplified 16-ary pulse-position-modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Sensitive multi-rate optical communication is experimentally investigated on static and fading channels at data rates from 52 Mbps to 311 Mbps using 16-ary pulse-position-modulation, channel coding and interleaving, and a near-optimal thresholded preamplified receiver.

articleTitle: Multiobjective physical topology design of all-optical networks considering QoS and Capex
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an algorithm to define the physical topology and the specification of the optical devices that should be deployed in a network to minimize simultaneously the total capital cost and the network blocking probability.

articleTitle: Network innovations brought by digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Operational efficiency improvements of optical networks enabled by digital coherent receivers are discussed in view of reliability, agility, performance and reduced operational complexity. Several specific technologies are briefly introduced to deliver some more insight.

articleTitle: Arbitrary wavelength conversion in entire CL-band based on pump-wavelength-tunable FWM in a HNLF
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Pump-wavelength-tunable FWM was demonstrated using a zero dispersion and dispersion slope HNLF. Signal in CL-band was converted to any wavelength in entire CL-band and measured power penalties were less than 1 dB for 10 Gbit/s NRZ signals.

articleTitle: Cycle slip probability in 100G PM-QPSK systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We estimate asymptotic probabilities of a cycle slip for a non-decision aided feedforward carrier synchronizer in dispersion-uncompensated optical lines with negligible nonlinear crosstalk.

articleTitle: First 80-Gb/s and 160-Gb/s wavelength-converted data stream measurements in a silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Data fidelity is inspected for the first time for wavelength-converted RZ TDM 80- and 160-Gb/s data using four-wave mixing in a silicon waveguide. Open eye diagrams and error-free operation is shown for demultiplexed 10-Gb/s tributaries.

articleTitle: 256 QAM (64 Gbit/s) coherent optical transmission over 160 km with an optical bandwidth of 5.4 GHz
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first demonstration of 256 QAM coherent optical transmission, where 64 Gbit/s polarization-multiplexed data at 4 Gsymbol/s were successfully transmitted over 160 km with an optical bandwidth of only 5.4 GHz.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a carrier distributed, 8192-split hybrid DWDM-TDMA PON over 124km field-installed fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A DWDM-TDMA PON using carrier distribution with symmetric 320 Gb/s capacity is demonstrated over 124 km field-installed fibers. The upstream channels feature a 3R 10 Gb/s burst-mode receiver with electronic dispersion compensation, burst-mode EDFAs and integrated reflective SOA-EAMs.

articleTitle: Optical phase-modulated radio-over-fiber links with k-means algorithm for digital demodulation of 8PSK subcarrier multiplexed signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A k-means algorithm for phase recovery of three, 50 Mbaud, 8PSK subcarrier multiplexed signals at 5 GHz for optical phase-modulated radio-over-fiber is proposed and experimentally demonstrated after 40 km of single mode fiber transmission.

articleTitle: All-optical carrier recovery with periodic optical filtering for wavelength reuse in RSOA-based colorless optical network units in full-duplex 10Gbps WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optically assisted downstream cancellation for wavelength reuse in WDM-PONs is demonstrated, allowing downstream extinction ratios up to 9 dB for symmetrical full-duplex data transmission at 10Gbps with RSOA-based ONUs. PON budgets of ~20dB can be reached.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the fuse effect propagation in networks infrastructures with different types of fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The evaluation of the fuse effect propagation in fiber networks is analyzed. We show a relation between the void interval, the power density and the fused effect velocity for different types of optical fibers.

articleTitle: 100Gbps EO polymer modulator product and its characterization using a real-time digitizer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First commercial 100 Gbps EO polymer modulator and its use in time-stretch A/D converter to monitor the high frequency performance of the modulator and achieving 100 GHz A/D conversion is shown.

articleTitle: PDL mitigation in PolMux OFDM systems using Golden and Silver Polarization-Time codes
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarization-Time coding can highly mitigate PDL impairments in optical OFDM systems. The performances of two full-rate Polarization-Time codes, the Golden and Silver codes, have been evaluated showing important coding gains.

articleTitle: Power efficiency of extended reach 10G-EPON and TDM/WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We estimate power consumption of several advanced PON technologies and architectures w/o and w/ reach extenders. Our results show that hybrid TDM/WDM PON has the potential to provide the highest energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Optical biasing in direct detection optical-OFDM for improving receiver sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that replacing of electrical by an optical biasing minimizes the nonlinearity effect of an optical modulator. This allows the amplitude of the driving signal to be increased which increases the robustness towards distortion.

articleTitle: Volterra nonlinear compensation of 100G coherent OFDM with baud-rate ADC, tolerable complexity and low intra-channel FWM/XPM error propagation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Nonlinear tolerance of PDM-OFDM transmission with in-line dispersion compensation, e.g. legacy ultra-long-haul submarine links, is substantially improved by a Volterra non-linear compensation scheme, baud rate sampled, with tolerable O(NlogN) complexity, effectively mitigating intra-channel FWM/XPM decision-feedback error propagation.

articleTitle: Advanced technologies for next-generation fiber networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review key advanced technologies for next-generation optical networking. These include advanced physical layer techniques for 100 Gb/s transmission, packet-based transport in core and metro networks, and novel candidate architectures for next-generation optical access.

articleTitle: 43 Gb/s DQPSK pre-equalization employing 6-bit, 43GS/s DAC integrated LSI for cascaded ROADM filtering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Electronic pre-equalization for 43 Gb/s DQPSK has been demonstrated for the first time. Waveform distortion caused by bandwidth narrowing to 18.1 GHz by cascaded 10 Gb/s ROADMs has been adequately pre-equalized by a SiGe-BiCMOS LSI with 6-bit, 43 GS/s digital-to-analog converters.

articleTitle: Very high bit rate transmission for NGPON using AMOOFDM direct modulation of linear laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Experimental demonstration of a bit rate as high as 32 Gbit/s is achieved over 20 km SMF for NGPON in a temperature range of 5°C-60°C using AMOOFDM direct modulation of a linear laser.

articleTitle: End-to-end native IP data 100G single carrier real time DSP coherent detection transport over 1520-km field deployed fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The first end-to-end 100 G transport of native IP packet traffic over 1520-km field deployed fiber is realized with multi-suppliers' 112-Gb/s single-carrier real time coherent DP-QPSK DWDM transponder, 100 GE router cards, and 100 G CFP interfaces.

articleTitle: Real-time detection of a 40 Gbps intradyne channel in the presence of multiple received WDM channels
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We characterize a single-ended intradyne receiver's performance when multiple channels are received without optical demultiplexing. A 40Gb/s dual-polarization QPSK channel is recovered from 16 interfering channels with less than 2dB OSNR penalty at 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> BER.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 8-fold multicasting of a 100 Gb/s polarization-multiplexed OOK signal using highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 8-fold multicasting of a 100 Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZOOK data signal to 200 GHz spaced copies using a highly nonlinear fiber. Degenerate four-wave mixing in a bi-directional wavelength conversion scheme is employed. An average power penalty of ~4 dB at a bit error ratio of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> is observed with over 45 nm of wavelength conversion bandwidth.

articleTitle: 69.1-Tb/s (432 × 171-Gb/s) C- and extended L-band transmission over 240 km Using PDM-16-QAM modulation and digital coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the record total capacity of 69.1 Tb/s with a spectral efficiency of 6.4 b/s/Hz by employing 21.4-Gbaud 16-QAM modulation, blind digital coherent detection, and 10.8-THz ultra-wideband amplification in the C- and extended L-bands.

articleTitle: 21 Gbps OFDM wireless signal transmission at 60 GHz using a simple IMDD radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple double-sideband IMDD RoF system is successfully employed to directly transport a 21 Gbps OFDM signal at 60 GHz over 500 m of standard single-mode fiber and 10 m wireless distance.

articleTitle: Compact 40-Gb/s EML module using broadband FPC connection technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed over-50-GHz broadband FPC connection techniques through the medium of a newly developed small connector. We firstly fabricated an EML module using FPC connection and the module successfully demonstrated clear eye opening at 40-Gb/s.

articleTitle: 12.5-Gb/s wireless data transmission by using bias modulation of NBUTC-PD based W-band photonic transmitter-mixer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated near-ballistic uni-traveling-carrier photodiode based broadband photonic transmitter-mixers with quasi-Yagi radiators fed horn antennas. 100GHz wireless transmission with date rate as high as 12.5-Gb/s via bias modulation under high photocurrent (20mA) has been achieved.

articleTitle: 360km field transmission of 10 Gbit/s stream cipher by quantum noise for optical network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Secure optical transmission experiment is demonstrated using a stream cipher by quantum noise. The bit error rates of a 10Gbit/s signal through 360km fiber for authentic receiver and eavesdropper are 5×10-7 and 0.4 ∼0.5.

articleTitle: 40G and 100G deployment on 10G infrastructure: Market overview and trends, coherent versus conventional technology
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare conventional and coherent solutions for 40 G and 100 G operations. We then discuss 40 G and 100 G deployment strategy over 10 G infrastructures in the context of a field trail on a commercial link carrying traffic.

articleTitle: Investigating the limits of optical packet transmission through cascaded transient-suppressed EDFAs without regeneration or active gain control
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a transmission loop, we show the maximum number of cascaded conventional- EDFAs is gain-transient limited for packet transmission and demonstrate error-free, noise limited packet transmission across 44 transient-suppressed EDFA's without active gain-transient control or regeneration.

articleTitle: Intra-node contention in a dynamic, colorless, non-directional ROADM
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using numerical simulation of a dynamic network, we quantify the intra-node blocking occurring in colorless, non-directional Reconfigurable Optical Add/Drop Multiplexers (ROADMs). Designs including a client-side fiber cross connect are shown to offer lower blocking probability.

articleTitle: Narrow spectral linewidth full band tunable laser based on waveguide ring resonators with low power consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a widely tunable laser souree that uses triple ring resonators with narrow spectral linewidth. A spectral linewidth of less than 100 kHz is obtained for all wavelength channels across C-band. This laser achieved a high fiber output power of ∼16 dBm and a high side-mode-suppression ratio of > 45 dB.

articleTitle: Demonstration of simultaneous all-optical up-conversion of Gigabit wireless services at 60-GHz and 64-GHz in converged optical wireless system carried by single wavelength lightwave
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical simultaneous up-conversion of multiple, separate 1-Gb/s wireless services at 60GHz and 64GHz mm-wave band carried by one single lightwave for in-building radio-over-fiber based optical wireless access system is proposed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficient digital coherent detection of A 1.2-Tb/s 24-carrier no-guard-interval CO-OFDM signal by simultaneously detecting multiple carriers per sampling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate efficient detection of a 1.2-Tb/s 24-carrier NGI-CO-OFDM signal with 12.5-Gbaud PDM-QPSK carrier-modulation by simultaneously recovering 2 or 3 carriers per 50-GSamples/s-sampling, and show its performance after transmitting the signal over 7,200 km.

articleTitle: Compensation of cross-gain modulation in filtered multi-channel optical signal processing applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate compensation of nonlinearity due to cross-gain modulation in wideband analog systems employing narrow-band optical filtering, which is essential for multi-channel optical signal processing in RF channelizer applications.

articleTitle: Single feeder bidirectional WDM-PON with enhanced resilience to Rayleigh-backscattering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a system demonstration of 6 dB-enhanced tolerance to distributed reflections for WDM-PONs using commercial 1.25 Gb/s SFP reflective transceivers. The scheme, based on 8B10B-coding and high-pass electrical filtering, works with CW or 10 Gb/s downstream seeding.

articleTitle: Transmission of 96×100G pre-filtered PDM-RZ-QPSK channels with 300% spectral efficiency over 10,608km and 400% spectral efficiency over 4,368km
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We transmitted 96 × 100 G pre-filtered PDM-RZ-QPSK channels with 300% spectral efficiency over 10,608 km using 52 km spans of 150 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> fiber and simple single-stage EDFAs. We also achieved 400% spectral efficiency over 4,368 km using similar techniques.

articleTitle: Ultra-long cavity hybrid silicon mode-locked laser diode operating at 930 MHz
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An integrated 9-cm cavity hybrid silicon laser that is fundamentally mode-locked at 930 MHz is presented. The laser outputs chirped 200-ps pulses at 1.1-ns repetition rate. Harmonic mode-locking up to the 8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic is shown, with 35-ps pulses at the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> harmonic.

articleTitle: Effects of Rayleigh backscattering in long-reach RSOA-based WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the effects of Rayleigh backscattering in a long-reach RSOA-based WDM PON. The results show that the Rayleigh-induced penalty depends highly on the gain of the remote EDFA and the lengths of drop fibers.

articleTitle: Designing and engineering metropolitan area transparent optical networks for the provisioning of multicast sessions
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the problem of designing and engineering metropolitan area optical networks for the provisioning of multicast sessions. The Q-factor for each session is taken into account, aiming at maximizing the admitted number of connections.

articleTitle: Power consumption of hybrid optical switches
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Two realization options of hybrid optical switches are evaluated with regard to power consumption. Both switches show improved energy efficiency in comparison to a pure packet switch while all-optical switch consumes the lowest power.

articleTitle: Traffic independent heuristics for regenerator site selection for providing any-to-any optical connectivity
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study single path-based heuristics with ranking and redirection, and connectivity dependent heuristics based on k-center and connected dominating set problems, for regenerator site selection to provide any-to-any connectivity in reconfigurable translucent optical networks.

articleTitle: Semi-blind nonlinear equalization in coherent multi-span transmission system with inhomogeneous span parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Semi-blind sequence is proposed for optimizing the nonlinear equalization parameters from limited prior knowledge of link. Its performance is demonstrated in an extreme case where the fiber type of a span is incorrectly informed.

articleTitle: 40 km long-range Raman-based distributed temperature sensor with meter-scale spatial resolution
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new Raman based distributed measurement technique which allows for temperature sensing over nearly 40 km of graded index multimode optical fiber with meter-scale spatial resolution and temperature accuracy better than 3°C.

articleTitle: Ultra high performance media multicasting scheme over wavelength-routed networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a demonstration of an all-optical multicasting scheme for ultra high definition media over wavelength-routed networks, using Self-Phase Modulation. The feasibility of using this technique has been experimentally and theoretically evaluated for streaming rates up to 100 Gbps.

articleTitle: Enhanced distributed hybrid sensor based on Brillouin and Raman scattering combining Fabry-Perot lasers and optical pulse coding
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Pulse coding techniques are proposed in combination with the use of Fabry-Perot lasers for simultaneous strain and temperature sensing based on hybrid spontaneous Raman-Brillouin scattering. Combination of both techniques allows for ~0.27K / ~30με resolution along 25-km sensing range.

articleTitle: Terabit/s single-carrier transmission systems based on coherent time-division demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Single-carrier systems using coherent time-division demultiplexing and demodulation of 4-PSK, 8-PSK and 16-QAM at bit rates up to 5.1 Tb/s are reviewed. Emphasis is on transmission experiments up to 1040 km.

articleTitle: Opportunity cost analysis of online routing algorithms for dynamic wavelength routed mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce a new cost model to analyze end-to-end online routing algorithms in dynamic wavelength routed mesh networks. This model leads to the design of simple and efficient routing algorithms with congestion awareness.

articleTitle: Interrelation profile analysis method for alignment of polarization-maintaining fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new method for alignment of polarization-maintaining (PM) fibers has been developed that solves alignment problems with low-contrast PM fibers. It provides a fast and accurate universal method for PM fiber alignment.

articleTitle: A non-silica bridging wire between silica fiber tapers for novel in-line components
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the power delivering between two silica fiber tapers through a bridging wire made of a highly nonlinear tellurite glass. The Fresnel reflection at the splicing point is significantly reduced by angled-cut fiber tapers.

articleTitle: 4 × 10 Gb/s time and wavelength multicasting with NRZ to RZ format conversion using four-wave mixing in a highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous time and wavelength multicasting with NRZ to RZ format conversion by four-wave mixing of the input signal with a time- and wavelength-interleaved laser source. Error-free operations are obtained in all the outputs.

articleTitle: Economic study comparing Raman extended GPON and Mid-span GPON reach extenders
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an operational and capital cost study comparing newly proposed Raman amplified GPON systems with standardized, commercially available, mid-span GPON reach extenders.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution on a 10Gb/s WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first 10 GHz clock-rate, differential-phase-shift-keyed quantum key distribution system on a 10 Gb/s multi-user WDM-PON network. A dual feeder fiber scheme is used to reduce spontaneous Raman scattering-induced inter-channel cross-talk.

articleTitle: Applications of volume Bragg gratings in high-power fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this presentation the latest results on volume Bragg grating locked fiber lasers will be reviewed. This novel technique provides one to two orders of magnitude improved spectral brightness, improved temporal stability and at least equally efficient lasing as when ordinary dielectric mirrors are used. Results on tuning and photodarkening resistant fiber lasers are also presented, as well as some results where the lasers are used in nonlinear optics.

articleTitle: Characterization of integrated polarization-diversity DPSK demodulator with two-dimensional chirped grating couplers and ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the design and experimental results of an integrated polarization-diversity DPSK demodulator. The integration of 2-D chirped grating couplers enabled polarization-diversity operation with two micro-ring resonators which converted the phase modulation to intensity modulation.

articleTitle: A scheme for improving the performance of 100-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZ33 DQPSK signals using the phase regenerator and PMD compensator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed a scheme of combination of phase regenerator and PMD compensator to the 100-Gbit/s Polarization-Multiplexed DQPSK System to improve its tolerance to PMD. The system performance is effectively improved after both compensation and regeneration.

articleTitle: Simultaneous monitoring of in-band optical noise for WDM signals using stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous monitoring of the optical signal to noise ratio (OSNR) for wavelength-division multiplexed 40 Gb/s signals using the back-reflected Stokes wave from Stimulated Brillouin Scattering. A highly sensitive OSNR range of 5-25 dB is observed.

articleTitle: Modification of spectroscopic properties of bismuth doped silica fiber by post-fabrication process and different fabrication methods
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The spectroscopic properties of pristine and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-loaded MCVD based Bi-doped aluminosilicate fibers were investigated. Also, the properties of Bi-doped fiber, fabricated by powder-in-tube method, have been compared to MCVD based Bi fiber.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator rib waveguide bends using phase-compensated microprism
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The silicon-on-insulator rib waveguide bends using phase-compensated microprisms are experimental demonstrated. A very compact SOI rib waveguide with bending radius of 15.43 ¿m is achieved with demonstrating bending angle of 10°, 30°, and 40°.

articleTitle: Friction property and mechanism of indoor optical fiber cable and optimization for access network to MDUs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We studied the cable friction and found that it depends on polymer sheath stiffness and lubricants. Optimization should prevent stick-slip motion and reduce the friction by controlling the polymer stiffness and the lubricants.

articleTitle: Asynchronous and packetized transmission in optical CDMA distributed sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate asynchronous, packetized data transmission from distributed commercial sensors in an optical CDMA network. Error-free transmission is obtained and the near-far problem is reduced using all-optical signal processing with a nonlinear optical loop-mirror.

articleTitle: Applicability verification of all-optical sampling based Q factor monitor for link-by-link fault management in transparent optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Applicability of all-optical sampling based Q-factor monitor has been successfully verified for link-by-link fault management in transparent optical mesh networks by comparing with an electrical receiver.

articleTitle: Front side power monitoring in TO-can RSOA module with monitoring photodiode and thermoelectric cooler
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We reports power monitoring characteristics in RSOA TO-module with m-PD, TEC and thermistor. By monitoring output power at the front of RSOA, monitor current linearity can be improved and monitoring window becomes wider.

articleTitle: Tutorial: XG-PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: overview of the NGA candidates; service requirements; physical layer specifications; protocol foundations; ONU management; and standardization plan.

articleTitle: Reach-optimized design for ULH mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The goals for ULH mesh network design should be reach optimization of the whole network and preparation for the future growth. We propose an approach that designs each ROADM-to-ROADM section independently with minimized OSNR penalty.

articleTitle: Optical waveform sampling and error-free demultiplexing of 1.28 Tbit/s serial data in a silicon nanowire
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 640 Gbit/s and 1.28 Tbit/s serial data optical waveform sampling and 640-to-10 Gbit/s and 1.28 Tbit/s-to-10 Gbit/s error-free demultiplexing using four-wave mixing in a 300nm×450nm×5mm silicon nanowire.

articleTitle: Economics of 100Gb/s transport
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Deploying spectrally-efficient 100Gb/s coherent transponder technology in carrier networks can yield substantial CAPEX and OPEX savings. This paper discusses these economic gains and how a carrier can maximize their return on optical transport investment.

articleTitle: A novel WDM-OFDM-PON architecture with centralized lightwave and PolSK-assisted multicast overlay
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel WDM-OFDM-PON architecture with centralized lightwave sources and PolSK multicast overlay. The 10Gb/s P2P signals, 2.5Gb/s multicast signals and 2.5Gb/s upstream signals have been successfully transmitted over 25km fiber.

articleTitle: Single-frequency hybrid Brillouin/ytterbium fiber laser with 1-W output power
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A high-power hybrid Brillouin/ytterbium fiber laser is demonstrated with an output power of 1 W. The laser operates in the single-frequency regime with an optical signal-to-noise ratio greater than 55 dB in a 0.1-nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: The dynamics of a developing CW supercontinuum: Analytical predictions and experiments
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that the development of the supercontinuum spectrum in the quasi-CW regime can be interpreted analytically in terms of Akhmediev Breathers. Theory and experiment are in excellent agreement.

articleTitle: Radio-over-fibre phase contrast imaging using a reflective electro-absorption transducer and 1550/1310nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Radio-over-fibre phase contrast imaging is a new technique for object characterization in hostile environments. Commercially-available 1550 nm/1310 nm VCSELs and a reflective electro-absorption transducer offer sub-mm resolution over 1 km of SMF in a 3.1-5 GHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Fabrication of fiber Bragg gratings in 40 μm diameter low GeO2 silica fiber using cw-Ar+-laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Mean index changes >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> were obtained in non-hydrogen-loaded ~3% GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-doped silica fibers with a 9/40 μm core/cladding diameter using a cw 244-nm-Ar<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-laser. Core stress changes are positive indicating a compaction contribution to the index change.

articleTitle: Real-time and single-shot measurement of instantaneous frequencies of wavelength-division-multiplexed signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A self-reference characterization technique is demonstrated for simultaneously measuring instantaneous frequencies of multi-wavelength optical signals using a single measurement platform. The technique allows real-time optical sampling of the induced frequencies both for amplitude and phase modulated signals.

articleTitle: Generation of RZ-AMI using a widely tuneable modulated grating Y-branch chirp managed laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10 Gb/s RZ-AMI format is generated using a 45 nm tunable Modulated-Grating Y-branch Chirp Managed Laser (CML) with an optical delay line interferometer (DLI), achieving +/- 800 ps/nm dispersion tolerance window.

articleTitle: Development of novel cicada-resistant optical drop cable
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By observation of cicada ovipositor's movement, we found that tensile strength and hardness of sheath material are effective against cicada attack. And also, we have newly designed the optical drop cable with cicada-resistant sheath material.

articleTitle: 80-Gb/s optical MSK generation using a monolithically integrated quad-mach-zehnder IQ modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optical MSK transmitter was experimentally demonstrated using a single monolithically integrated high-speed quad-MZ IQ modulator. An 80-Gb/s binary MSK with compact spectrum was generated using the proposed transmitter with electronics designed for 40-Gb/s systems.

articleTitle: Next generation transmission fiber for coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The impact of fibre parameters on coherent system performance is presented. Not unlike intensity transmission, low loss, large effective area and high local dispersion are preferred for optimizing coherent system performances.

articleTitle: Cross-layer traffic grooming for optical networks with hybrid layer-one and layer-zero signal regeneration
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a cross-layer traffic grooming algorithm that balances layer-one and layer-zero signal regeneration capability to achieve the lowest network design cost. The cross-layer approach shows good cost reduction compared to the traditional non-cross-layer approach.

articleTitle: Giant dispersive wave generation induced by soliton collisions
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on a novel effect in which soliton collisions can lead to the generation of dispersive wave with extreme peak power and enhanced spectral shift in a photonic crystal fiber with two zero-dispersion wavelengths.

articleTitle: 1×16 optical packet switch sub-system with a monolithically integrated InP optical switch
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 1×16 optical packet switch sub-system for 160 Gbps RZ-OOK and 12 × 10 Gbps multi-wavelength DPSK packets. We show error-free operation with maximum penalties of 0.7 dB for 160 Gbps RZ-OOK and 0.6 dB for multi-wavelength DPSK packets.

articleTitle: Endless optical polarization control and PMD compensation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate fast endless optical polarization control for instrumentation, polarization demultiplexing and PMD compensation. Mean/max polarization error is 0.077/0.197 rad during 30 minutes at up to 56-krad/s tracking speed. A 50-Grad trajectory is also tracked.

articleTitle: Very-high temperature (200°C) operation of GaN-based cascade green light emitting diode for plastic optical fiber communication
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate cascade green light-emitting-diodes, which greatly release trade-off between output-power and speed and exhibits strong modulation-speed enhancement with negligible output-power degradation from room-temperature to 200°C operation. 200 Mbit/sec error-free transmission at 200°C can be achieved.

articleTitle: In-band SBS suppression for optical high power transmitter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: No observable implementation loss is demonstrated with an in-band carrier frequency dithering technique to suppress stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) in a 50-W optical BPPM transmitter, contrast to previous demonstration with out-of-band modulation.

articleTitle: Symmetry-induced dispersion and performance penalty in coupled resonator optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that for fundamental reasons, microdisk based CROWs possess two non-degenerate transmission modes, making their long-planned use in optical communications highly challenging. Interference between these modes can lead to complete eye closure in most relevant communications scenarios.

articleTitle: All-fiber optical magnetic field sensor based on Faraday rotation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-fiber optical magnetic field sensor with a sensitivity of 0.49 rad/T is demonstrated. It consists of a fiber Faraday rotator (56-wt.%-terbium-doped silica fiber) and a fiber polarizer (Corning SP1060 fiber).

articleTitle: Full characterization of noise figure spectrum in a single-pumped fiber parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, an asymmetric NF spectrum induced by both Raman induced excess noise and Raman modified pump transferred noise of a fiber parametric amplifier has been measured. Experimental results agree well with theory.

articleTitle: Spectrum-compressed, millimeter-wave wireless over fiber access system using duobinary line coding at 10-Gbps and beyond
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, a spectrum-compressed very-high-throughput wireless-over-fiber system leveraging duobinary signaling is proposed. Error-free transmission of a 10-Gbps duobinary signal at 60-GHz over 5-km SMF-28 and 6-ft free-space is successfully demonstrated without decoders/demodulators.

articleTitle: Discrete parametric band conversion in silicon for mid-infrared applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Mid-infrared has great potential for silicon photonics. Engineering the dispersion by IR compatible cladding materials and waveguide dimensions enable broadband discrete wavelength conversion. We show that >1.2 ¿m discrete wide-band conversion is achievable at 4 ¿m pumping.

articleTitle: 43Gbit/s NRZ-DPSK and RZ-DQPSK transmission over 1000km of G.652 ultra-low-loss fibre with 200km amplifier spans
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 40×43 Gbit/s NRZ-DPSK and RZ-DQPSK transmission over 1000 km of ultra-low-loss G.652 fibre with 200 km amplifier spacing. Hybrid contra-directional Raman-EDFA amplification and lumped dispersion management enables simple, cost-effective link design.

articleTitle: Phasor monitoring of DxPSK signals using software-based synchronization technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We develop a novel technique to obtain the constellation diagram from asynchronously sampled data measured by using the delay-detection technique, and demonstrate the constellation monitoring of 10.7-Gsymbol/s DQPSK and D8PSK signals and the BER estimation.

articleTitle: Widely-tunable, multi-wavelength short wave infrared light source based on fiber optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber-optical-parametric-oscillator-based multi-wavelength pulse source operating at 1.9 μm. Multiple time- and wavelength-distinct pulse seeds were used to cover wavelength range from 1904 to 1924 nm and generate new tones with linewidths below 0.1 nm.

articleTitle: Simultaneous transmission of 256-QAM WIMAX at 5.7GHz and optically generated impulse radio UWB over fiber for indoor wireless multi-services
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fiber transmission of simultaneous optically generated FCC compliant 625 Mbps impulse radio UWB and 80 Mbps 256-QAM IEEE 802.16 WIMAX signals is experimentally demonstrated by using a single directly modulated light source.

articleTitle: Optical path restoration for up to two failures using preconfigured cycles
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a method for designing path protection for single- and multiple-wavelength optical demands surviving up to two failures. Preconfigured cycles cost-effectively provide immediate restoration without intermediate switching or wavelength conversion.

articleTitle: Regenerative tunable optical delay for phase modulated signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a multi-functional element that achieves both noise reduction and continuously tunable optical delay for phase modulated signals. We experimentally show 14.7 dB OSNR improvement and up to 882 ps tunable delay for a NRZ-DPSK modulated signal.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation in 8-Channel 42.8-Gbit/s DWDM coherent PolMux-QPSK system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation in an 8-Channel 42.8-Gbit/s DWDM coherent PolMux QPSK system. The results show that our proposed algorithm can achieve a comparable performance as the Mth-power while having much lower computational complexity.

articleTitle: All-order polarization mode dispersion (PMD) compensation in 10Gbit/s×4 OTDM system via hyperfine resolution optical pulse shaper
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical compensation of all-order polarization mode dispersion with >50 ps mean differential group delay in a 10 Gbit/s×4 OTDM system using an optical pulse shaper with 1.6 GHz/pixel resolution.

articleTitle: On the benefit of fast switching in optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Though the benefit of wavelength switching in WDM networks is well understood, that of fast switching at packet/burst level is not. We show that fast switching can further reduce wavelength resources and OEO conversion.

articleTitle: Contamination effects on optical performance for short reach 10Gb/s SFP+ transceivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This research is to establish a modeling methodology to assess insertion loss due to contamination on a lens based, 10 Gb/s, short reach Small Form-factor Pluggable (SFP+) module transceivers in multimode applications.

articleTitle: Highly efficient electrospray process for carbon nanotube-based laser pulse formers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate laser pulsation of CNTs deposited by electrospray process that ensures target-localized and homogeneous deposition of CNTs with dramatically improved deposition efficiency (>95%). Resultant pulses have 3.95-MHz repetition rate and 190.9-fs pulse width.

articleTitle: Optical crosstalk in silicon nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We characterize optical crosstalk and the associated bit-error rate degradation in silicon nanowaveguides. Our results indicate that the crosstalk decreases with increasing modulation frequency and decreases with input power, which we attribute to free-carrier absorption.
