articleTitle: Gain spectrum of an optical parametric amplifier with a temporally-incoherent pump
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the performance of a fiber optical parametric amplifier pumped with a temporally-incoherent pump. Parametric gain coefficients seven times higher than that of a coherently pumped amplifier are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Full colorless WDM-RoF system with simultaneous transmission of 63-GHz and baseband 1.25-Gbps data by sideband separation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The radio over fiber system that transmits 63-GHz-band and baseband signals simultaneously based on WDM system is proposed. 63-GHz tone is generated by optical carrier suppression method using MZM. RSOAs are used for uplink and downlink signal modulation. BER performance and RF spectrum are analyzed for observing downlink and uplink transmission characteristics. An error free transmission of both downlink and uplink signals are achieved after 23-km SSMF.

articleTitle: High efficiency nonuniform grating coupler by utilizing the lag effect in the dry etching process
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Utilizing the lag effect in dry etching, a nonuniform silicon-on-insulator grating coupler is designed and fabricated. Over 80% (>-1 dB) coupling efficiency is theoretically obtained and experimental coupling efficiency of 55% is achieved for TE polarization.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the quality of transmission in transparent mesh networks with mixed fiber types
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the quality of transmission in mesh networks relying on various fiber types. We show that the quality of transmission can be evaluated accurately using the weighted nonlinear phase criterion.

articleTitle: Photonic generation and processing technologies for converged ultra-high throughput fiber-wireless systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss the recent advances of key photonic generation and processing technologies toward high flexibility, integration, and spectrum efficiency for delivering ultra-high throughput wireless services over optical fiber systems for access and very-short-reach applications.

articleTitle: Secure optical communication using single phase modulator for bit-by-bit code scrambling and DPSK data modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed a novel bit-by-bit code-hopping scheme using single phase modulator for secure optical communication and experimentally demonstrated the transmission of 2.5 Gbps DPSK data secured by scrambling five 8-chip, 20 Gchip/s Gold codes with prime-hop patterns.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal slow light devices — tunable delay, nonlinearity, dynamic tuning —
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent progress on photonic crystal slow light devices is presented. A 100 ps class tunability, 1 THz bandwidth, ps order response, enhanced nonlinearities with chalcogenide material, and dynamic tuning for stopped light generation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Self-homodyne 10 Gbit/s PSK receiver based on stimulated Brillouin amplification and electrical filtering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first self-homodyne coherent detection of 10 Gbit/s PSK signals using Brillouin amplification of the optical carrier. Performance close to the ideal homodyne receiver is obtained by using proper line coding and post-detection high-pass filtering.

articleTitle: An optical microfiber Sagnac interferometer with adjustable transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A Sagnac interferometer based on an optical microfiber is demonstrated. It shows good adjustability of transmission, which enables it to be used as linear edge filter, optical variable attenuator, or gain flattening filter.

articleTitle: 64-Tb/s (640×107-Gb/s) PDM-36QAM transmission over 320km using both pre- and post-transmission digital equalization
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Employing raised-cosine pulse-shaped PDM-36 QAM modulation and both pre- and posttransmission digital equalization, we demonstrate 12.5GHz-spaced, 640 × 107 Gbits/s DWDM transmission over 4 × 80 km of ultra-large-area fiber with a record capacity of 64 Tb/s at 8 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-service MAC-enabled OBS networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, a novel multi-service architectural solution based on a MAC protocol for mesh OBS networks is designed and the network performance among TDM services and connectionless bursts transmissions is evaluated through simulations.

articleTitle: Yb-fiber laser frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Significant progress in Yb-fiber laser based frequency combs over the last few years resulted in sub-Hz relative comb-tooth linewidths, average powers over 60 W and GHz comb spacings enabling novel applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic birefringence induced extensional stress in curled hole-assisted fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes the dynamic birefringence induced by the extension of a curled optical hole-assisted fiber, which increases linearly under high tension. This technique can be a used for monitoring premises wiring.

articleTitle: Bit-rate tunable clock recovery of NRZ-DPSK signal based on delay-asymmetric nonlinear loop mirror and stimulated brillouin scattering loop
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate bit-rate tunable clock recovery of NRZ-DPSK signal. The signal is converted to RZ-OOK by demodulation and by phase erasure. Recovered clock signals from 4 to 13 GHz are obtained through a SBS loop.

articleTitle: Stealth transmission of time domain spectral phase encoded OCDMA signal over WDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 1.25 Gbps time domain spectral phase encoded OCDMA signal with 32-chip, 40 Gchip/s optical codes has been stealthily transmitted over public 10 Gbps WDM channel. Error-free transmission has been achieved for both the public and stealth channels.

articleTitle: A micromachined injection-locked laser via tunable grating mirror
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reports an integrated injection-locked laser constructed using microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) technology, which achieves a large wide locking range of 43 nm with an average SMSR of 32 dB.

articleTitle: All-optical multi-impairment performance monitoring of 640 Gb/s optical signals using a chalcogenide photonic chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate multi-impairment monitoring of 640 Gb/s signals enabled by a broadband photonic-chip-based radio-frequency spectrum analyser. We show simultaneous monitoring of group velocity dispersion, in-band optical signal-to-noise ratio and timing jitter from a single measurement.

articleTitle: Integrated optical and wireless access/metro networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper discusses several protocol issues in an integrated PON plus a wireless mesh network, and designs for supporting direct inter-ONU and wireless peer-to-peer communications, and collaborative mobile cellular systems.

articleTitle: Low phase noise millimeter-wave generation by integrated dual wavelength laser diode
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report millimeter-wave generation by an integrated dual wavelength laser diode based on optical sideband injection locking. Low phase noise millimeter-wave carrier at 42 GHz has been generated from 5.25 GHz modulation signal.

articleTitle: Assessment of optical switching in data center networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a scalable optical switching architecture towards contention-free interconnection for data center networks. The simulations show it can support higher load and throughput with significantly lower latency compared to today's commercial Ethernet switches.

articleTitle: A systematic approach to develop and manage SRLGs for optical transport networks with multi-tier resources
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a generalized framework that characterizes multi-tier resource dependency and operators' diversity policies in transport networks. The framework enables the design of systematic approaches toward SRLG development for optical transport networks.

articleTitle: Digital phase estimation method based on Karhunen-Loève series expansion for coherent phase diversity detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel phase estimation method for coherent systems is presented and demonstrated. It outperforms 5.5 times the phase noise and spectral width tolerance respect to the other methods.

articleTitle: Nonlinear limitations in a joint transmission of 100Gb/s O-OFDM and 40Gb/s DPSK over a 50 GHz channel grid
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate the nonlinearity impact of neighbouring DPSK DWDM channels on one 100 Gb/s PDM-OFDM channel. A new DSP-based SPM correction scheme enables complete compensation of the degradation of the nonlinear threshold of 1.8 dB.

articleTitle: Adaptive pulse shaping for high-speed optical communications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Through temporal pulse shaping at a repetition rate of 42.7 GHz, this paper demonstrates a simple method with applications in high-speed optical communications for adaptive, multi-type pulse shaping, repetition-rate multiplication and pulse generation.

articleTitle: Photodiodes with monolithically integrated wilkinson power combiner
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report improved output power and linearity characteristics of two InP/InGaAs partially-depleted-absorber photodiodes monolithically integrated with a Wilkinson power combiner and stub tuner in the frequency range up to 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Ring topology based mesh sensing system with self-healing function using FBGs and AWG
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel sensing system based on FBG sensors with comprehensive self-healing capability in a mesh-ring-based topology by utilizing the FSR and periodic filtering characteristics of the AWG.

articleTitle: Picosecond fiber optical parametric oscillator with 500 nm tuning range using dispersion-shifted fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a picosecond fiber optical parametric oscillator with a tuning range of 500 nm pumped by a relatively low-cost intensity-modulated pump. Pulses with pulsewidth from 7 ps to 17 ps are generated.

articleTitle: Impact of polarization-mode dispersion on wavelet transform based optical OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The impact of PMD on wavelet transform based optical OFDM (WTO-OFDM) systems is investigated. Simulations show that WTO-OFDM is very sensitive to PMD. A 1-dB penalty at 5-ps DGD is incurred for 112-Gb/s dual-polarization transmission.

articleTitle: Effects of nonlinear losses and design geometry on gain in silicon waveguides with erbium doped regions
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the effects of design geometry and nonlinear losses on gain in silicon with erbium-doped regions. Multi-trench designs distribute intensity more uniformly and reduce the nonlinear losses including up conversion and excited state absorptions.

articleTitle: Characterization of structural irregularities in highly birefringent photonic crystal fiber based on polarization coupling by torsional acoustic wave
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel method to characterize the variation of the birefringence induced by structural irregularities in highly birefringent photonic crystal fiber with high accuracy based on polarization coupling by torsional acoustic wave.

articleTitle: Blue-yellow-red multi-color Si-rich SiOx strip-loaded waveguide amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Si-nanocrystal incorporated Si-rich SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> strip-loaded waveguide amplifiers grown by detuning N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O/SiH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> fluence ratio and RF power are demonstrated with blue, yellow, and red multi-color amplified-spontaneous-emission and gain coefficients of 160, 70 and 45 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution over atomic-ensemble quantum repeaters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The key generation rate for quantum key distribution systems that rely on quantum repeaters with atomic-ensemble memories is obtained. We find the cross-over distances at which quantum repeaters outperform direct entanglement-distribution links.

articleTitle: Optical carrier suppression and balanced coherent heterodyne detection for improved performance in wideband microwave photonic links
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a wide-band microwave photonic link with high gain and dynamic range, low noise figure, and dispersion-free propagation using double sideband suppressed carrier modulation, optical amplification and balanced coherent heterodyne detection.

articleTitle: Quantum blackbox model for electro-optical phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present, for the first time, a blackbox model characterizing the quantum optical phase modulation operation in terms of a unitary scattering operator which excludes the unphysical negative frequencies.

articleTitle: 1.3 μm EML TOSA for Serial 40 Gbps Ethernet solution
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First 40 Gbps operation of a 1.3 μm EML TOSA employing a cost-effective flexible printed circuit as an electrical interface is demonstrated with the extinction ratio of 7.3 dB for serial 40 Gbps Ethernet solution.

articleTitle: 100G coherent DWDM transponder module enabling seamless upgrade of long haul optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review recent trends and progress in 100 G module and subsystem development for long haul DWDM applications and explore similarities and differences between these 100 G products and those developed at 40 G.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated phased-array switch for optical packet switching and interconnection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel type of wavelength-insensitive monolithically integrated InP 1×N switch is developed using optical phased-array architecture. Low-polarization-dependent 1×8 switch, 1×16 switch, and application to 320-Gbps WDM optical packet switching are demonstrated.

articleTitle: BER improvement for RZ-DPSK receivers using saturated asymmetric filtering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new enhanced receiver for noise degraded RZ-DPSK signals. A highly saturated SOA and a detuned filter are used. An error free detection for an 8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> input BER is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-speed digital coherent receiver with parallel optical sampling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical parallel processing enables electronic dispersion compensation in coherent receivers at symbol rates above the employed electronics' speed limit. Up to 64 Gbaud QPSK (128 Gb/s) are processed and transmitted up to 610 km-SSMF without optical dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Phase-transparent optical data exchange of 40-Gbit/s DPSK signals using four-wave-mixing in a highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the phase-transparent optical data exchange based on non-degenerate FWM in an HNLF via theoretical analysis and experimental verification. 40-Gbit/s NRZ-DPSK data exchange is demonstrated with a power penalty (at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>) ~ 4.5 dB.

articleTitle: Advances in MLSD-equalized incoherent transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent results in intensity modulated links' equalization are enabling previously unattainable performance, longer reach and higher spectral efficiency comparable to significantly more complex coherent transmission systems. System design aspects and tradeoffs are reviewed.

articleTitle: Hardware accelerated impairment aware control plane
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a hardware accelerated QoT estimation tool used in the DICONET impairment-aware optical network. Performance evaluation is given by examining different network scenarios in terms of network size and number of wavelengths.

articleTitle: Fiber based ultrashort pulse system with kilowatt level average power
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the generation of 830 W of compressed average power at 78 MHz pulse repetition frequency and 640 fs pulse duration. We discuss further power scaling including the issue of transversal spatial hole burning.

articleTitle: OFDM for adaptive ultra high-speed optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The introduction of OFDM into optical communications provides an exciting opportunity for future ultra high-speed optical networks that may offer adaptable rate, subwavelength accessibility, 'plug & play' automatic installation, monitoring, and maintenance. CO-OFDM presents an alternative pathway toward 1 Tb/s Ethernet. As such, CO-OFDM offers a smooth road map of line rate migration from 100 Gb/s, to 400 Gb/s, to 1 Tb/s. Due to the chromatic dispersion in fiber, multicarrier signal possesses nonlinearity advantage over single-carrier at 100 Gb/s and beyond. Opto-electronic integration for 1-Tb/s OFDM transceiver is becoming a fertile field for future research. A few-mode fiber is investigated to deliver a capacity beyond 100 Tb/s per fiber.

articleTitle: High power fiber lasers and amplifiers for applications in telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the current technology and applications of watt to multi-watt fiber lasers and amplifiers in all areas of fiber optic and free space optical communications.

articleTitle: Ultimate power limits of optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The fundamental power scaling limits for diffraction limited fiber lasers are reviewed. Relationships between the limits show there is an upper bound for single aperture power of conventional fiber lasers of 10-40 kW.

articleTitle: Fractional survivable network bandwidth: A comparison of IP over WDM schemes
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: IP over WDM network schemes are considered that protect a fraction b of the network bandwidth. If b is large then failure detection and fractional bandwidth protection at the optical layer lowers bandwidth costs.

articleTitle: High density thermoplastic ferrule for optical interconnection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 48-fiber thermoplastic MT ferrule is developed. The fiber hole position error is below 2.5 μm and the insertion loss is below 0.5 dB. The ferrule is cost effective compared with conventional thermosetting ferrule.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase noise compensation using a modified nonlinear optical loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Nonlinear phase noise compensation with possibility of simultaneous amplitude noise suppression has been experimentally demonstrated in a DPSK transmission system using a modified NOLM. As main application quadrature and higher PSK modulation formats are expected.

articleTitle: Regenerative amplification in a quantum dot SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report regenerative amplification of 10, 40 and 80 Gb/s return-to-zero (RZ) signals in a columnar quantum dot SOA (CQD-SOA). Self-phase-modulation (SPM) with a red-shifted band-pass filter and limiting amplification are exploited.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a nonlinear effects crosstalk minimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A nonlinear crosstalk minimization algorithm that simultaneously considers SPM, XPM and FWM is presented and experimentally assessed. For a PON worst-case scenario a 1 dB power gain is obtained for a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: The development of the 1.27 μm high responsivity AlInAs avalanche photodiodes for 10G-EPON (OLT)
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the 1.27 μm AlInAs APD with high responsivity of 0.93 A/W and wide bandwidth of 8.3 GHz at a multiplication factor of 10 optimized for 10G-EPON (OLT).

articleTitle: Semiconductor quantum dot devices
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this presentation, an introduction to nanostructures is presented, followed by a discussion on the different quantum dots growth methods - Frank-van der Merwe growth, Stranski-Krastanow growth, self-assembly and patterning. Devices such as self-assembled quantum dot lasers and patterned quantum dot lasers are then addressed.

articleTitle: Intra-channel chromatic dispersion measurements with live neighboring signals in a long haul DWDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel four-tone probe signal is used to measure end-to-end residual chromatic dispersion in single 50-GHz DWDM channels of a long-haul ROADM network while transmitting more than 30 live signals in neighboring channels.

articleTitle: Single-chip all-optical packet processor based on all-optical flip-flop monolithically integrated with MZI-SOA switch
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We fabricate and demonstrate all-optical packet switching using a single photonic integrated circuit (PIC), which is constructed from monolithically integrated all-optical flip-flop and switch. Both 10 and 40-Gb/s signal can be transmitted through the PIC.

articleTitle: Delay-based bandwidth-aware topology abstraction scheme for OIF E-NNI multi-domain routing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An abstraction scheme for delay-based metric advertisement of virtual intra-domain links is proposed for multi-domain traffic engineering. The scheme guarantees an effective combination of blocking probability, control plane scalability and service level performance.

articleTitle: 24-channel optical transceiver module for waveguide-on-card interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 24-channel 850nm optical transceiver modules based on silicon carriers with through-silicon electrical and optical vias have been assembled and tested at 12.5Gb/s/channel. Packaged on an organic carrier, the modules enable waveguide-connected multichip modules.

articleTitle: Impact of PMD and nonlinear phase noise on the global optimization of DPSK and DQPSK systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a global optimization algorithm, we maximize the reach of DPSK and DQPSK systems including PMD and nonlinear phase noise at data rates ranging from 5 Gbit/s to 230 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: VCSEL-based coherent detection of 10-Gbit/s QPSK signals using digital phase noise cancellation for future optical access systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a VCSEL-based QPSK coherent system to be implemented for future access systems, using digital phase noise cancellation to achieve a coherent detection of 10-Gbit/s QPSK signals with a laser linewidth of 300 MHz.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s transmission using a hybrid PDM technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A hybrid polarization division multiplexing (PDM) technique was demonstrated for 40 Gb/s RZ-DPSK signal without polarization tracking receiver (PTR). Long-term Q-factor measurements and DGD tolerance study showed performance similar to offset PDM and regular PDM with PTR.

articleTitle: 1.25/10.3Gbps dual rate algorithm for 10G-EPON burst-mode CDR
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present new dual rate algorithm for a burst-mode CDR and successfully achieved rapid burst-mode data recovery of less than 16 ns at 1.25 Gbps and of less than 6.4 ns at 10.3 Gbps in the same platform.

articleTitle: Optical generation and wireless transmission of 60 GHz OOK signals using gain switched laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel, simple and cost effective system for optical millimeter-wave generation and transmission of 3 Gbps data based on gain switching. System performance has been investigated, including wireless transmission and power budget analysis.

articleTitle: Design-space exploration for CMOS photonic processor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Monolithically integrated dense WDM photonic network topologies optimized for loss and power footprint of optical components can achieve up to 4x better energy-efficiency and throughput than electrical interconnects in core-to-core, and 10x in core-to-DRAM networks.

articleTitle: High-speed circuit technology for 10-Gb/s optical burst-mode transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A careful choice of burst-mode 3R receiver circuits achieves fast settling of 200 ns and low power of 1.68 W as well as the optical sensitivity and dynamic range in the 10G-EPON specification.

articleTitle: Area-efficient 100G+ EFEC calculation with Xilinx FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents area-optimized implementations of Galois Field multipliers that exploit the unique programmable logic cells in the Xilinx FPGA, enabling a 100 Gb/s EFEC block with significantly lower footprint within an optical transport FPGA.

articleTitle: 44-Gb/s/λ, upstream OFDMA-PON transmission with polarization-insensitive source-free ONUs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, we demonstrate colorless 44-Gb/s/λ, upstream OFDMA-PON transmission with polarization-insensitive, source-free ONUs. Superior performance is reported over 20 km SSMF plus 1:32 split, featuring OLT-side coherent detection and no ONU-side temperature control.

articleTitle: All-optical up-conversion 10-Gb/s signal in 60-GHz ROF system using 2-m Bismuth Oxide-based fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical up-conversion based on dual-pump four-wave mixing (FWM) in 2-m Bismuth Oxide-based fiber for 10-Gb/s OOK wireless signals in 60-GHz ROF systems has been experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Optical phase remodulation for 10-Gb/s WDM-PON with enhanced tolerance to Rayleigh noise
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel phase remodulation scheme for 10-Gb/s WDM-PON is proposed and demonstrated. Downstream DPSK signal with a reduced modulation depth facilitates upstream phase remodulation and Rayleigh noise suppression. High extinction-ratio is attained in downstream/upstream demodulation.

articleTitle: A novel carrier-eliminated optical millimeter-wave generation using a single over-driven phase modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A carrier-eliminated 40-GHz optical mm-wave generated by over-driving a phase modulator is first proposed. Error-free transmission over 10-km SMF-28 and 3-m wireless is successfully demonstrated with a highly relaxed bandwidth requirement for sideband optical filtering.

articleTitle: 25 Gb/s direct modulation of implant-confined holey VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 25 Gb/s direct modulation and bit error measurements over 100m multimode fiber from an 850-nm implant-confined holey VCSEL are demonstrated. The high speed performance arises from cavity designs that are achieved using standard fabrication and epitaxial materials.

articleTitle: Novel ultra wide-range frequency offset estimation for digital coherent optical receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel, dual-stage frequency offset estimator and achieve the widest range of ± 0.5 times the system symbol rate for the first time in a 42.8-Gbit/s coherent PolMux QPSK receiver.

articleTitle: Adaptive waveband switching in WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This work proposes an adaptive routing scheme based on ant optimization techniques and novel graph-based waveband assignment algorithm to accommodate and group online lightpath requests while minimizing the blocking and resources usages in WDM networks.

articleTitle: 10Gbps monolithic silicon FTTH transceiver without laser diode for a new PON configuration
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new PON configuration and novel silicon photonic transceiver architecture for ONU are proposed, eliminating the need for an internal laser source in ONU. The Si transceiver is fully monolithic and demonstrates low-cost high-volume manufacturability.

articleTitle: Octagonal large-mode-area leakage channel fiber with reduced bending loss
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate a novel design for high-power large-mode-area leakage channel fibers (LCFs) with a single octagonal dual-diameter air-hole ring encircling a nine-cell pure-silica core, having a tenfold differential mode loss and increased resistance to bending.

articleTitle: Arbitrary-frequency optical millimeter-wave generation for radio over fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The arbitrary-frequency optical microwave or millimeter (mm)-wave signals, ranging from 25 to 325 -GHz with 25-GHz spacing, can be simultaneously generated based on the generation technology of multi-wavelength laser source followed by a wavelength selected switch (WSS). These multi-wavelength signals are realized by cascading a phase modulator (PM) and a Mach-Zehnder intensity modulator. This technology is capable of generating 11 multi-wavelengths from single CW lightwave with less than 2-dB maximum power difference. One reconfigurable WSS with one input and four output ports is employed to select multiple optical mm-wave signals with a minimal frequency spacing of 25 GHz.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable linear chirp control in photonic generation of high-frequency microwave pulses
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A fiber-based approach for linear chirp control in optically-generated microwave pulses is proposed and demonstrated. Full linear chirp reconfigurability, including positive, negative and zero chirp rates, is achieved by tuning the relative delay in a fiber interferometer.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable WDM/TDM-PON ring-architecture by using all-optical wavelength converter and injection-locked FP-LD
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel ring-based WDM/TDM-PON architecture which can flexibly concentrate subscribers in response to the demand. A wavelength converter and an injection-locked Fabry-Perot LD are respectively used for downstream and upstream forwarding.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of data traffic grooming of a single 10-Gbit/s TDM tributary channel between two 160-Gbit/s WDM channels
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate tributary channel data grooming of high-speed signals using second-order nonlinearities in a PPLN waveguide. 16 TDM tributary channel data traffic grooming/exchange between two 160-Gbit/s WDM signals is shown with a penalty of ~4 dB.

articleTitle: A new optical fiber line testing function for service construction work that checks for optical filters below an optical splitter in a PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new function for construction-work undertaken to install optical cables for services in PONs. We demonstrated to determine whether an optical fiber is "live" or "unused" in branched fiber-region below optical splitter exactly.

articleTitle: High performance “Green” VCSELs for data centers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: VCSEL performance will be reviewed. A careful design of cavity structure, as well as precise control in the epitaxial growth enables us to achieve a record power conversion efficiency of 62% in the 1060nm VCSELs.

articleTitle: Vector signal transmission in radio-over-fiber link employing optical multi-sidebands modulation scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a radio-over-fiber link employing optical multi-sidebands modulation to transmit vector signals, with the advantages of overcoming dispersion-induced fading effect and system simplification.

articleTitle: The capabilities of the undersea telecommunications industry
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Undersea transoceanic telecommunications cables are routinely installed with multiple terra-bit capacity. In this presentation I will give an overview of these state-of-the-art systems, discuss key technologies, and speculate on what's to come in future builds.

articleTitle: Loss of polarization entanglement in optical fibers due to polarization mode dispersion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We perform quantum tomography measurements on polarization-entangled photon pairs traversing fibers with birefringence. We find that the entanglement disappears gradually if the birefringence affects only one photon of the pair. A theory supports our observations.

articleTitle: Ultralow-power high-performance Si photonic transmitter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a 320 fJ/bit transmitter made of a Si microring modulator flip-chip bonded to a CMOS driver. The transmitter consumes only 1.6 mW power, and exhibits a wide open eye with extinction ratio >7 dB at 5 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Compensating XPM for 100 Gbit/s coherent channels with 10 Gbit/s direct-detection NRZ neighbors
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simple optoelectronic method to compensate for cross-phase modulation in long-haul systems. Simulations show >1.3 dB improvement in Q for 1200-km 40 and 100-Gbit/s CO-QPSK and CO-OFDM channels with 10-Gbit/s NRZ neighbors.

articleTitle: Experimental analyses and optimization of equalization techniques for 60-GHz OFDM radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigated transmission performance of 16 QAM-OFDM signal over 25-km fiber and 5-m air distance using 60 GHz ROF technology. It is the first time that the details of optimal equalization technique for 60 GHz OFDM-ROF systems are presented.

articleTitle: Simplified framework for optimal support of 40Gb/s and 100Gb/s services over OTN exploiting grooming and VCAT
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simplified framework that exploits grooming and virtual concatenation to minimize the optical transport network cost for supporting 40Gb/s and 100Gb/s services. The impact of transceiver cost and maximum optical reach is assessed.

articleTitle: Design and performance evaluation of wavelength-constrained optical time-slotted networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose to design a wavelength-constrained Time-Wavelength-Interleaved Network (TWIN) that uses a non-reconfigurable core, and compare its performance to that of a Time-Wavelength-Switched Network (TWSN) which utilizes a fast reconfigurable switch.

articleTitle: Optimal hardware module planning and switch backplane configuration for layer-one traffic grooming
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an automatic hardware module planning approach for optical transport networks. An optimal switch backplane size is identified that can achieve the most cost-effective hardware module planning.

articleTitle: Passive decoy state quantum key distribution with coherent light
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simple method for passive preparation of decoy states in quantum key distribution with coherent light. It involves linear optics together with a photo-detector. The performance is comparable to the active decoy schemes.

articleTitle: Simplified field re-construction and adaptive system optimization in full-field FFE
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We simplify the implementation of full-field reconstruction and combine it with adaptive FFE. The adaptive algorithm incorporates self-equalization of system parameters and enables full-field FFE robust to sampling phase misalignment.

articleTitle: An information-diffusion-based routing scheme in wavelength-routed WDM mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel information-diffusion-based routing (IDBR) scheme in wavelength routed WDM mesh networks. The IDBR scheme has the fast convergence and the low bandwidth consumption of OSPF-TE while requires lower computational complexity as RIP.

articleTitle: Topology-optimized slow-light couplers for ring-shaped photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a topology-optimized coupler for a ring-shaped photonic crystal waveguide to improve the coupling of light located in the slow-light regime. An enhancement of the coupling efficiency of up to 2.5 dB is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improving optical steganography transmission privacy by imposing phase masks on stealth signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Temporal phase modulation of spread stealth signals is proposed to improve optical steganography transmission privacy. It increases an eavesdropper's difficulty of detecting and intercepting the stealth channel hidden under public transmission, even with dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of higher-order mode suppression in a bent large-mode-area multi-cladding fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel technique to suppress the higher-order mode in a bent large-mode-area triple-cladding fiber is experimentally presented. 3-dB suppression of LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</sub> mode is observed on a fabricated triple-cladding fiber with 130-mm diameter bend.

articleTitle: Availability-aware routing for large-scale hybrid wireless-optical broadband access network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In large-scale hybrid wireless-optical broadband access networks, the availability of wireless links and optical links varies considerably. Availability-aware routing can significantly improve availability and throughput by encouraging more usage of PON.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic devices by dressed photon exchange
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Nanophotonics is defined, and a physical picture of dressed photons is presented. Room-temperature nanophotonic logic gates and related devices are demonstrated. An application for an optical router system is also reviewed.

articleTitle: Coherent state quantum key distribution with continuous-wave laser beams
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Continuous variable quantum key distribution relies on the transmission of weakly modulated coherent states and the detection of optical field for secure communication. In this talk, we give an overview of recent developments in continuous variable quantum key distribution. In particular, we discuss a scheme that uses continuous-wave laser beams without optical pulsing. Due to its continuous wave nature, our scheme is intrinsically broadband and does not require measurement basis switching. Finally, we present a status report on integration of this system into existing communication infrastructures at the Parliamentary Triangle of Australia in Canberra.

articleTitle: A WDM-PON optical multicast overlay scheme using Inverse-RZ-duobinary signal
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate optical multicast overlay on WDM-PON employing bandwidth efficient Inverse-RZ-duobinary signal. Multicast overlay control is realized by tuning the bias at the point-to-point downstream modulator at the OLT.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic generation of millimeter-wave white-light at W-band with very-fast sweeping rate by use of high-power and broadband photonic emitters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By using photonic emitters and fast-scanning lasers at 1.55μm wavelengths, we generated very-flat spectra at 75-110GHz with a thirty times faster scanning-rate (35GHz/ms), much lower driving-voltage, and comparable power than those of tunable MMW oscillator.

articleTitle: Channel group-delay- and polarization-insensitive wavelength conversion of multichannel polarization-shift keying signal
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, simultaneous all-optical wavelength conversion for multichannel polarization-shift keying (PolSK) signal using four-wave-mixing in highly non-linear fiber. The proposed multichannel wavelength converter can realize channel group-delay and polarization-insensitive operation among the channels.

articleTitle: 200Gs/s real-time optical-sampling-based orthogonal frequency division multiplexing system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing scheme with 200 GSample/s optical sampling technique is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. 50 Gb/s AO-OFDM data is successfully transmitted over a 20 km umcompensated single-mode-fiber link with real-time direct-detection.

articleTitle: ISNOW: Integrated sensor networks with optical and wireless communications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated sensor network architecture with optical and wireless links, named iSNOW. iSNOW optimally integrates optical and wireless links through cross-link optimization including an intelligent routing protocol. iSNOW improves system performance.

articleTitle: Implementation of a high-speed quantum key distribution system for metropolitan networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Improvement of QKD performance, particularly on key generation rate, has been required to meet current network traffic. A high-speed QKD system should be equipped with low loss receivers with high visibility, highly efficient photon detectors with small dark count probability, and a stable clock synchronization system with low stray light to the quantum signals, because the key generation rate is determined by photon detection rate and error rate. High speed post processing is also required to improve key generation through-put. A solution for these issues will be discussed.

articleTitle: Fourier domain mode locking laser sweeping based on optical parametric amplification
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a Fourier domain mode locked (FDML) laser scanning from 1516 to 1550 nm and 1567 to 1597 nm using optical parametric amplifier (OPA) as the gain medium. The output power of -4.85 dBm with sweep rate of 39.6 kHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Next generation photonic network elements -multigranularity switching and rate flexible transponders
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents advanced network elements that achieve extremely high capacity and bandwidth flexibility in next-generation photonic networks. Multi-granularity-switching nodes and bit-rate-flexible transponders are discussed with experimental results including 10-Tbit/s-throughput switching and 10-Gbit/s-to-100-Gbit/s bit-rate flexibility.

articleTitle: Single-channel 400 Gbit/s, OTDM-32 RZ/QAM coherent transmission over 225 km using an optical phase-locked loop technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a single-channel 400 Gbit/s (polarization-multiplexed, 10 Gsymbol/s, 4 OTDM-32 RZ/QAM) coherent transmission using an optical phase-locked loop technique with a frequency-stabilized fiber laser. 400 Gbit/s data were transmitted over 225 km.

articleTitle: Optical buffer based on monolithic InP phased-array 1×16 switch with silica-PLC pitch converter and ultra-compact coiled fiber delay lines
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate large-capacity high-resolution optical buffer, comprising 1 × 16 InP switch and ultra-compact delay lines based on thin-cladding highly nonlinear fibers. Silica-PLC-based pitch converter is employed to realize uniform coupling from all 16 switch ports simultaneously.

articleTitle: Low phase noise laser source packaged in a low power consumption module for all optical sampling applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using low power consumption photonic modules containing a low timing jitter optical laser source and an optical gate, we demonstrated potential all-optical sampling of a radio signal carried at >5GHz with a 6 bits resolution.

articleTitle: Horizontal p-i-n high-speed Ge waveguide detector on large cross-section SOI waveguide
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a novel high-speed Ge photodetector on a large cross-section SOI waveguide platform. The device is butt-coupled with waveguide using a horizontal p-i-n junction configuration to enable highspeed operation. A very compact Ge detector with an active area of only 0.8 × 10 ¿m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, greater than 32 GHz optical bandwidth at -1 V of reverse bias, and a responsivity of 1.1 A/W is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing in highly Ge-doped nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate and study four-wave mixing in an 11-m highly Ge-doped nonlinear-fiber (HDF) for the first time. The HDF is highly compatible with standard single mode fiber that allows a homogeneous platform for signal processing.

articleTitle: Propagation of whispering gallery modes along the miniature optical fiber coils
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Propagation of the whispering gallery modes along a micro-deformed miniature optical fiber coil (MOFC) is investigated. The results are applied to explain the performance of a preliminary-fabricated MOFC. Conditions of a low-loss MOFC are discussed.

articleTitle: All-optical parallelization for high sampling rate photonic ADC in fully digital radar systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical samples of RF signals are all-optically parallelized for further processing in low-speed electrical digitizers. This technique enables high-rate sampling with no additional jitter and limited SNR degradation, making this solution suitable for radar systems.

articleTitle: A scalable constraint-based path computation approach in multi-domain optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Inter-domain network information distribution becomes the bottleneck of constraint-based path computation in multi-domain optical networks. This article proposes scalable DHT-based path computation approach to address this problem. Its performances have been evaluated by experiments.

articleTitle: InP-based photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: InP-based photonic integrated circuits are key devices for constructing photonic networks with low cost, low power consumption and small footprint. Many types of components are required to span various application areas, from backbone to on-chip.

articleTitle: Tailoring rare-earth emission spectra through controlled energy transfer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical fiber preforms were solution doped with lanthanide-containing nanoparticles. The nanoparticles spatially localize the doping yielding multiply-doped glasses that did not show energy transfer. This approach opens doors to novel broadband amplifiers and lasers.

articleTitle: Transmission of 5×62 Gbit/s DWDM coherent OFDM with a spectral efficiency of 7.2 bit/s/Hz using Joint 64-QAM and 16-QAM modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transmission of 5 × 62 Gbit/s polarization multiplexed coherent OFDM is demonstrated over 80 km SSMF. Using 64-QAM and 16-QAM simultaneously allows reducing the channel spacing and makes a net spectral efficiency of 7.2 bit/s/Hz possible.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator tunable wavelength router with minimized polarization dependent loss
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel polarization diversity scheme based on 2D grating couplers and a simple phase shifter to achieve polarization dependent loss as low as 0.15 dB in an SOI wavelength router.

articleTitle: Asynchronous 2×2 optical packet synchronization, buffering, and forwarding
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first asynchronous 2×2 optical packet switch capable of synchronizing, buffering, and forwarding 10 Gb/s packets generated from independent transmitters with better than 99% packet recovery measured using a burst mode receiver.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of MLSE-based receivers in a 1000 km transmission link under fast SOP variations
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper aims at comparing the tolerance to fast SOP variations of two MLSE-based receivers. Descriptions of the emulation device and measurement method are given. The results show that the receiver architecture impacts the performance.

articleTitle: OSNR monitoring using two fiber interferometers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In-band OSNR from 5 to 30 dB of a single 10 G NRZ-OOK channel was measured by two fiber interferometers within an accuracy of ±0.5 dB without requirement for knowledge of the noise-free extinction ratio of the signal.

articleTitle: 8-fold 40-to-320-Gbit/s phase-coherent WDM-to-TDM multiplexing and 320-to-40-Gbit/s demultiplexing using highly nonlinear fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 40-to-320-Gbit/s phase-coherent WDM-to-TDM multiplexing based on cross-phase modulation (XPM) and subsequent 320-to-40-Gbit/s demultiplexing using XPM-induced frequency shift in highly nonlinear fibers. An average penalty of approximately 7 dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER is observed after the nonlinear processes.

articleTitle: Time lens for sub-picosecond optical pulse measurement on a chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated subpicosecond temporal optical imaging based on four wave mixing temporal to frequency domain conversion in a CMOS compatible, high index glass waveguide.

articleTitle: All-solid single-trench-assisted bend-insensitive fibers: Performances and deployment aspects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate how all-solid single-trench-assisted (ultra-) bend-insensitive fibers meet the FTTH market requirements and growing needs. High manufacturing robustness, excellent splicing performances and high MPI tolerance, even in worst-case deployment scenarios, are reported.

articleTitle: Optics for volume servers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Photonic interconnects provide a solution to the problems of power consumption and diminishing communication radius in volume servers, but cost considerations dictate a very different photonic infrastructure than is found in other applications.

articleTitle: New prospects for poled fiber technology in frequency doubling and sensing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Second order nonlinearity can be created in silica fibre by poling. Practical electro-optic switches have been elusive. This paper describes new developments demonstrating real prospects for applications in sensing and second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: First experimental evidence of a novel multimode pumping scheme for an array of rare-earth doped waveguide amplifiers and lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel multimode pumping scheme for waveguide amplifier and laser arrays. Light from a broad area laser at 980 nm is coupled into a large passive waveguide and then effectively transferred to the active cores.

articleTitle: New and improved strategies for optical protection in mixed-line-rate WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Employing Mixed Line Rates (MLR) in optical WDM networks enables new paradigms for protection at lightpath level. We design transparent MLR networks with dedicated protection and achieve significant cost reduction.

articleTitle: Multi-band power allocation in AMOOFDM high data rate NG-PON downlink transmission direct modulation of linear laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Multi-band power allocation for NG-PON downlink transmission is experimentally demonstrated when implementing AMOOFDM with direct modulation of a linear laser. Multi-user power and bit-allocation allows the users datarates to be balanced according to a target QoS.

articleTitle: Nonlinear pulse processing in high-index glass integrated devices: Pulse compression
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Sub-ps pulse compression is demonstrated by using an integrated nonlinear chirper based on an integrated, low loss, low dispersion, high index glass (Hydex<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>) spiral waveguide. Compressions of 40% are demonstrated for peak power around 100 W.

articleTitle: Optical arbitrary waveform generation based optical-label switching transmitter with all-optical label extraction
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper introduces a modulation-format transparent optical-label switching transmitter based on optical arbitrary waveform generation. Packets consisting of 100 Gb/s payloads with 40 Gb/s labels and all-optical label extraction are demonstrated.

articleTitle: OBiS: Optical bit switcing - a switch architecture for optical Omnipresent Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The Omnipresent Ethernet architecture has been proposed for end-to-end communication using pure Ethernet. We extend the scheme to an all-optical variant that supports a novel scheme called optical bit-switching which is verified through simulations.

articleTitle: Reduction of XPM penalty by sub-bit delay demodulation of DQPSK
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that using a shortened delay in the demodulator for DQPSK channels can significantly reduce the XPM penalties caused by transmitting 40 Gb/s DQPSK channels alongside 10 Gb/s OOK channels.

articleTitle: Ge-doped laser fiber with suppressed stimulated brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Ge-doped laser fibers with suppressed SBS are proposed. By taking advantage of the difference between optical and acoustic properties, higher SBS thresholds of 3-5 dB are shown numerically while maintaining diffraction limited beam quality.

articleTitle: A simple, low power, self referenced technique for complete characterization of optical frequency combs and arbitrary waveforms
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple scheme which uses only an intensity modulator and an OSA to achieve low-power (~100 nW, 10 aJ/pulse at 10 GHz), self-referenced, amplitude and phase characterization of optical frequency combs and 100% duty factor arbitrary waveforms.

articleTitle: Phase stable RF-over-fiber transmission using heterodyne interferometry
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate stable transmission of 3GHz over 300m of fiber with less than 0.017 degree (17fs) RMS phase error. An interferometer measures optical phase delay, providing information to a feed-forward correction of RF phase.

articleTitle: Integrated optical hyper-parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated, CMOS compatible, multiple wavelength source based on hyper-parametric oscillation via MI (FWM) gain in a high index doped silica glass ring resonator. We obtain lasing with wavelength spacings from 200 GHz to > 6 THz, with a threshold of 54 mW. This device has promise for telecommunications and on-chip WDM optical interconnects for computing.

articleTitle: Advanced coherent modulation formats and algorithms: Higher-order multi-level coding for high-capacity system based on 100Gbps channel
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review recent technology advances in high-capacity 100Gbps system using polarization-division-multiplexed (PDM) eight-level coding (8PSK and 8QAM) and DSP-based intradyne detection. Research activities on higher-order modulation formats such as PDM-16QAM and PDM-64QAM are also summarized.

articleTitle: On operating shared-path-protected WDM networks non-revertively by using backup path reprovisioning
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Performance of using backup path reprovisioning for non-revertive operations of shared-path-protected optical networks is assessed in terms of connection availability. Numerical results indicate that the approach is attractive when sufficient free wavelengths are available.

articleTitle: All-optical XOR gate with feedback using highly ge-doped nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical XOR gate with feedback using cross-polarization-rotation in a highly Ge-doped-nonlinear fiber. The optical feedback employs a TOAD to clean up signal and for wavelength conversion, resulting in a wide-open eye diagram.

articleTitle: Statistical transmission experiments using a real-time 12.1 Gb/s OFDM transmitter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A highest speed 12.1 Gb/s real-time OFDM transmitter is reported with optimized Q-factor (Q=3D22.3 dB). Statistical performance measurements using BER testing prove similar error distributions for 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</sup>-1 PRBS data at fibers linear and nonlinear transmission regime.

articleTitle: Line coding for 10-Gb/s directly modulated lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the use of various line coding schemes (8B/10B, 5B/6B, 7B/8B, 9B/10B, 64B/66B) to improve the performance of frequency modulation-based directly modulated lasers. We show that 9B/10B line coding outperforms the other codes in terms of receiver sensitivity and dispersion tolerance.

articleTitle: Carbon-nanotube-deposited PLC waveguide for four-wave mixing based wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a novel carbon-nanotube-deposited PLC waveguide for four-wave-mixing-based wavelength conversion. Tunable wavelength converted 10-Gb/s NRZ signal is achieved with 3-dB power penalty. This is the first demonstration of CNT-technology-based device for integrated photonic applications.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable bandpass filter based on liquid crystal photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An electrically tunable bandpass filter based on two photonic crystal fibers filled with different liquid crystals is demonstrated. Both the short-wavelength and long-wavelength edge are tuned individually or simultaneously with the response time in milliseconds.

articleTitle: 110-Gb/s multi-band real-time coherent optical OFDM reception after 600-km transmission over SSMF fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate real-time reception of a 110-Gb/s multi-band OFDM signal after transmission of 600-km SSMF fiber and 400-ps differential-group-delay. The performance of 110-Gb/s CO-OFDM signal is characterized by measuring the individual sub-band at 3.33 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Current view of large scale photonic integrated circuits on indium phosphide
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the current state of large-scale and high functionality photonic integrated circuits on the InP platform for transmitters, receivers, and other device applications.

articleTitle: Stability of amplified DPSK WDM transmission against Raman crosstalk effects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate Raman-crosstalk-induced amplitude dynamics in amplified DPSK WDM transmission. We prove existence and stability of equilibrium states with nonzero amplitudes in all channels. Our results are confirmed by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of PDM-QAM16 transmission at 112 Gbit/s over 2400 km
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the efficacy of nonlinearity compensation for single-channel 14 Gbaud PDM-QAM16 over an uncompensated SMF link without Raman amplification. Nonlinear compensation increased the maximum reach from 1440 km to 2400 km for an FEC limit of 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of performance monitoring using neural networks trained with parameters derived from delay-tap plots and eye diagrams
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the use of artificial neural networks trained with parameters derived from both delay-tap plots and eye diagrams for multi-impairment monitoring in a 40-Gbit/s non-return-to-zero on-off keying system.

articleTitle: Next generation transport network architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper discusses the prospects of and challenges facing the next generation transport network architectures. Enhancements expected in optical path technologies are highlighted and state-of-the-art key enabling technologies are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Exploiting excess capacity for improved robustness in optical WDM backbone mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Any operational network has some excess capacity to accommodate new traffic demands and avoid early exhaustion of bandwidth resources. Exploiting this unused capacity to improve robustness of an optical WDM backbone mesh network is investigated.

articleTitle: Two-stage constant modulus algorithm equalizer for singularity free operation and optical performance monitoring in optical coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A two-stage constant-modulus-algorithm (CMA) equalizer for polarization-demultiplexing in a polarization-division-multiplexed coherent receiver is demonstrated. The equalizer eliminates the singularity problem of CMA equalizers and provides an effective way to monitor polarization-mode dispersion and polarization-dependent loss.

articleTitle: Novel optical fast fourier transform scheme enabling real-time OFDM processing at 392 Gbit/s and beyond
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optical FFT scheme is implemented and tested at 392 Gbit/s. It enables OFDM signal processing way beyond the bandwidth limits of electronics. The scheme operates with little energy as it exploits passive optical components.

articleTitle: Quantum dot SOA dynamic range improvement for phase modulated signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10 dB input power dynamic range advantage is found for amplification of phase-encoded signals with quantum dot SOA compared to low confinement bulk SOA. The effect is attributed to differences in the alpha-factor.

articleTitle: Simultaneous NIR and SWIR wavelength-swept generation over record 329-nm range using swept-pump fiber optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate fiber-optical-parametric-oscillator-based swept-wavelength source operating simultaneously in 1.3 μm and 1.9 μm bands. Total wavelength sweep range of 329 nm/s with cumulative speed exceeding 70000 nm/s is achieved by a seeding source generating 25 nm sweep at 6000 nm/s rate.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of wide bandwidth single and dual pump non-degenerate phase sensitive amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate non-degenerate phase sensitive amplification of a DPSK data signal in both single and double pumped parametric configurations, achieving uniform phase sensitive gain and attenuation over the 20 nm assessed bandwidth.

articleTitle: Novel generation and transmission of 2 Gbps impulse radio ultra wideband over MMF for in-building networks application
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
