authors.preferredName: H. P. A van den Boom

abstract: We propose novel generation technique of IR-UWB pulse by linearly combining two monocycles using different pulse shapes. We experimentally demonstrate DSP based BER measurement of 2 Gbps IR-UWB over multimode fiber for in-building networks application.

articleTitle: First experimental bit-error-rate validation of 12.5-Gb/s silicon modulator enabling photonic networks-on-chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Error-free 12.5-Gb/s operation of silicon microring resonator electro-optic modulator is experimentally demonstrated, with bit-error-rate and power penalty performance metrics measured using system-level comparative analysis for varying modulation rates. Results show functional feasibility for photonic networks-on-chip.

articleTitle: Optimization of the chromatic dispersion equalizer of a 43Gb/s realtime coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We optimized the 15-tap equalizer filter of a 43 Gb/s coherent polarization multiplexed QPSK receiver and compared simulation results with measurements using an FPGA-based realtime receiver. Optimization extends the chromatic dispersion tolerance from 4,000 ps/nm to 7,000 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Pseudo-Newton based equalization algorithms for QAM coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In 112 Gbit/s optical coherent transmission context, we propose decision-directed and blind adaptive equalizers using variable step size suitable for 16-QAM. The considered algorithms offer better steady state performance and convergence speed than standard adaptive equalizers.

articleTitle: 140 Gbit/s coherent optical transmission over 150 km with a 10 Gsymbol/s polarization-multiplexed 128 QAM signal
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 140 Gbit/s coherent optical transmission over 150 km with a polarization-multiplexed 10 Gsymbol/s, 128 QAM format in a 20 GHz bandwidth. Error-free 120 Gbit/s-150 km transmission is also realized with 64 QAM.

articleTitle: Efficient topologies for large-scale cluster networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Increasing integrated-circuit pin bandwidth has motivated a corresponding increase in the degree or radix of interconnection networks and their routers. This paper describes the flattened butterfly, a cost-efficient topology for high-radix networks. On benign (load-balanced) traffic, the flattened butterfly approaches the cost/performance of a butterfly network and has roughly half the cost of a comparable performance Clos network. The advantage over the Clos is achieved by eliminating redundant hops when they are not needed for load balance. On adversarial traffic, the flattened butterfly matches the cost/performance of a folded-Clos network and provides an order of magnitude better performance than a conventional butterfly. In this case, global adaptive routing is used to switch the flattened butterfly from minimal to non-minimal routing - using redundant hops only when they are needed. Different routing algorithms are evaluated on the flattened butterfly and compared against alternative topologies. We also provide a detailed cost model for an interconnection network and compare the cost of the flattened butterfly to alternative topologies to show the cost advantages of the flattened butterfly.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of all-optical polarization multiplexing and polarization demultiplexing between two 50-Gbit/s channels and a single 100-Gbit/s channel
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate all optical multiplexing and demultiplexing between two WDM 50-Gbit/s channels and a single Polarization Multiplexed 100-Gbit/s. Both On-Off-Keying and Differential Phase-Shift-Keying formats are shown.

articleTitle: 53.5% photodiode RF power conversion efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A record 53.5% RF power conversion efficiency is reported for a photodiode delivering 24.4 dBm output power. This is achieved by optimized photodiode design, optical intensity-envelope shaping with a Mach-Zehnder modulator and photodiode signal compression.

articleTitle: All-optical phase regeneration of 40Gbit/s DPSK signals in a black-box phase sensitive amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a black-box four wave mixing based bit-rate-flexible phase sensitive amplifier and use it in the first demonstration of 40 Gbit/s DPSK phase regeneration.

articleTitle: OFDM vs. OOK with MLSD for IM/DD systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the performance of direct-detection OFDM techniques using optimized power allocations to the performance of OOK with MLSD in amplified direct-detection systems using single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Optical frame synchronizer for 10 G Ethernet packets aiming at 1 Tb/s OTDM Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Synchronization of 10 G Ethernet packets to a local clock was demonstrated using a phase modulator and a SMF as retiming elements. Error free performances for the synchronized packets with different lengths were achieved.

articleTitle: 1650-km transmission of 50-Gb/s NRZ and RZ-DQPSK signals generated using an electroabsorption modulators-silica planar lightwave circuit hybrid integrated device
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate long-haul transmission of 50-Gb/s RZ and NRZ-DQPSK signals generated using an electroabsorption-based optical vector modulator. Transmission over 1650 km is achieved with less than 1.2 dB OSNR penalty relative to back-to-back performance.

articleTitle: Lessons learned from CORONET
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The DARPA CORONET Program is focused on multi-terabit core optical networks supporting highly dynamic IP and wavelength services. We describe key methodologies for achieving CORONET objectives and insight into important elements for future commercial applicability.

articleTitle: Nonlinear polarization effects and mitigation in polarization multiplexed transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that nonlinear polarization effects could significantly degrade the performance of polarization multiplexed transmission and change the perspective of dispersion management in such systems. Techniques to mitigate nonlinear polarization effects are discussed.

articleTitle: Demonstration of energy conserving TDM-PON with sleep mode ONU using fast clock recovery circuit
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An energy conserving TDM-PON architecture using sleep mode ONU is presented. Sleep mode ONU with fast wake-up capability is demonstrated. The architecture employs novel just-in-time sleep control scheme to enhance energy conservation and buffering performances.

articleTitle: Fortistis: Split extension in dense passive optical networks by inline amplification with remote ASE-shaped pump delivery via colorless optical network units
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A method for extending the customer density via ASE-pumped splitters in the tree in a WDM/TDM-PON is presented. The influence of Rayleigh backscattering in the feeder is faced, originally prohibiting any upstream transmission.

articleTitle: Network coding in optical networks with O/E/O based wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Performing network coding at network nodes with O/E/O wavelength conversion equipment incurs negligible additional cost. Our methodology finds minimum O/E/O equipment for multicast network coding on a minimal wavelength subgraph with one link failure reliability.

articleTitle: Tunable continuous-wave fiber optical parametric oscillator with 1-W output power
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on a CW fiber OPO, whose output wavelength can be tuned over the 1463-1674 nm range, by means of a tunable intracavity filter. Over 1 W of output power can be extracted at long wavelengths.

articleTitle: Integrated drop-filter for dispersion compensation based on SOI rib waveguides
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A drop-filter for dispersion compensation based on tapered Bragg gratings in SOI waveguides is presented. We show fabrication and characterization of the device, which separates one WDM channel with an overall loss of 3 dB.

articleTitle: Cost-effective 10.7 Gbit/s cooled TOSA employing rectangular to-can package operating up to 90 °C
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Employing rectangular TO-CAN and optimizing coupling mode of transmission line realize both TEC power consumption of 0.6 W at 90°C and superior optical output waveform with ask margin of 24% at 10.7 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: A 24-channel 300 Gb/s 8.2 pJ/bit full-duplex fiber-coupled optical transceiver module based on a single “holey” CMOS IC
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 24-channel 850-nm VCSEL and PD arrays are flip-chip soldered to 90-nm CMOS "holey" 48-channel 12.5-Gb/s/channel transceiver chip, featuring through-substrate holes for optical I/O. Aggregate 300-Gb/s bi-drectional data rate is highest reported for single-chip transceiver modules.

articleTitle: Power penalty measurement and frequency chirp extraction in silicon microdisk resonator modulators
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 5 Gbs and 10 Gbs error free operation of silicon photonic microdisk resonant modulators to a distance of 70 km, measure dispersion power penalties and compare the experimental results with theoretically derived values.

articleTitle: 650 Gbit/s OTDM transmission over 80 km SSMF incorporating clock recovery, channel identification and demultiplexing in a polarisation insensitive receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Error free low penalty 650 Gbit/s OTDM transmission is demonstrated using a polarisation independent receiver based on FWM for demultiplexing. Spectral shaping in the transmitter and filtering in the receiver are used for clock extraction.

articleTitle: RSOA-based 10.3 Gbit/s WDM-PON with pre-amplification and electronic equalization
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A WDM-PON bidirectional architecture with 24-dB optical budget or 35-km SSMF at 10 Gbit/s is demonstrated using a low bandwidth RSOA (~2GHz), assisted by electronic equalization and optimum offset filtering at the receiver.

articleTitle: Self-coherent optical transmission using a narrow linewidth tunable slotted fabry-perot laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A narrow linewidth slotted Fabry-Perot laser has been employed in a self-coherent optical transmission system. A comparison of the system performance of the tunable slotted laser with a SG-DBR laser has also been shown.

articleTitle: 4.7 Gbit/s transmission over 50m long 1mm diameter multi-core plastic optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: We report, for the first time, 4.7 Gbit/s transmission over 50 m long 1 mm diameter multi-core step-index plastic optical fiber, employing discrete multitone techniques and low-cost optical transceiver. A spectral efficiency of 13 bit/s/Hz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: PMD and PDL behavior of aerial fiber with the accelerated Jones-Matrix Eigenanalysis
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarization characteristics of aerial SMF were examined with the accelerated Jones-Matrix Eigenanalysis, comparing to interferometric method. PMD shows strong correlation with environmental changes but PDL doesn't. Both instantaneously increase however at different and contingent times.

articleTitle: Characterization of SBS gain and loss spectra using Fresnel reflections and interaction of two sidebands
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A compact single-ended setup for stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) spectra characterization is proposed based on microwave modulated optical sidebands and Fresnel reflection in optical fibers. The measured spectra agree well with the theoretical Lorentzian profile.

articleTitle: Single channel, 200 Gb/s, chromatic dispersion precompensated 100 km transmission using an optical arbitrary waveform generation based optical transmitter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents single channel, 200 Gb/s, 20-bit DPSK packets generated by an optical arbitrary waveform generation based optical transmitter with chromatic dispersion precompensation, and their transmission through 100 km of single-mode-fiber and recovery.

articleTitle: Radio frequency transparent demodulation for broadband wireless links
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel demodulation technique for radio over fiber systems, transparent to RF carrier frequency, employing coherent detection and baseband digital signal processing is presented for the first time. Multi-gigabit signal demodulation at 40 GHz RF is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Algorithms for coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: coherent receiver hardware; optical hybrid network; clock recovery-retiming; polarisation estimation; phase estimation; parallel DSP architectures; cycle slip management; quadrature amplitude modulation; OFDM signals; CD compensation algorithms; PMD compensation and fiber nonlinear effect compensation.

articleTitle: 50-wavelength channel-by-channel tunable optical dispersion compensator using combination of arrayed-waveguide and bulk gratings
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel optical configuration for a channelized tunable optical dispersion compensator (TODC) with channel-by-channel operation across entire the L-band. The TODC consists of a cyclic frequency arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) whose free spectral range (FSR) coincides with the channel spacing, a bulk grating and a liquid crystal on silicon. We achieved channel-by-channel compensation over 50 channels with a maximum chromatic dispersion of 800 ps/nm.

articleTitle: A novel subcarrier OFDM-MSK WDM passive optical network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally propose and demonstrate generation, transmission and reception of the optical OFDM-MSK modulation in WDM-PON. Our experimental results suggest that OFDM-MSK modulation scheme will be a promising candidate for future optical access network.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion towards Rayleigh backscattering tolerant PONs via four-wave mixing in SOA-based ONUs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Wavelength shifting in PONs with downstream signal remodulation is presented, allowing upstream transmission over trees with 25 km feeder and 1:32 split with penalties < 2 dB, originally Rayleigh backscattering limited. Side-mode suppression is analyzed for hybrid PONs.

articleTitle: Optical memory elements with extremely wide hysteresis window (94mA) using partly saturable-absorber novel active MMI bi-stable laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel active MMI bi-stable laser diodes are proposed and demonstrated. Using partly saturable-absorber configuration in active MMI, extremely wide hysteresis window of 94mA was achieved with 30fJ optical switching energy in 335μm total device length.

articleTitle: Highly integrated InP-based subsystems for all-optical processing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation is given. Topics discussed are optical signal processing; InP-based devices; integrated devices; device examples and application examples.

articleTitle: IEEE 802.3av™-2009 10G-EPON and support for loss budgets beyond 29dB
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The recently approved 10 G-EPON support the maximum loss budget of 29 dB. Through straightforward reconfiguration of existing PMD components, 32 dB loss budget can be supported (providing 1:512 split at approx. 6.4 km), exceeding G.987.2 XG-PON Nominal2 class

articleTitle: A symmetric 320Gb/s capable, 100km extended reach hybrid DWDM-TDMA PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a DWDM-TDMA PON with symmetric 320 Gb/s capacity shared between 16384 customers. The upstream channels were tested in burst-mode and feature low-cost tuneable lasers, monolithically integrated SOA-EAMs, burst-mode EDFAs and a 10 Gb/s burst-mode receiver.

articleTitle: Frequency resolved angle and time difference of arrival estimation with spatial spectral holography
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Correlative power spectrum and spectral phase mapping via readout of a fiber interferometer with spatial-spectral materials is analyzed and demonstrated to enable precise frequency resolved time delay and angle of arrival estimation with microwave signals.

articleTitle: Low loss chalcogenide glass waveguides fabricated by thermal nanoimprint lithography
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low loss thermally nanoimprinted chalcogenide waveguides are demonstrated for the first time, uniquely using a soft PDMS stamp. Losses of 0.24 dB/cm at 1550 nm limited by Rayleigh scattering were achieved and embossing of As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration on the reduction of linewidth impact in a self-heterodyne optical OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show experimentally that the signal quality of a self-heterodyne optical OFDM system can be improved by temporally realigning the carrier with the subcarriers before photodetection. This can be explained by self-heterodyne linewidth measurement theory.

articleTitle: The transition to chip-level optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The increasing bandwidth demands of computing chips have spawned significant research into chip-scale photonic interconnects. We review the DARPA-sponsored efforts at the inter- and intra-chip interconnect levels and highlight the key challenges to be addressed.

articleTitle: Multi-channel return-to-zero signal regeneration using a single phase modulator and an AWG
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate multi-channel RZ signal regeneration based on a phase-modulator and an AWG. BER improvements for 8 10Gb/s channels after 450km transmission demonstrate that regeneration with timing jitter reduction and dispersion compensation can be achieved.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband optical chirp linearization for precision length metrology applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate precise linearization of ultra-broadband (>5 THz) laser frequency sweeps using a fiber-based self-heterodyne technique. Frequency errors less than 170 kHz relative to linearity were observed enabling very high resolution ranging over large distances.

articleTitle: High performance photonic integrated circuits for coherent fiber communication
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Advanced modulation format transmitters and receivers used in optical coherent systems are highly complex, containing many interconnected elements. Photonic integration can reduce the footprint, cost, and power consumption of optical coherent transceivers.

articleTitle: 640 Gbit/s single-polarization DPSK transmission over 525 km with time-domain optical Fourier transformation in a round-trip configuration
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 640 Gbit/s single-polarization DPSK signal was transmitted over 525 km in a single channel. Time-domain optical Fourier transformation in a round-trip configuration greatly enhanced the tolerance to higher-order PMD and provided error-free performance.

articleTitle: Transceiver modules utilizing travelling-wave electro-absorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Electro-Absorption-Transceiver (EAT) structures used as efficient Travelling-Wave Electro-Absorption-Modulator (TWEAM) as well as Travelling-Wave-Photo-Detector (TWPD) are investigated. Clear eye-openings at 100 Gb/s for operation as modulator and/or as detector, as well as 80 Gb/s transmission between a pair of EATs, are presented.

articleTitle: Challenges of 40/100 Gbps deployments in long-haul transport networks on existing fibre and system infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High-bandwidth services require faster long-haul transport networks. Meanwhile operators are not ready to make evolve significantly their fibre infrastructure based on PMD-limited G.652 fibre while they would like to upgrade the already deployed WDM systems by replacing progressively 10 Gbps wavelengths by 40 and 100 Gbps channels. Challenges of 40/100 Gbps deployments on legacy fibre and system infrastructure are discussed here.

articleTitle: Optical printed circuit board with an efficient optical interface for 480-Gbps/cm2 (20 Gbps × 12 ch × 2 layers) high-density opticall interconnections
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a high-speed (20 Gbps) and high-density (480 Gbps/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) optical printed circuit board with a new two-lens optical interface for optical interconnections, and successfully demonstrated a 20-Gbps operation in our optical interconnection.

articleTitle: FiOS cost efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: As part of FiOS deployment Verizon is constantly looking for opportunities to reduce overall deployment cost. This paper focuses on some of the ways VZ has achieved cost efficiency and ongoing initiatives looking at possible cost reduction in the future FiOS deployments.

articleTitle: Effect of spectral hole burning on the feedforward control of erbium-doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, the effect of spectral hole burning (SHB) on the feedforward control of an erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA) is investigated. A novel experimental setup allowing to verify a mathematical model for this effect without the inaccuracies of measurement setups used so far is presented. Using this model, it is shown that SHB leads in drop scenarios to overshoots up to a certain output power level, whereas undershoots are observed for larger output powers.

articleTitle: PDM-OFDM for upgrade scenarios: An investigation of OFDM-induced XPM on 42.8-Gb/s DPSK over SSMF and LEAF
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear tolerance of 42.8-Gb/s DPSK with PDM-OFDM neighbors. It is found that the XPM penalty scales with the OFDM-bandwidth and that for data rates up to 40-Gb/s delta powers are required.

articleTitle: Low-cost and high-capacity short-range optical interconnects using graded-index plastic optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: H. P. A van den Boom

abstract: We demonstrate a transmission rate of 51.8 Gb/s over 100-meters of perfluorinated multimode graded-index plastic optical fiber using discrete multitone modulation. The results prove suitability of plastic fibers for low-cost high-capacity optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Cloud computing over light-trail WDM core networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Light-trail, a spatial sub-wavelength optical grooming solution for WDM networks, facilitates dynamic bandwidth provisioning and optical multicasting - essential for cloud computing services. We evaluate through simulations a novel protocol for cloud computing over light-trails.

articleTitle: Towards real-time implementation of optical OFDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the progresses made towards real-time implementation of optical OFDM, with emphasis on the needed digital signal processing (DSP). Various OFDM procedures and algorithms are discussed in the context of DSP-efficiency and resource requirement.

articleTitle: Characterization of a MEMS based optical system for free-space board-to-board optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate alignment of an array of VCSELs to detectors, using a MEMS-based lens system for free-space board-to-board optical interconnects. Our optical system is capable of aligning up to 5 degrees of freedom.

articleTitle: Architectural trade-offs for video transport networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Several architectural aspects and options are discussed for producing video based services: storage and transcoder placement, routing and (staggered) multi-casting, buffering/smoothing and retiming streams, separate handling of I-frames from B-/P-frames and applying optical flow switching.

articleTitle: Polarization independent dual wavelength converter based on FWM in a single semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a FWM-based dual channel wavelength converter in an SOA with very small variations in conversion efficiency and a minor polarization related power penalty of 0.9 dB between best and worst case of polarization states.

articleTitle: The impact of peer-to-peer networking on user behaviour and network design
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: P2P networking is a powerful tool for content distribution. Decentralised P2P networks lead to other traffic patterns than client-server networks, which affect the whole network. Higher upstream bandwidth and more dynamics in the access network are rewarded.

articleTitle: Colorless 10Gb/s extended reach WDM PON with low BW RSOA using MLSE
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A low bandwidth RSOA-based WDM-PON system is evaluated at 10 Gb/s with an off-line processing. Results show that almost 20 Km bidirectional and 125 km unidirectional fiber are feasible by means of 8 states conventional MLSE.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-spectral-efficiency transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss the generation, transmission, and coherent detection of 14-Gbaud polarization-division multiplexed, 16-ary quadrature-amplitude-modulation (16-QAM) signals (112-Gb/s line rate). We attain 630-km and 1020-km wavelength-division-multiplexed transmission with spectral efficiencies of 6.2 b/s/Hz and 4.1 b/s/Hz, respectively.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s 1550 nm VCSEL transmission over 23.6 km single mode fiber with no dispersion compensation and no injection locking for WDM PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 10 Gb/s VCSEL transmission for WDM PON over 23.6 km single mode fiber. Dispersion penalty is limited to 2.9 dB by introducing a wavelength offset with respect to the remote array waveguide grating to reduce chirp.

articleTitle: 41.25 Gb/s real-time OFDM receiver for variable rate WDM-OFDMA-PON transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The first real-time, record-speed 41.25 Gb/s 8 QAM-OFDM receiver is demonstrated using FPGA-based DSP. Superior upstream WDM-OFDMA-PON performance with variable rate transmission is exhibited over 20 km SSMF and a 1:32 split.

articleTitle: A 448 × 448 optical cross-connect for high-performance computers and multi-terabit/s routers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the feasibility and dynamic switching performance of a 448 × 448 AWGR-based OXC with nanoseconds switching speed. To our knowledge, such a port-count is unprecedented for such switches.

articleTitle: Wide dynamic range OSNR monitoring for RZ-DQPSK systems using delay-tap sampling technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose half-symbol delay-tap sampling for OSNR monitoring and extend the monitoring range to 5-45 dB. The proposed method also enables calibration-free monitoring with range of 16-43 dB at 40 Gbps data rate.

articleTitle: Optically powered low-energy demarcation device for monitoring FTTx networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an energy-autarkic FTTx monitor. A special protocol and sophisticated hardware reduce the electrical operating power to 0.7μW, which can be delivered by an optical supply signal of only 5μW/monitor at a separate wavelength.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency in 10Gbps Ethernet transceivers: Copper versus fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The new Energy Efficient Ethernet standard will significantly improve the energy efficiency of 10 Gbps copper transceivers. This paper compares the energy efficiency of 10 Gbps Ethernet copper transceivers that implement the new standard with fiber transceivers.

articleTitle: Noise reduction of OCDM signals by electrical time gating
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: To reduce the MAI noises from the received OCDM signals, a new electrical time gating method has been designed and evaluated. The results show a bit-error rate improvement of up to over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>.

articleTitle: Self-polarization-stabilization technique for long-reach coherent WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple self-polarization-stabilization technique for the long-reach RSOA-based WDM PON implemented with self-homodyne receivers. The effectiveness of this technique is confirmed in 2.5-Gb/s transmission experiments over 68-km long link partially composed of installed fibers.

articleTitle: Tunable DWDM XFP with an external cavity laser transmitter and transmission performance matching 300-pin transponders
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A full C-Band tunable 10 G DWDM XFP using external cavity laser (ECL) technology is presented. Using this approach, we demonstrate performance on par with traditional 300-pin transponders, enabling the system equipment transition to higher density with pluggable optics.

articleTitle: 1-Tb/s DWDM amplification in a fiber optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report less than 1-dB cross-talk penalty for 26 DWDM channels modulated at 43.7 Gb/s RZ-DPSK when amplified by a fiber optical parametric amplifier showing compatibility with high-capacity (> 1 Tb/s) communication systems.

articleTitle: Channel capacity of step-index Polymer Optical Fibers: Experiments and simulation with realistic parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Step-index Polymer Optical Fibers (SI-POF) are candidates for broadband in-house networks. For the first time, we give a comprehensive overview over the real channel capacity of POF links up to 100 m, based on experimental investigations and complex system simulations. More than 2 Gbit/s can be transmitted at very low BER with existing components. Improved devices will give place for further progress.

articleTitle: AT&Ts photonic backbone design options
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: As AT&T plans for the future, there are a number of critical decisions required to define a new 100G backbone. These decisions are driven by specific carrier characteristics, which are described in this paper.

articleTitle: Reducing modal noise in short-range radio over multimode fibre links
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Reducing gain fluctuations in Short Range Radio over Multimode Fiber Links requires Central Launch. Furthermore, the quality of today's optical connectors gives importance to the combined effect of finite detecting area and Laser frequency chirp.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity management and compensation in transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Nonlinearity remains a limiting factor in optical data transmission due to demand in high bit rate high spectral efficiency transmission. Dispersion management is still an effective mitigation method. PM-QPSK with coherent Rx improves Rx sensitivity and has good nonlinear tolerance. It is still beneficial to have optimized FEC overhead. Access to the signal optical fields allows for DSP nonlinearity compensation. Compensation schemes are dependent on the dispersion in the transmission path. Experimental results has shown 1dB or less performance improvement -SPM compensation.

articleTitle: Electronic dispersion compensation by Hadamard transformation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that the Hadamard transform can be applied to look up table (LUT)-based predistorters to simultaneously compress and optimize the LUT for dispersion-limited links.

articleTitle: Heuristic strategies for routing 100-GbE over OTN in distributed differential delay compensation architectures
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A heuristic optimization framework is proposed for routing virtually-concatenated 100Gb/s Ethernet over optical transport networks with distributed differential delay compensation. Under short computing times, reduced buffer sizes and limited link capacity requirements are obtained.

articleTitle: Comparison of microbending loss characteristics between LMA holey fibers and conventional LMA fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We fabricated holey fibers with effective area of 130μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 150μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Advantages of using holey fibers are demonstrated by comparing microbending loss properties with conventional step-index LMA fibers.

articleTitle: End-to-end real-time demonstration of 128-QAM-encoded optical OFDM transmission with a 5.25bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency over IMDD systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Real-time optical OFDM transceivers with 128-QAM encoding are experimentally demonstrated, for the first time, which enable 5.25 Gb/s end-to-end transmission with the highest spectral efficiency of 5.25 bit/s/Hz over 25 km (500 m) SMF(MMF) IMDD systems involving directly modulated lasers.

articleTitle: Impact of pulse shaping on the SPM tolerance of electronically pre-compensated 10.7 Gb/s DPSK systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Pulse shaping for electronic pre-compensation systems using differential phase shift keying modulation is experimentally shown to provide a 1.9 dB increase of the nonlinearity threshold.

articleTitle: A linear cascade near-ballistic uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes with extremely high saturation-current bandwidth product (6825mA-GHz, 75mA/91GHz) under a 50Ω load
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate linear cascade near-ballistic uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes. Compared with control (a single device), this novel structure exhibits significant improvement in bandwidth-efficiency and saturation-current-bandwidth products. Record-high saturation-current-bandwidth product ( > 6825 mA-GHz, 91GHz) under 50Ω loads can be achieved.

articleTitle: Link-aware precoding for nonlinear optical OFDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that signal shaping schemes for the reduction of nonlinearities in optical OFDM systems need to take into account the signal evolution along the dispersive link. Rather than minimizing the transmit PAPR, a good precoding scheme should minimize the cumulative power variance.

articleTitle: Field verification of 40G DPSK upgrade in a legacy 10G network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report verification of 1,200 km field upgrade of 10 G NRZ wavelengths with 40 G DPSK channels. Non symmetric dispersion map results in pronounced intra-channel nonlinear effect, which could be significantly reduced by dispersion pre-compensation.

articleTitle: 172-Gbps cascaded OTDM MUX and DEMUX operations of 43G VSR transceivers using integratable semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 172-Gbps cascaded OTDM MUX and DEMUX for future LAN applications. Challenge is that the key devices are integratable, i.e. ISBT optical gates, EAM-DFB VSR MSA transceivers, quantum-dot SOAs, and mode-locked laser diodes.

articleTitle: BER performance of 16-QAM signals amplified by dual-pump fiber optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We derive analytically the probability distribution function of the excess amplitude noise induced by pump noise transfer in dual-pump fiber optical parametric amplifiers and calculate the signal-to-noise ratio penalty for amplification of 16-QAM signals.

articleTitle: Double-pass PBS-integrated coherent mixer using silica-based PLC
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A coherent mixer with double-pass polarization-beam splitters integrated in silica-based PLC is newly developed. It is experimentally confirmed that the developed PLC-chip successfully works in the receiver for 40-Gbit/s dual-polarization quadrature phase-shift keying signal.

articleTitle: Digital optical phase locked loop for real-time coherent demodulation of multilevel PSK/QAM
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a digital optical phase locked loop (DOPLL) for real-time demodulation of high-speed multilevel PSK/QAM. It was simply implemented using low-speed digital signal processor after electrical sampling to demodulate high-speed BPSK, QPSK and 16QAM.

articleTitle: Mapping and transport standard for OTU4
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recently revised ITU-T G.709 defines a container for 100 Gbps signals called an OTU4. This paper highlights some of the reasons the OTU4 bit rate, frame structure, and mapping scheme were chosen.

articleTitle: Noise figure measurements in phase-insensitive and phase-sensitive fiber parametric amplifier cascade
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By cascading two non-degenerate inline fiber-optic parametric amplifiers, we observe NF ~2dB (beating phase-insensitive quantum limit) at 16-dB gain for the second (phase-sensitive) stage after subtracting the excess noise from the first (phase-insensitive) stage.

articleTitle: All-optical label processing in optical packet switched networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a data-format transparent all-optical label processing system suitable for photonic integration that requires N active device to process 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup> addresses. We demonstrate error-free all-optical packet switch with label swapping operation at 160 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Multiband signals generation and transmission over fiber and air by a novel frequency-doubled, radio-over-fiber architecture without expensive carrier suppression filters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel frequency-doubled wireless over fiber system to offer multiband services including baseband, 60-GHz millimeter-wave and 15-GHz microwave without carrier suppression. Multiband wireless signals are successfully transmitted through both fiber and air channels.

articleTitle: Astrophophotonics: A new generation of astronomical instruments
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The emergence of astrophotonics - a field that lies at the interface of astronomy and photonics - is timely as it has the potential to solve a number of outstanding problems in astronomical instrumentation.

articleTitle: Low-loss intermateability of APC-MPO connectors between different material and different guide hole diameter plugs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low-loss intermateability design of SM-APC-MPO connector was studied. Plugs of different dimensions for guide hole diameters, different materials and different Yoffset values demonstrated low-loss intermateability of less than 0.25 [dB] for 97% value.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband supercontinuum generation from ultraviolet to 6.28 μm in a fluoride fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-broadband SC generation from UV to 6.28 μm in a 2-cm-long fluoride fiber pumped by a 1450 nm femtosecond laser.

articleTitle: A dual-peak optical demultiplexer in 60GHz-band radio over fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A dual-peak optical demultiplexer based on sampled and phase-shifted fiber Bragg grating was proposed and the impact of group delay is discussed. The demultiplexer is experimentally demonstrated and applied in a 62.5-GHz RoF system.

articleTitle: All-optical contention resolution using a single optical flipflop and two stage all-optical wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new scheme for 40 Gb/s all-optical contention resolution based on cascaded wavelength converters and a hybrid integrated optical flip-flop. Using simultaneously both ports of the flip-flop, component and power reduction is achieved.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator ring-shaped photonic crystal waveguides for refractive index sensing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an integrated refractive index sensor based on a ring-shaped photonic crystal waveguide. We measured the shift in cut-off wavelength for different ambient refractive indices and we observed a sensitivity of ¿¿/¿n = 110 nm/RIU.

articleTitle: Towards on-chip, integrated chalcogenide glass based biochemical sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reviews ongoing progress in the development of novel on-chip planar molecular sensors in infrared-transparent chalcogenide glasses. We demonstrate on-chip cavity-enhanced refractometry and infrared absorption spectroscopy for sensitive detection of proteins and small molecules.

articleTitle: Design of single-polarization single-mode photonic crystal fiber based on index-matching coupling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new design to achieve single-polarization single-mode guidance in highly birefringent photonic crystal fiber. The suppression of unwanted polarization state is realized by introducing index-matched cladding defect waveguide.

articleTitle: High bit-error tolerant frame/lane alignment for 100 Gb/s multi-lane transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study high bit-error tolerant frame/lane alignment for 100 Gb/s multi-lane transmission with advanced modulation formats. Bit-error allowance/correction for frame/lane alignment improves the bit-error tolerance and achieves stable operation even at the uncorrected BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Diversity requirements for selecting candidate paths for alternative-path routing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In alternative-path routing, it is shown that requiring candidate paths to be diverse only with respect to the most congested links in the network performs better than requiring the candidate paths to be completely diverse.

articleTitle: A high capacity and long reach DWDM-PON using triple-contact F-P LDs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a color-free DWDM-PON at 50 GHz channel spacing by using the triple contact F-P LD. The transmission length of 30 km and 90 km are demonstrated with and without FEC at 1.25 Gb/s-per-channel.

articleTitle: RZ-to-NRZ and NRZ-to-PRZ format conversions using a photonic crystal fiber based Mach-Zehnder interferometer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have fabricated a photonic crystal fiber based Mach-Zehnder interferometer and demonstrated its use in both RZ-to-NRZ and NRZ-to-PRZ pulse format conversions for 10-Gb/s OOK signals. The PCF length is only ~165 cm.

articleTitle: Burst switching for energy efficiency in optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Energy consumption of electronic burst switching is modeled and compared to electronic packet switching in the network core and edge. It is shown that burst switching can provide significant energy savings relative to packet switching.

articleTitle: Development of photonic switching node prototypes for transparent networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using newly developed PLZT-based OBS core node, low-loss Ether-frame transmission with application-layer connectivity is demonstrated over 92-km 2-hop field testbed. Recent progresses in developing OPS/OCS hybrid router are also reviewed.

articleTitle: Polar coordinate transformation based dual binary-drive QPSK modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: QPSK signal generation by a dual binary-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator employing polar coordinate transformation was experimentally demonstrated for cost-effective digital coherent transceivers. Tolerance to a bias and driving voltage error is discussed for practical implementation.

articleTitle: Fiber optic structural Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The main fiber optic and other non contact Photonic technologies used in Structural Health Monitoring (PSHM) will be reviewed, several case study and sector applications examples will also be addressed and, finally, the conclusions summarized.

articleTitle: Resource-efficient task assignment and scheduling in optical grids
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a resource-efficient list scheduling heuristic for the problem of task scheduling in an optical Grid with the objectives of maximizing the network utilization efficiency and minimizing the task completion time.

articleTitle: Chirped sub-50 fs pulse generation: Optimization of fiber length for ultrafast fiber optical parametric oscillators
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Sub-50 fs pulses at 940 nm having linear chirp are generated using a synchronously-pumped fiber optical parametric oscillator where the fiber length is chosen to compensate for dispersion from optical components inside of the cavity.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear properties of ultra-compact fiber device
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Linear and nonlinear characteristics of devices using millimeter-scale spools of highly-nonlinear fiber are investigated within 1200-2400 nm band. An ultracompact tunable short-wave infrared source was constructed to demonstrate efficient nonlinear conversion from 1.26 to 2.2¿m.

articleTitle: Continuous phase modulation as an alternative to QPSK for 100 Gb/s optical links
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Constant envelope formats including CPM may reduce the impact of nonlinear impairments arising from intensity variations and the associated nonlinear phase noise. We quantify the advantages of CPM versus QPSK and identify possible deployment opportunities.

articleTitle: Two-qubit state engineering in the telecom O-band
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We build and characterize a fiber-based source of 1310-nm polarization entanglement with the highest reported fidelity to a maximally entangled state, 99.6% ± 0.15% as characterized via coincidence basis tomography.

articleTitle: 1.8-ps RZ-pulse 43-Gbps transmissions over 126-km DSF with parametric tunable dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 1.8-ps pulse 43 Gbps RZ-OOK transmissions over 126-km zero-DSF using a parametric tunable dispersion compensator with slope compensation. The penalty dependence on the converted wavelengths was consistent with the designed dispersion values.

articleTitle: Digital equalization of ultrafast data using real-time burst sampling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate digital equalization of 40 Gbps data enabled by use of Real-time Burst Sampling (RBS) with photonic time-stretch A/D converter. Evaluation of a feed-forward equalizer and a decision feedback equalizer is also shown.

articleTitle: 10.3-Gb/s operation over a wide temperature range in 1.3-μm quantum-dot DFB lasers with high modal gain
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Temperature-stable 10.3-Gb/s operation was attained for 1.3-μm quantum-dot DFB lasers with high modal gain. Clearly-opened eye diagrams with the extinction ratio of over 5.2 dB were obtained from -40°C to 80°C.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement of distributed reflector lasers at low bias current by optical injection locking
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By optical-injection-locking, the bandwidth enhancement of Distributed-Reflector lasers with quantum-wire-like active regions was demonstrated. The bandwidth was increased to >15-GHz at a 5-mA bias, which is 4-times smaller bias than that for conventional edge-emitting lasers.

articleTitle: Operationalizing a control plane network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Control Plane: A set of architectures and protocols that enable an optical transport network to operate in a dynamic, self-organizing mode

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s XPM based all-optical retiming using filtered clock signals from a quantum-dash fabry-perot laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The implications of the number of laser modes in the spectrum of a filtered clock signal on XPM based retiming is investigated in terms of SBS suppression, spectral broadening and timing jitter.

articleTitle: Method for estimating loss over wide wavelength region of fiber cables installed in access networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simple method for estimating the loss of installed cables to expand WDM access networks. Loss at arbitrary wavelengths can be very accurately predicted from the measured loss at a few wavelengths.

articleTitle: Phase-preserving amplitude regeneration for RZ-DPSK signals at 42.7 Gbit/s using saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally evaluate a novel all-optical phase-preserving amplitude regeneration technique for RZ-DPSK signals using saturable absorber. The device's capacity for amplitude noise reduction, hence preventing from nonlinear phase noise accumulation is demonstrated at 42.7 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Simultaneous 3 × 10-Gbps optical data transmission in 1-μm, C-, and L-wavebands over a single holey fiber for ultrabroad-waveband photonic transport system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Simultaneous 3 × 10-Gbps error-free photonic transmissions with clear eye-openings are demonstrated in the 1-μm, C-, and L-wavebands by using an ultrabroad-waveband photonic transport system comprising a 3.3-km-long holey fiber transmission line.

articleTitle: Reducing spectral attenuation in solid-core photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the effects of fabrication process timing and preform exposure to atmospheric air on spectral attenuation in photonic crystal fibers. The lowest attenuation is achieved by rapid processing.

articleTitle: Distributed birefringence measurement of polarization maintaining fiber using transient Brillouin grating
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a true distributed birefringence measurement of polarization-maintaining fiber based on transient Brillouin grating. A birefringence variation of 2.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> along 8 m Bow-tie fiber is measured with 20 cm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Linear coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The development of linear coherent receivers at UCSB is reviewed. The progression of the feedback receiver architecture toward closer integration, lower feedback delay and higher performance is outlined. The alternative XOR receiver approach is summarized.

articleTitle: Integrated triplexer on hybrid silicon platform
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated the first laser and photodetector integrated triplexer on silicon with a compact size of 1mm*3.5 mm. The 3 dB bandwidth for the 1310 nm laser and 1490/1550 nm photodetector were measured to be 2 GHz and 6 GHz respectively.

articleTitle: Novel 2×2 wide-angle AlGaAs/GaAs carrier-injection optical switch with reduced power consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 2 × 2 AlGaAs/GaAs optical switch based on our wide-angle design including current-spreading restriction, curved electrodes, double-reflection interfaces, and graded heterojunctions. The fabricated device has a 7° crossing angle and a 0.6 W power consumption.

articleTitle: Highly-birefringent tunable long-period fiber gratings in hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber by use of mechanical pressure
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The mode coupling properties of highly-birefringent tuneable LPGs formed in HC-PBGF are presented. The mode coupling from the fundamental core mode to higher-order guided mode of a HC-PBGF is obtained by use of periodic mechanical pressure.

articleTitle: A novel multi-bit optical code label processing scheme in optical packet switching networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Parallel-to-cascading optical code label processing is proposed and experimentally demonstrated in a 16-node setup. The physical structure for multi-bit label's processing is significantly simplified, since only one encoder, one decoder and one photodiode are needed.

articleTitle: Determination of localized loss in cabled fiber using OTDR measurements of relative mode field diameter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced sensitivity of a commercial OTDR by employing novel bidirectional analysis techniques. The method is applicable to measurements of cabled fiber where fluctuations in local mode field diameter are due to factory variations.

articleTitle: Dispersion fluctuation equalization nonlinear fibers by spatially controlled tension
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally verified that spatial dispersive fluctuations in nonlinear fiber can be effectively suppressed by inverting precisely mapped zero-dispersion wavelength via application of longitudinally controlled stretching.

articleTitle: Tunable single-longitudinal-mode fiber optical parametric oscillator with saturable-absorber-based auto-tracking filter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A tunable single-longitudinal-mode (SLM) fiber optical parametric oscillator is demonstrated by using a subring cavity and a fiber loop mirror incorporated with a saturable absorber. It can provide dual-wavelength SLM output.

articleTitle: Application of SONET Adaptive Rate to multi-carriers transport network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper provides a current assessment of SONET Adaptive Rate technique from the local access service provider perspective. It also highlights how it shortens the service provisioning and activation processes from weeks to hours.

articleTitle: QPSK-OFDM radio over polymer optical fiber for broadband in-building 60GHz wireless access
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 500Mb/s Quadrature Phase-Shift Keying (QPSK)-Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) signals on 60-GHz mm-wave are experimentally demonstrated over 100-m graded-index polymer optical fiber with less than 1 dB power penalty at BER = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: High refractive index Bi2O3- B2O3-TeO2 glass with high visible-NIR transmittance
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have newly developed Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> glass system. This glass shows high transmittance in visible and near-IR wavelength, in spite of their high refractive index and optical nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Polarization-dependent loss induced penalties in PDM-QPSK coherent optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate PDL-induced penalties in PDM-QPSK coherent systems with both lumped model and distributed model. We find the lumped model significantly over-estimates PDL penalties and PDM coherent systems can tolerate more PDL than single-polarization systems.

articleTitle: Dual- versus single-carrier configuration for 40 Gb/s coherent BPSK-based solutions over low dispersion fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally compare the performance of BPSK-based dual- and single-carrier coherent solutions at 40 Gb/s over low-dispersion fiber. We show that the single-carrier solution is more tolerant to cross-nonlinearities induced by 10 Gb/s neighbors.

articleTitle: Subwavelength semiconductor nanocavity laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the smallest metallo-dielectric cavity semiconductor laser to our knowledge operating at near-infrared frequencies. The laser consists of an InGaAsP patch sandwiched by gold. We observe lasing in electric and magnetic dipole modes.

articleTitle: Normal dispersion, polarization-maintaining Erbium doped fiber for short pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose normal dispersion polarization-maintaining Erbium doped fibers (EDFs) for short pulse amplification reducing nonlinearity and optimizing chromatic dispersion simultaneously. Evaluations of the EDFs in short pulse amplification are shown.

articleTitle: Fully DC-coupled 10Gb/s burst-mode PON prototypes and upstream experiments with 58ns overhead
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a chain of four fully DC-coupled 10Gb/s burst-mode prototypes operating with 58ns overhead for the first time. 10Gb/s upstream burst-mode experiments are performed without a time-critical reset signal from test equipment.

articleTitle: Deployment analysis of TDM/WDM single fiber PON with colourless ONU operating at 2.5 Gbps subcarrier multiplexed downstream and 1.25 Gbps upstream
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A single-fiber full-duplex hybrid TDM/WDM-PON is demonstrated to operate at 2.5/1.25 Gbps rates, with RSOA ONU. It achieves high power budget (GPON compliant) at a distances higher than 20 km, and serves up to 1280 users.

articleTitle: Demonstration of transmission performance in MPLS-TP network using streaming media traffic
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A testbed based on European Cost-239 topology is constructed to demonstrate the transmission performance of MPLS-TP network. By introducing streaming media traffic, two factors are given with numerical results to show their influences on transmission.

articleTitle: Reliable self-healing WDM mesh network structure
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel self-healing WDM mesh network structure is proposed with economic self-healing functionality. Without the need of wavelength conversion or backup fiber links, 77-channels CATV traffic is successfully restored under single or multiple failure-links happened.

articleTitle: Monolithic silicon photonic DWDM receiver for terabit data communications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a high performance DWDM receiver monolithically integrated with AWG and photodetectors array on SOI platform. It is capable of operating at 320 Gbps data rate and its sensitivity is between -16 dBm and -19 dBm.

articleTitle: Accounting for PMD temporal correlation during lightpath set up in GMPLS-controlled optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel impairment-aware lightpath provisioning scheme, which leverages PMD temporal correlation, is proposed for GMPLS-controlled transparent networks. Simulations show that the scheme reduces the blocking probability, thus allowing larger domains of transparency.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 8-channels simultaneous multiplexing using 8-chip electrical codes for 10 Gbit/s ECDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First time 8-channels electrically code division multiplexing technique for optical access networks is demonstrated at a chip-rate of 10 Gchip/s. The technique enables error-free transmission of 1.25 Gbit/s × 8-channels over 20 km single-mode-fiber.

articleTitle: Observation of narrow linewidth beat signal for millimeter wave generation using MZM-based flat comb generator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We showed 100 GHz beat signals and estimated the linewidth of the beat signal. 100 GHz-spaced optical modes were extracted from 12.5 GHz-spaced comb signals. The linewidth was narrower than 1 Hz.

articleTitle: Integrated quantum memory for quantum communication
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first demonstration of a quantum memory protocol in a waveguiding media, which is promising for high-speed, electro-optic control of quantum state evolution during storage, as well as integration into future quantum networks.

articleTitle: Wideband wireless over fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Broadband radio over fiber systems, which can simultaneously distribute multiple wireless services and enable remote sensing, are reviewed. The systems are used to demonstrate improved remote passive RFID tag detection through the use of multiple antennas.

articleTitle: 16-channel × 100-GHz monolithically integrated O-CDMA transmitter with SPECTS encoder and seven 10-GHz mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a fully-integrated O-CDMA transmitter by monolithically integrating 7 colliding-pulse mode-locked lasers with two arrayed waveguide gratings and 16 phase modulators in InP technology.

articleTitle: Error free transmission at 5 Gb/s over 37m of microstructured polymer optical fibre
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 5 Gb/s transmission in a microstructured PMMA fibre at visible wavelengths. The source used in this measurement is generated by sum frequency mixing a CW Nd-YAG laser with a modulated L Band signal.

articleTitle: Export policies for multi-domain WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze the performance of six export policies for a multi-domain routing protocol in WDM networks. We show that providing many AS-disjoint paths for survivability and load-balancing does not necessarily guarantee the lowest connection blocking.

articleTitle: Use of discrete modulation and a continuous wave local oscillator in a 24 km continuous variable quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We implement an experimental continuous variable quantum key distribution system over 24 km of optical fiber that uses discrete signaling and a continuous wave local oscillator. A secure key rate of 3.45 kb/s was achieved.

articleTitle: Using a microcontroller to optimize the bias voltage of balanced photodiodes to minimize even-order distortion in analog fiber-optic links
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Use of a microcontroller-based bias board for balanced photodiodes improves even-order distortion cancellation due to voltage dependent responsivity nonlinearities. The bias board improves the second order intermodulation distortion in balanced photodiodes by 8.3 dB.

articleTitle: Transmission of a 288 Gbit/s Ethernet Superchannel over 124 km un-repeatered field-installed SMF
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the world's first transmission of a 288Gb/s Ethernet Superchannel over 124 km un-repeatered link of field-installed SMF using direct-detected NRZ Coherent WDM with a 2dB OSNR transmission penalty at a FLR of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Converged networks; their pros and cons
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Network convergence that unifies network infrastructures is an ideal architecture as a service platform, but can also have its downsides. This paper describes the pros and cons from technical and commercial perspectives.

articleTitle: Transmission of 3×253-Gb/s OFDM-superchannels over 764 km field deployed single mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
