abstract: We demonstrate transmission of 3×253-Gb/s optical OFDM-superchannels in 100-GHz spacing co-propagating with 112-Gb/s NRZ-QPSK DWDM signals over 764 km field deployed fibers and compare system performance with and without inline DCF modules at the repeater amplifiers.

articleTitle: Impacts of waveband capacity and waveband add/drop ratio on the performance of roadm-ring connecting hierarchical optical path cross-connects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze the performance of a multiple-ROADM-ring connected network that utilizes Hierarchical Optical Cross-Connects (HOXC). We clarify the impacts of the waveband capacity and waveband add/drop ratio at the HOXC node on the node performance and switch scale.

articleTitle: An application-oriented hierarchical quantum cryptography network test bed
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A hierarchical metropolitan quantum cryptography network upon the inner-city commercial telecom fiber cables is reported in this paper. The techniques of the quantum router, optical switch and trusted relay are assembled here to divide the seven-user network into a four-node backbone net, a two-user subnet and a single-fiber access link. Secure keys distributed in this network can be utilized to encrypt the instant video, sound, text messages and confidential files transmitting between nodes. The whole implementation including the hierarchical quantum cryptographic communication links and the corresponding application software shows a big step toward the practical user-oriented network with a high security level.

articleTitle: Fabrication of a highly nonlinear tellurite complex microstructure fiber for supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A dispersion controlled highly nonlinear tellurite complex microstructure fiber whose chromatic dispersion is flatter than that of the previous ones is realized. Broad supercontinuum generation was demonstrated under the several hundred pJ femtosecond pulse pumping.

articleTitle: Simultaneous ER enhancement and frequency stabilization scheme for directly modulated DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simultaneous extinction-ratio enhancement and frequency stabilization scheme is proposed for directly modulated DFB lasers at the optical line terminal to enhance signal quality and to stabilize optical frequency by using a single Fabry-Perot etalon.

articleTitle: Single-mode photonic crystal fiber with low bending loss and Aeff of > 200 μm2 for ultra high-speed WDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose photonic crystal fiber with W-shaped effective index profile to achieve the largest A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> for telecommunication use. We realized a 220-μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> with a cut-off wavelength and bending loss compatible with ITU-T recommendation G.655.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the need for carrier Ethernet in mission critical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Comparison of circuit and packet-switched networks in handling delay-sensitive data reveals that the primary causes of latency are different in these two networks, and both can be mitigated by using Carrier Ethernet in Mission-Critical Networks.

articleTitle: Performance of microwave-photonic links
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Progress in high-performance microwave-photonic links is reviewed. Although recent research has explored a wide variety of techniques, none has provided a spur-free dynamic range approaching what may be achievable ultimately (~180 dB·Hz). Future directions are considered.

articleTitle: High-linearity modified uni-traveling carrier photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report novel InGaAs/InP modified uni-traveling carrier photodiodes with record linearity. At low frequencies the third-order output intercept point (OIP3) is 55 dBm and remains as high as 47.5 dBm at 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Actively doped solid core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Solid photonic bandgap fibers offer distributed spectral filtering with extraordinarily high suppression. This opens new possibilities of artificially tailoring the gain spectrum of fibers. We present record-performance of such fibers and outline their future applications.

articleTitle: Reference MPO connectors with Pre-angled MT ferrules and measurements of fiber core position
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes the single mode 12-fiber reference MPO connector with insertion loss of no more than 0.15dB and core eccentricity of no more than 0.45μm.

articleTitle: An ASE-injected FP-LD-based return-to-zero transmitter for long-reach WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple RZ transmitter based on incoherent-light-injected FP-LD which improves the dispersion tolerance by a factor of 1.5. Thanks to wide timing margin between adjacent bits, we successfully transmit incoherent 1.25-Gb/s signals over 45 km of SSMF.

articleTitle: High-performance photonic integrated circuits (PICs)
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This tutorial presents a collection of slides and concludes that: (1) Active InP-based photonic ICs can be created with size, weight, power and system performance metrics superior to discrete solutions in many situations. However, cost can only be less if the market size is sufficient. (2) Close integration of control/feedback electronics will be desirable in many future PIC applications. (3) Coherent approaches will be greatly enabled by the use of photonic integration, and numerous sensor applications may be enabled in addition to higher-spectral-efficiency communications.

articleTitle: 7.34-μs continuously tunable parametric delay
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A wavelength-transparent, continuously-tunable 7.34-μs all-optical delay is demonstrated for 10-Gb/s NRZ signal by cascading discrete and continuous stages. 3.7- to 4.3-dB penalty is reported for the entire system that includes four successive silicon-based parametric processes.

articleTitle: Verizon's fiber-to-the-premises and lessons learned
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper covers examples of lessons learned during the five years of Verizon's FiOS and the need to continually be evolving in product and service offering to meet customer's needs.

articleTitle: Compact, low power and low threshold electrically pumped micro disc lasers for 20Gb/s non return to zero all optical wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a 7.5μm wide InP Micro-Disc-Laser, with a very low ∼100μA threshold current, heterogeneously integrated on top of Silicon on Insulator substrate, all optical NRZ wavelength conversion at speeds up to 20Gb/s is demonstrated

articleTitle: Limitations for applying standard 10G Ethernet sequence order-set in G.709 core transport network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Current lab assessment shows standard 10 G Ethernet link fault sequence ordered-set works as expected between two direct attached clients. This paper evaluates the limitations applying the same ordered-set by inserting transport network between these clients.

articleTitle: 20-μm-pitch eight-channel monolithic fiber array coupling 160 Gb/s/channel to silicon nanophotonic chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A multichannel tapered coupler interfacing standard 250-μm-pitch low-NA polarization-maintaining fiber arrays with ultra-dense 20-μm-pitch high-NA silicon waveguides is designed, fabricated, and tested, demonstrating coupling losses below 1 dB and injection bandwidths of 160 Gb/s/channel.

articleTitle: Influence of Rayleigh backscattering on the performance of NOLM-based phase-preserving amplitude limiters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Design and fiber optimization in NOLM-type regenerators allow for a substantial decrease in excess noise originating from Rayleigh backscattering. Cascaded operation of up to 20 phase-preserving limiters in a DPSK transmission system is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of high-speed signaling for protection under multiple-priority-class traffic in WDM ring networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated the world's first high-speed signaling method for protection under multiple-priority-class traffic in WDM ring networks. This method is effective for actual WDM ring networks deploying ROADM node.

articleTitle: An ultra low power CMOS photonics technology platform for H/S optoelectronic transceivers at less than $1 per Gbps
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a CMOS Optoelectronic technology platform, using a 650 mW 4×10-Gb/s 0.13 ¿m silicon-on-insulator integrated transceiver chip, co-packaged with an externally modulated laser, to enable high density data interconnects at <$1 per Gbps.

articleTitle: High frequency photonic analog-to-digital conversion using nonuniform sampling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss recently developed techniques for photonic analog-to-digital conversion based on nonuniform sampling. We have experimentally validated this approach, demonstrating high resolution, alias-free signal reconstruction at carrier frequencies up to 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Performance of modified decision-directed polarization control/demultiplex algorithm in coherent QAM receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A modified decision-directed polarization control and demultiplex algorithm for coherent receivers is evaluated for QAM schemes up to order 256, and compared against the constant-modulus algorithm adapted for QAM and differential phase compensation.

articleTitle: Efficient routing in heterogeneous core DWDM networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We design a cost efficient routing algorithm and prototype a network planning tool to cost-effectively provision high-speed connections over a large carrier's heterogeneous core DWDM network with multi-vendor sub-networks.

articleTitle: Harmonic distortion in slow light SOA based microwave photonic phase shifters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a theoretical and experimental evaluation of any general order harmonic distortion in a SFL phase shifter based on CPO in a SOA and propose different optical filtering implementations for distortion-free design.

articleTitle: Point-to-Multipoint VLAN path signaling demonstration on the GMPLS controlled Ethernet test network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper provides the demonstration of GMPLS controlled Point-to-Multipoint Ethernet path establishment. The prototype RSVP-TE is extended for supporting peer and overlay model networks. Detailed RSVP-TE signaling mechanisms, experimental results are discussed.

articleTitle: Survivable mapping with maximal physical-layer failure-localization potential in IP over transparent optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Physical-layer failure-localization potential is explored in finding the survivable mapped lightpaths of IP over transparent optical networks. Numerical results show that accurate or near-accurate failure localizations are achieved with the new survivable mapping design.

articleTitle: OTDM to WDM format conversion based on cascaded SHG/DFG in a single PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate error-free OTDM to WDM format conversion based on cSHG/DFG within a 30 mm-long PPLN waveguide and a time-to-frequency domain conversion approach, which relies upon switching a linearly chirped pulse.

articleTitle: Transmission of 44-Gb/s coherent optical OFDM signal with trellis-coded 32-QAM subcarrier modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the transmission of a spectrally-efficient 44-Gb/s CO-OFDM signal whose subcarriers are trellis-coded with 32-QAM over a 990-km dispersion-managed SSMF link, and show the performance improvements obtained through the coded-modulation and self-phase-modulation compensation.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of a novel service provisioning mechanism for future optical internet infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A detailed performance and trade-off analysis of a novel optical service plane architecture which is either integrated with the infrastructure provider entity or exists as a separate entity is presented and evaluated.

articleTitle: Security of quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution offers the promise of secure communication at unprecedented security level. Secure systems can be implemented by standard optical communication components - if done right. We report on the divide of right and wrong.

articleTitle: Digital video bandwidth requirements for large flat-panel televisions
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Consumer expectations for high quality high-definition programming will place greater demand on access networks as flat-panel display sizes increase. Herein, we investigate the bandwidth requirement to deliver high quality HD viewing experience for larger displays.

articleTitle: A “linear” high-contrast gratings hollow-core waveguide and its system level performance
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The high-contrast gratings assisted hollow-core waveguide demonstrates an ultra-low nonlinearity (<6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup> /W/m). Digital and analog system-level simulations further show that the waveguide does not introduce any observable nonlinearity-induced penalty.

articleTitle: Towards silicon on insulator DQPSK demodulators
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fabrication of integrated DQPSK demodulators is a challenge due to low birefringence requirements. We present work on demodulator structures realized in intermediate SOI technology. The work paves the way for silicon based DQPSK demodulators.

articleTitle: Optimization and comparison of the transmission performance of RSOA/SOA intensity-modulated optical OFDM signals for WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For optical OFDM IMDD systems, optimum operating conditions of RSOA/SOA intensity modulators are identified, under which similar performances are obtained for different modulators. Under low-cost component-enabled conditions, RSOA modulators with high rear-facet reflectivity are preferred.

articleTitle: Optical phase conjugation in chalcogenide planar waveguides for compensating signal transmission effects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report optical phase conjugation of wavelength multiplexed signals using a chalcogenide planar waveguide inserted along a transmission link. Distortion compensation of 3×40 Gb/s RZ-DPSK signals propagating through 225 km of standard single mode fiber is achieved.

articleTitle: Nano-engineered optical fibers and applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reviews a technology for making nano-engineered optical fibers. Key features and advantages of nano-enginneered glass fibers are discussed. Fiber designs and their applications are presented.

articleTitle: 100GbE optical transport, appropriate modulation formats, and impact on deployed transport networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the system requirements for 100 GbE optical transport and compare possible technical solutions. Our experience, derived from modeling, laboratory experiments and field trials on deployed transport networks is presented.

articleTitle: Experimental study on broadband nonlinear phase wandering in coherent detection long-haul transmissions
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate fast phase wandering observed in coherent detection long-haul transmission experiments. We demonstrate the phase wandering is a broadband nonlinear effect. We compare its impact on different coherent modulation and detection schemes.

articleTitle: Highly efficient columnar-quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier in high temperature condition
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A less temperature dependent columnar-quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier (CQD-SOA) with high efficiency is developed. At 50°C, a high penalty-free output power of ~12 dBm together with a high gain of 17 dB is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: OSNR monitoring technique for PDM-QPSK signals based on asynchronous delay-tap sampling technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new technique for monitoring the individual OSNR of each polarization tributary of PDM-QPSK signals. The results show that the performance of this technique is not sensitive to PMD and PDL.

articleTitle: A broadband ultra-low loss all-solid photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the fabrication and characteristic of an all-solid photonic bandgap fiber with loss as low as 0.41 dB/km at 1550 nm within the first-order bandgap. The control of bandgaps, dispersion and bend characteristic has been investigated.

articleTitle: Investigation of spectral efficient modulation formats for 400Gbit/s/port optical packet switched system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the performance of NRZ-OOK, NRZ-DPSK, NRZ-DQPSK, NRZ-8 PSK and NRZ- 16-QAM modulation and their influence to an optical packet switched systems (OPS) performance. The aim was to demonstrate that OPS systems can be spectrally efficient.

articleTitle: In-service chromatic dispersion and pass-band shape measurements for light path with modulated ASE source
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A tunable modulated broadband source and narrow-bandwidth filter are used to measure chromatic dispersion, group-delay ripple, and pass-band shape of DWDM-network light paths. This new method is simple and suitable for in-service measurements.

articleTitle: 10 channel, 45.6Gb/s per channel, polarization multiplexed DQPSK InP receiver photonic integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 10 wavelength, monolithically integrated, polarization multiplexed, InP DQPSK receiver operating at 45.6 Gbit/s per wavelength.

articleTitle: Security enhanced SPECTS O-CDMA with four-state encoded data modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a security enhancement mechanism based on four-state temporal optical coding which protects a SPECTS O-CDMA upstream link against eavesdropping including DPSK detection. The FPGA-based code-hopping implementation facilitates future encryption by optical codes.

articleTitle: Impact of crosstalk in capacity performance of WDM/OCDMA system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The capacity of WDM/OCDMA system is analyzed under time-wavelength domain crosstalk to determine the simultaneous capacity threshold. The system's crosstalk, channel spacing and datarate are optimized to have a teletraffic capacity equal to nominal capacity.

articleTitle: Recent progress on OTDM Terabit/s transmission and their future
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent advances toward 1 Tbit/s/ch transmission over long distances were overviewed. 1) Ultrahigh-speed transmission at 640 Gsymbol/s per polarization (640 Gbit/s DPSK or 1.28-2.56 Tbit/s DQPSK) have been demonstrated. 2) Subpicosecond pulse transmission over long distances, however, suffers from serious transmission impairments caused by long-term PMD variation and higher-order PMD. 3) Signal processing such as time-domain OFT technique and bandwidth reduction by employing multi-level RZ-QAM are expected to overcome such limitations and realize Tbit/s transmission over 500-1000 km. 4) All-optical and OTDM technologies are expected to contribute not only to ultrahigh-speed data transmission but also to network flexibility and low power consumption.

articleTitle: Characterization of distortionless analog signal multicasting by parametric mixer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present characterization of a two-pump parametric device for analog linear multicasting. Linearity of parametric multicasting is assessed from highly linearized input seed by two-tone intermodulation measurements. Experimental results confirm distortionless behavior of four-photon mixers.

articleTitle: Phase to intensity modulation conversion by third-order dispersion and its effect on group velocity dispersion measurement using phase-modulated CW light
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that phase to intensity modulation conversion induced by third-order dispersion doubles the modulation frequency, and therefore, the third-order dispersion does not affect group velocity dispersion measurement using phase-modulated light.

articleTitle: A scalable optical packet switch with label processing for DPSK and OFDM data packets
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a scalable and low latency optical packet switch for DPSK and OFDM packets. Results show error-free operation of 1 × 64 optical packet switch for 12 × 10 Gb/s DPSK packets and 12 × 40 Gb/s OFDM packet.

articleTitle: Electronic pre-distortion operating at 1 sample/symbol with accurate bias control for CD compensation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Electronic pre-distortion operating at 1 Sa/sym with anti-aliasing filter and accurate bias control is proposed. This approach guarantees Q penalty within 0.7 dB for 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK coherent system with dispersion up to 25,000 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Improved aggregated impairment information for bi-directional lightpath establishments
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a set of physical parameters for GMPLS signaling to establish bi-directional paths. This reduces the amount of flooded information and speeds-up the path establishment while keeping its risk of unfeasibility lower than 2%.

articleTitle: En route to grouping-constraint free, colorless directionless ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: WSS-based ROADM architecture limits local transponder wavelengths to a grouping constraint. 3D-switch-based architecture offers powerful solution without grouping constraint. This paper presents an updated performance and cost analysis comparing WSS-based and 3D-switch-based ROADM architectures.

articleTitle: Demonstration of world-first 112 Gbit/s 1310 nm LAN-WDM optical transceiver for 100GbE and 100GbE over OTN applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First 4 × 28.0 Gbit/s WDM optical transceiver was developed. Experimental results show the distinguished transceiver achieves high performance that it complies with ITU-T G 959.1 and IEEE 802.3ba to support larger capacity of data traffic.

articleTitle: Broad convergence of 32QAM-OFDM ROF and WDM-OFDM-PON system using an integrated modulator for bidirectional access networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel architecture of converged 32QAM-OFDM ROF and WDM-OFDM-PON by employing an integrated modulator. The 10Gb/s 16QAM-OFDM wired signal, 1Gb/s 32QAM-OFDM wireless signal and upstream signal are transmitted 25km fiber successfully.

articleTitle: Optical network technologies for datacenter networks (invited paper)
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the optical communication technologies required to support data center operations and warehouse-scale computing.

articleTitle: Probabilistic-based approach for fast impairments-aware RWA in all-optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We devised a probabilistic model to compute the number of used wavelengths in every link of a transparent optical network. Based on this model, a novel approach for impairments-aware RWA algorithm is proposed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Low loss heat resistant fluorinated polymer optical waveguides for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Multimode optical waveguides using low loss heat resistant fluoropolymer were demonstrated. We fabricated 10 cm-long film optical waveguides and measured insertion loss, tolerance, and heat resistant. These results showed good performance at 1310 nm.

articleTitle: Optimum mechanical splice conditions for fiber with hole-assisted structure
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The mechanical splice characteristics of a hole-assisted fiber (HAF) are investigated both numerically and experimentally. We successfully derived the optimum mechanical splice conditions, which can be universally utilized for HAF with arbitrary structural parameters.

articleTitle: Silicon quantum well light-emitter for optical interconnections
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed all-silicon based light-emitter for optical interconnections. The relatively short florescent lifetime of 4.2 ns in a silicon quantum well makes direct modulations at 10 Mbps accessible for low-end high-volume consumer applications.

articleTitle: First demonstration of 80-km long-haul transmission of 12.5-Gb/s data using silicon microring resonator electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First demonstration of long-haul transmission reaching bandwidth-distance product of 1-Tb-km/s, using silicon microring resonator electro-optic modulator, sets new precedence for silicon photonic applications. 12.5-Gb/s bit-error-rate and power penalty measurements confirm 80-km of feasible fiber propagation.

articleTitle: Polychromatic sampling for high-speed real-time processing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent advances in polychromatic sampling are reviewed in context of the multicast parametric synchronous sampling architecture of waveforms and real-time processing of high bitrate signals. Operation principle and latest results of polychromatic sampling are presented.

articleTitle: High power reliability for plug style optical attenuators
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High power damage threshold test and thermal simulation for plug-style optical attenuator were carried out. The degradation mode and its mechanism were clarified. The limit in high power level for assuring long-term reliability was confirmed.

articleTitle: A self wavelength tracking method for a cost effective WDM-PON with tunable lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a self wavelength tracking method for tunable lasers in a WDM-PON. By measuring the back-scattered power by a feeder fiber, we identified and tracked the allocated wavelength of the tunable laser.

articleTitle: Adaptive self-reconfigurable network to create cost-effective bandwidth-on-demand services
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel path-provisioning algorithm that can cost-effectively create bandwidth-on-demand services. Its use of the `make before break' rerouting technique reduces blocking probability while preventing service disruption.

articleTitle: Fiber nonlinearity mitigation in 428-Gb/s multiband coherent optical OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose DFT-spread (DFT-S) OFDM within each sub-band of multiband-CO-OFDM to mitigate fiber nonlinearity. For 1000-km standard-single-mode-fiber transmission at 420-Gb/s, 32-band DFT-S CO-OFDM outperforms conventional CO-OFDM and coherent single-carrier by 1.1 and 0.8 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Optical wavelength multicasting based on four wave mixing in highly nonlinear fiber with reduced polarization sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using three co-polarized probes and a pump modulated signal, seven multicasting channels with 100-GHz spacing are demonstrated. The conversion efficiency fluctuation due to polarization sensitivity is reduced from more than 20 dB to 5 dB.

articleTitle: Recent progress in tellurite fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We shows new potential of tellurite fibers with high nonlinearity as optical signal processing and coherent light generation media by demonstrating applications of stimulated Raman and Brillouin scattering and supercontinuum generation.

articleTitle: 1.28 Tb/s wavelength conversion for polarisation multiplexed RZ-DPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical wavelength conversion for single wavelength channel 1.28-Tb/s polarisation multiplexed RZ-DPSK signals was demonstrated using a 100-m polarisation-maintaining highly nonlinear fibre (PM-HNLF). Error free performance for the converted signal was achieved.

articleTitle: Analyzing return loss deterioration of optical fiber joints with various air-filled gaps over wide wavelength range
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigated the return loss of optical fiber joints with various air-filled gaps. We discovered that the return loss might deteriorate to 8.6 dB for one connector and 5.9 dB for four-connected connectors at worst.

articleTitle: New propagation mode of fiber fuse with a long-period damage track in hole-assisted fiber (HAF)
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We observed a new fiber fuse propagation mode in HAF with an approximately 30 times larger period than that in SMF. We made the first observation of a new fiber fuse threshold power (upper threshold).

articleTitle: 10GHz all-optical gate on a silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a fast all-optical gate with a 5μm radius InP disk heterogeneously integrated on to a SOI waveguide circuit. Rise time and fall time together are 50ps.

articleTitle: High dynamic-range microwave photonic links using maximally linear FIR optical filters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a microwave photonic link in which maximally linear FIR optical filters discriminate frequency modulation. Using a tenth-order filter, one can achieve a 127 dBm/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup> SFDR with 1 mW of received optical power.

articleTitle: Low bending sensitivity of regular OM3/OM4 fibers in 10GbE applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Regular graded-index multi-mode fibers exhibit low bend losses under 10GBASE-S sources launches. Improved process control of the inner part of the graded-core of OM3/OM4 fibers saves margins in 10GbE systems submitted to bends.

articleTitle: Tunable and variable clock generation up to 1.2 THz by filtering an actively mode-locked 42.5 GHz quantum dash fabry-perot laser with a reconfigurable filter
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the generation of an optical clock up to 1.2 THz using a Quantum Dash mode-locked laser and a spectral filter, selecting two or three lines, which are separated by the desired spacing.

articleTitle: Measurement of mean fiber DGD using asynchronous delay-tap sampling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate measurement of mean fiber DGD using asynchronous delay-tap sampling in a 10 Gbit/s WDM test-bed. With and without polarization scrambling, mean DGD values of 30.5 ps and 26.2 ps were measured on 31 ps all-order PMD fiber.

articleTitle: The fastest response burst-mode transmission scheme using small redundant scrambler and AC-coupled receiver with fast baseline response
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The fastest 10-nsec response with 21.5-dBm dynamic-range burst-mode transmission for 10G-PONs without any reset scheme is demonstrated using newly proposed small redundant scrambler and low-cost AC-coupled receiver. Efficient bandwidth is improved to 97% for 512-ONUs.

articleTitle: Multi-Gbps ASK and QPSK-modulated 60 GHz RoF link using an optically injection locked VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 60 GHz RoF transmitter employing an optically injection locked VCSEL is demonstrated for the first time. Multi-Gbps ASK and QPSK at 60 GHz after 20 km fiber and 3 m wireless transmission is shown.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of end-to-end GMPLS-enabled restoration in multi-domain transparent WSON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Two GMPLS restoration strategies operating at wavelength and link granularities are experimentally validated in a multi-domain WSON. The strategies are qualitatively compared in terms of resource usage, restorability and restoration time.

articleTitle: Compact, high-speed hybrid silicon microring lasers for computer interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate scaling of compact, low-threshold hybrid silicon microring lasers to meet the criteria of low power consumption, high-speed modulation and operation in elevated temperature for optical interconnect applications.

articleTitle: Equalization of first and second order PMD in 100 GBit/s PolMux transmission using optical butterfly FIR filters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: PolMux increases PMD sensitivity compared to single polarization transmission. We investigate the equalization of first and second order PMD in the optical domain and determine the respective remaining penalties induced by DGD, PCD and DEP.

articleTitle: 166 Gb/s PDM-NRZ-DPSK modulation using thin-LiNb03-substrate modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The modulation of a 166-Gb/s PDM-NRZ-DPSK signal is demonstrated using a thin-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-substrate modulator. The use of a 0.1-mm-thick substrate and a ridge-type waveguide improves the optical response and brings about a reduction in Vπ.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband radio-over-fiber techniques and networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper summarizes the motivations and results obtained regarding the optical distribution of a 60 GHz radio signal throughout buildings to provide users with Ultra-Broad-Band Wireless Home Area Network with datarates >1Gbps and continuous coverage.

articleTitle: Gain clamping in a fiber optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have experimentally shown that gain clamping is required in fiber optical parametric amplifiers. By using optical gain clamping (OGC), we have reduced gain variation to 1 dB, for signal input variation of 12 dB.

articleTitle: Improvement of phase noise compensation for coherent optical OFDM via data-aided phase equalizer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a novel data-aided phase equalizer for coherent optical OFDM systems with RF-pilot enabled phase noise compensation. Simulation results corroborate the superior performance for different RF-pilot to signal power ratios.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband, low-power, 2×2 electro-optic switch using sub-micron silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a broadband Mach-Zehnder electro-optic switch capable of simultaneously routing multiple channels within 110-nm optical bandwidth with only 3.1-mW power consumption and a 4-ns switching time. Switching bandwidth is maintained over 30°C temperature variation.

articleTitle: Distributed characterization of bending-induced birefringence in spun fibers by means of P-OFDR
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report, for the first time, spatially-resolved measurements of bending- induced birefringence in ad hoc drawn single-mode spun fibers. The combined effect of spin rotation and bending birefringence is clearly highlighted.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s complete ETDM system based on monolithically integrated transmitter and receiver modules
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A complete ETDM system based on monolithically integrated transmitter and receiver modules was demonstrated with BER performance below FEC threshold up to 107 Gb/s. ETDM signal at 112 Gb/s with clear eye opening was also observed.

articleTitle: Phase-incoherent DPSK regeneration using a fiber-sagnac interferometer
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for the first time phase-incoherent regeneration of DPSK signals based on fiber-Sagnac interferometer. Power penalty improvement of phase-, amplitude- and ASE-noise loaded signals up to 3 dB is reported at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Scalability of optical intermodule interconnects for switches and routers comprising 100 Gb/s line cards
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyzed scalability limitations of various optical interconnection solutions for rack-to-rack applications with respect to required number of interconnecting fibres and power consumption.

articleTitle: Reduction of fast SOP changes in DSCMs under influence of shock and vibrations
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fast SOP changes in fiber-based dispersion slope compensating modules (DSCMs) due to mechanical impact are effectively suppressed by introducing a simple passive vibration-suppression scheme consisting of shock mounts isolating the DSCM spool from the housing.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s photonic crystal fiber transmissions with 1.1 μm directly-modulated single-mode VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 10-Gbit/s transmission over a 5-km photonic crystal fiber in the 1.1 μm band using a directly-modulated single-mode VCSEL. The transmission distance was extended to 14 km by using an ytterbium-doped fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Optimal traffic grooming and regenerator placement in WDM optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We consider traffic grooming and regenerator placement in an optical network in which lightpaths are hop-constrained by impairments. Combining grooming with regenerator placement reduces costs compared to addressing traffic grooming and regenerator placement separately.

articleTitle: M-PSK versatile modulation using a single-electrode straight-line phase modulator and digital signal processing for ISI-suppression
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: BPSK, QPSK, and 8-PSK modulation/demodulation was experimentally demonstrated using only a single-electrode straight-line phase modulator for the first time. ISI caused by the modulation was compensated by pre-equalization based on digital signal processing, achieving BER<10-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>.

articleTitle: Transmission of 42.8-Gb/s polarization multiplexed RZ-QPSK DWDM signals over 3900 km with 12.5-GHz channel spacing and coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated 42.8 Gb/s DWDM transmission over 3900 km SMF-28 with 12.5-GHz channel spacing and coherent detection. Eight polarization-multiplexed-RZ-QPSK signals have been successfully transmitted over 3000 and 3900-km SMF-28 with BER< 8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> and 2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, repetitively.

articleTitle: Waveguide-integrated Ge/Si avalanche photodetector with 105GHz gain-bandwidth product
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a waveguide-integrated avalanche photodetector using Group-IV heterostructure materials. Such device achieved a responsivity of ~0.8 A/W at unity gain and an impressive gain-bandwidth product of ~105 GHz at 1550 nm photon wavelength.

articleTitle: Demonstration of polarization insensitive wavelength conversion of 112-Gb/s polarization multiplexed RZ-QPSK signals using bismuth-oxide-based nonlinear optical fiber with high SBS threshold
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarization insensitive wavelength conversion by employing a dual pump scheme in 112-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZ-QPSK system has been realized by using a 2-m Bismuth-Oxide-based nonlinear optical fiber (Bi-NLF) with high SBS threshold.

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring of the modal content of monolithic large-mode-area fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A method for the real-time monitoring of the modal content of a monolithic LMA fiber laser is reported for the first time. It allows for the direct observation of the dynamics of transversal mode competition.

articleTitle: Demonstration of end-to-end bit-parallel memory transactions across the ultra-low latency data vortex optical packet switch
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate end-to-end memory transactions between a processor and memory node across the data vortex optical packet switch. Successful read and write transactions via the network at 4 × 2.5 Gb/s are verified.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength conversion of 56 Gbit/s NRZ-DQPSK signals in silicon-organic hybrid strip waveguides
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical wavelength conversion of 56 Gbit/s NRZ-DQPSK based on four-wave mixing is demonstrated in a silicon-organic hybrid strip waveguide operated in TM mode.

articleTitle: Method for measuring conversion gain response and O/E bandwidth of integrated D(Q)PSK receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A method for recovering the O/E frequency response of D(Q)PSK receivers with integrated delay-line interferometers (DLIs) is presented. Modulator chirp is canceled by measuring at specific DLI phases, making the approach robust and versatile.

articleTitle: Long-haul coherent QPSK transmission of 40G channels with 120% spectral efficiency using increased linearity dispersion map with 100km spans and EDFAs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study transmission of 40 Gb/s signals using coherent RZ-QPSK with and without polarization multiplexing using 100 km large effective area fiber-spans and dual-stage EDFAs with mid-stage dispersion compensation. We show advantage and disadvantage of coherent detection schemes.

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s tunable all-optical phase-transparent wavelength conversion through cascaded SFG-DFG in a linear-chirped PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 160-Gb/s tunable and phase-transparent wavelength conversion using cSFG-DFG in a linear-chirped PPLN. Thanks to the enhanced conversion bandwidth, no any optical equalizer was required to compensate the spectrum distortion.

articleTitle: Comparison of static and dynamic WDM networks in terms of energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The benefit of migrating from static to dynamic WDM networks is evaluated, for the first time, in terms of energy consumption. Results show a clear benefit of dynamic operation for traffic loads < 0.5.

articleTitle: Simple suppression technique for higher-order mode amplification in bent large mode area triple-cladding fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel technique to suppress the higher-order mode in bent LMA triple-cladding fibers is proposed. It is shown that the higher-order mode can be coupled to a cladding mode with only an adjustment of the bending diameter.

articleTitle: World's first XG-PON field trial
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes the world's first field trial of XG-PON, which can deliver 10 Gbps downstream and 2.5 Gbps upstream to residential or business customers, and confirmed XG-PON's co-existence with a commercially deployed G-PON system.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable functionalities of coupled-cavity VCSELs using digital modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The coupled-cavity VCSEL under digital modulation can be configured to perform different functionalities for data communications. 10 Gb/s pulse amplitude modulation up to 4 levels, and 34 ps optical pulse generation are demonstrated in this work.

articleTitle: Improvement of chromatic dispersion and differential group delay tolerance of incoherent multilevel signaling with receiver-side digital signal processing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Chromatic dispersion and differential group delay tolerance of 30-Gbit/s 8DPSK and 8QAM signaling is investigated experimentally, and we show 1.7 and 1.25 times enhancement of them in 8QAM signaling by simple receiver-side digital signal processing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of hybrid optical ring network combining Multi-Wavelength OPS and OCS
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We design a hybrid optical add/drop node combining Multi-Wavelength Optical Packet and Optical Switching for Metro-Area Ring Networks. The feasibility of hybrid switching has been confirmed at a 120 Gb/s network testbed.

articleTitle: First demonstration of bidirectional Gigabit transmission over a single step-index plastic optical fibre
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a Gigabit Ethernet bidirectional transmission over a single POF. The solution is attractive for very low cost consumer electronic short-distance cabling at high data rate requiring extremely simple installation.

articleTitle: Bi-doped fiber lasers and amplifiers for a wavelength range of 1300-1500 nm
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Bi-doped fibers are a promising medium for lasers and amplifiers in the 1150-1600 nm wavelength range. We present the results on the development of Bi-doped fiber lasers and amplifiers for telecom window of 1300-1500 nm in particular.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s bi-directional symmetric WDM-PON system based on POLMUX technique with polarization insensitive ONU
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated 10Gb/s bi-directional symmetric transmission based on polarization-division multiplexing with a centralized light source. One of two orthogonal polarization states carries downstream data while the other un-modulated state is used for upstream modulation.

articleTitle: FWM-based flexible wavelength conversion in whole C-band using realistic HNLF having dispersion slope
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Flexible conversion from an arbitrary wavelength to desired wavelength in whole C-band is studied and demonstrated within 1.7 dB efficiency variation among all conversion pairs using HNLF having dispersion slope of +0.02 ps/nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/km and ¿ of 30/W/km.

articleTitle: Spectral-efficient OOFDM system using compatible SSB modulation with a simple dual-electrode MZM
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A direct-detection OOFDM transmission is experimentally demonstrated which does not need a guard-band between the carrier and the OFDM sideband. The compatible-SSB modulation is realized through a single dual-electrode MZM.

articleTitle: Enhanced crankback signaling in multi-domain optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel solution is proposed for joint intra/inter-domain signaling crankback for multidomain DWDM lightpath setup. The scheme leverages existing intra/inter-domain routing protocol state and provides mechanisms to track signaling failures and limit setup overheads and delays.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive wavelength multicasting of RZ-DPSK signal based on four-wave mixing in a photonic crystal fiber with residual birefringence
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate polarization-insensitive wavelength multicasting of RZ-DPSK signal. The input signal is copied to four different wavelengths using four-wave mixing with unequally spaced pumps in a dispersion-flattened, highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber with residual birefringence.

articleTitle: Electro-optical synchronization system with femtosecond precision
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel system for the RF synchronization is presented. It makes use of standard, commercially-available telecommunication optical components. The added timing jitter of 5 fs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RMS</sub> has been measured on the first experimental tests.

articleTitle: Generating 20 GHz and 40 GHz pulse trains from a 10 GHz mode-locked laser using a tunable planar lightwave circuit and nonlinear wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of 20 GHz and 40 GHz pulse trains using a tunable planar lightwave circuit (PLC) and nonlinear wavelength conversion. The PLC is a 6-stage lattice-form Mach-Zehnder interferometer fabricated in silica-on-silicon technology.

articleTitle: Fully-etched photonic crystal grating coupler as an interface between single-mode fibers and photonic circuits on silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A fully-etched photonic crystal grating coupler with low back reflections is introduced as an interface between single-mode fibers and silicon-on-insulator wire waveguides. Peak coupling efficiency of 27% and 1-dB bandwidth of 34 nm is achieved.

articleTitle: Resolution-enhanced ultrafast ADC using optical multi-period transfer functions of NOLMs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a resolution enhancement scheme using optical input/output multi-period transfer functions of NOLMs for ultrafast low-resolution ADCs. This scheme can provide a resolution of 8.8 ENOB by combining 8-period transfer functions and 5-bit ADCs.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characteristics of ultra-broadband singlemode Cr-doped fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The fabrication of ultra-broadband singlemode Cr-doped fibers (SMCDFs) using fiber drawing-tower method is demonstrated for the first time. The success in fabrication of SMCDFs may open the possibility for utilizing SMCDFs as ultra-broadband fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Coherent demodulation of 10-Gb/s optical minimum-shift keying
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a digital coherent detection scheme for demodulation of optical MSK signal. A 10-Gb/s MSK signal synthesized by using a quad Mach-Zehnder in-phase/quadrature modulator was experimentally demodulated by the detection scheme.

articleTitle: Enabling passive interfaces for integrated optical and wireless access networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose passive interfaces for integrated optical-wireless access networks incorporating optical-tandem-single-sideband (OTSSB) modulation scheme. The performance of the interfaces is evaluated experimentally with OTSSB and VCSEL for simultaneous transport of wired and wireless signals.

articleTitle: Novel thermal drift suppression method in channel switching of mode-hop-free tunable laser array
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A switching time of less than 40 μs has been achieved for a TDA-DFB laser array with a thermal drift suppression technique using the tuning regions of non-lasing lasers as heaters for temperature compensation.

articleTitle: CMOS-integrated low-noise germanium waveguide avalanche photodetector operating at 40Gbps
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Germanium waveguide avalanche photodiode with 10dB gain and excess noise factor with k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> below 0.2 was demonstrated. Gain-bandwidth-product above 350GHz was achieved at voltages around 3V. The avalanche photodetector was monolithically integrated into front-end CMOS.

articleTitle: Optical access solutions beyond 10G-EPON/XG-PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper discusses WDM-based optical access networks beyond 10G-EPON and XG-PON. It describes drivers and requirements. Challenges as well as possible solutions are outlined.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers (SOAs) may be designed as linear or nonlinear network elements. We report on recent results that indicate advantageous characteristics for QD SOAs as linear and bulk SOA as nonlinear network elements.

articleTitle: Efficient digital backpropagation for PDM-CO-OFDM optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated experimentally that computationally-efficient digital nonlinearity compensation using backpropagation can increase the nonlinear tolerance of 61.7 Gb/s PDM-CO-OFDM by 2.2 dB in a 500 km link using only 3 backpropagation steps.

articleTitle: Using wavelength splitting at the remote node to mitigate Rayleigh backscattering for optical wired and wireless access networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an optical wired and wireless access network using wavelength-splitting (WS) at remote-node. A pair of CW carriers is generated from each laser source for wired and wireless applications respectively for effective Rayleigh-backscattering mitigation.

articleTitle: Low-power, polarization tracked 45.6 GB/s per wavelength PM-DQPSK receiver in a 10-channel integrated module
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce an architecture for low-power (<0.05 W/Gb/s) demodulation of PM-DQPSK signals at 45.6 GB/s, and demonstrate an integrated package combining custom 10-channel PLC, photodiode array, and ASIC, capable of real-time polarization tracking.

articleTitle: Colourless real-time optical OFDM end-to-end transmission at 7.5Gb/s over 25km SSMF using 1GHz RSOAs for WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Colourless real-time 16-QAM optical OFDM end-to-end transmission at 7.5 Gb/s over 25 km SSMF is demonstrated experimentally, for the first time, using variable power loading and live-optimised RSOA intensity modulators with modulation bandwidths as narrow as 1 GHz.

articleTitle: A real-time asynchronous dynamically re-sizable optical buffer for variable length 40Gbps optical packets
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 40 Gbps dynamically re-sizable optical buffer capable of storing packets of lengths ranging from 40 to 800 bytes. Packet recovery measurements greater than 95% demonstrate a dynamic operating range of 5 dB.

articleTitle: High-speed optical transceiver and systems for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Demand for higher data throughput and higher interconnect densities in servers and routers for IT network systems is growing quickly. Optical interconnects have both speed and high-density. There are more developments in optical interconnection, and we outline those from Japan with an opt-electronics package point of view.

articleTitle: 112.8-Gb/s PM-RZ-64QAM optical signal generation and transmission on a 12.5GHz WDM grid
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By employing a novel scheme we have generated 112.8-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed (PM)-RZ-64QAM optical signal. Transmission of 112.8-Gb/s PM-RZ-64QAM optical signal over 2×40km of SSMF has been demonstrated in an 8-channel WDM environment on a 12.5GHz grid.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10Gbps, 4-user, OCDMA transmission over 59km single mode fiber without inline dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Multi-user, 10Gbps, optical code division multiple access (OCDMA) transmission over 59 km of standard single mode fiber without inline dispersion compensation is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Partial implementation and experimental demonstration of an integrated optical path and packet node for new-generation networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We partially implement and experimentally evaluate an integrated optical path/packet node toward new-generation networks. Our own OCS control system successfully performs both dynamic changes of lightpath resources and lightpath establishment/release within total of approximately 6000 ms.

articleTitle: Single-photon avalanche detectors for quantum communications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: QKD systems widely employ Single-Photon Avalanche Diodes (SPAD) and set strong demand for improved features and performance. The present state of this detector technology is outlined and the main issues and prospect are discussed for Si-SPADs, suitable for free-space communications, and for InGaAs based SPADs intended for optical fiber communication systems.

articleTitle: Up to 425 GHz all optical frequency down-conversion clock recovery based on quantum dash Fabry-Perot mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that quantum-dash mode-locked laser can perform all optical frequency down-conversion clock recovery up to 425 GHz. We measured 0.3 dB penalty on the optical recovered clock for 170 Gbit/s signal.

articleTitle: Slow light laser oscillator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a slow light laser oscillator. The slow light laser was realized by incorporating an ultra-narrow bandwidth long-delay and low loss transmission filter into an Er/Yb doped fiber laser. We show that the spectral linewidth, free spectral range, relaxation resonance and Relative Intensity Noise (RIN) of a slow light laser are dramatically altered. The modified slow light laser noise dynamics can be explained by the increased cavity photon lifetime due to the filter delay. The slow light effectively increased the laser cavity Q and thus dramatically quenched the laser AM and FM noise by a few orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: 2038Km and four 50GHz OADM/filters transmission field trial of 115.2 Gb/s coherent CoFDM modem in the Telstra network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present results of a 115.2 Gb/s, coherent frequency division multiplexed (CoFDM) transceiver across a 2038 km link in the Telstra network. The link had 50 GHz channel spacing and the transceiver traversed four (50 GHz spaced) OADM sites.

articleTitle: Demonstration of QoS-aware packet protection via cross-layer OSNR signaling
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Quality-of-service aware packet protection is demonstrated using cross-layer signaling from a delay-line-interferometer-assisted optical-signal-to-noise-ratio monitor. 8×10 Gb/s wavelength-striped optical messages are successfully rerouted based on performance monitoring measurements communicated between the physical and networking layers.

articleTitle: Fully reconfigurable silicon photonic lattice filters with four cascaded unit cells
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a fully-reconfigurable CMOS-compatible silicon-photonic lattice-filter with four cascaded unit cells consisting of resonant rings and Mach-Zehnder interferometers. The measurements show high-quality filter responses including IIR and FIR filter characteristics matching theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Novel passive launch scheme for ultimate bandwidth improvement of graded-index multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new practical multimode fiber optical launch scheme, providing near single mode group excitation for >5 times transmission bandwidth improvement. Equalization-free transmission of a 10-Gb/s signal over 220-m fiber is achieved in experimental demonstrations.

articleTitle: Ultra-long 10 Gb/s unrepeatered WDM transmission up to 601 km
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We perform ultra-long unrepeatered transmission at 10 Gb/s, applying the most advanced technology: RZ-DPSK, third-order Raman pumping and ultra-low loss fiber. We transmit four channels over 574 km and one channel over 601 km.

articleTitle: Multi-service multi-carrier broadband MIMO distributed antenna systems for in-building optical wireless access
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel broad spectrum band-shifting technique is experimentally demonstrated to simultaneously transmit broadband (500 MHz to 3 GHz) multi-service, multi-carrier MIMO signals for in-building radio-over-fiber based wireless distributed antenna systems. The proposed scheme uses fewer local oscillators and does not require any service-specific narrowband band pass filters, thus upgrading of existing non-MIMO services to MIMO services or adding new MIMO services would be easier and cost-effective.

articleTitle: Field trial of a real-time, single wavelength, coherent 100 Gbit/s PM-QPSK channel upgrade of an installed 1800km link
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time, single-wavelength, coherent 100 G PM-QPSK upgrade of a field system. Performance sufficient for error-free operation after forward-error-correction was achieved over installed 900 km and 1800 km links, proving the viability of seamless 100 Gb/s upgrades.

articleTitle: Novel integrated coherent receiver module for 100G serial transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel coherent receiver module is presented, comprising two optical 90°-hybrids monolithically integrated with eight waveguide pin-photodiodes in balanced configuration. Superior optical performance is demonstrated in a 28 Gbaud NRZ-QPSK 150 km SMF transmission experiment.

articleTitle: 128 × 8 split and 60 km long-reach PON transmission using 27 dB-gain hybrid burst-mode optical fiber amplifier and commercial Giga-bit PON system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate error free transmission of a 128 × 8 split and 60 km long-reach PON system over 12 hours; a loss budget of over 60-dB is achieved by combining a hybrid burst-mode optical fiber amplifier (OFA) and a commercial G-PON system. Our proposed hybrid burst-mode OFA, which consists of a gain-clamped praseodymium-doped fiber amplifier (PDFA) and a fast automatic gain controlled PDFA, successfully achieves over 27-dB gain and over 16.5-dB dynamic range.

articleTitle: Statistical method for ROADM cascade penalty
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: ROADM elements in DWDM optical networks exhibit variations in pass-band amplitude response due to manufacturing variations and supplier diversity. We present a novel statistical approach for ROADM cascade penalty allocation, which reduces OSNR penalty with negligible impact to the worst case penalty estimate.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of a SIP-based platform for service oriented optical network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Experimental validation of a service oriented optical network architecture based on SIP for on-demand session management is presented in this paper. The service set-up delay is evaluated under different traffic conditions and network equipment capabilities.

articleTitle: Full C-band 40-Gbit/s DPSK tunable transmitter module developed by hybrid integration of tunable laser and InP n-p-i-n Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 40-Gbaud tunable transmitter module was developed for the first time by the hybrid integration of a full C-band tunable laser and an InP Mach-Zehnder modulator. Wavelength-tunable chirpless 40-Gbit/s DPSK modulation was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photonic chip based 1.28 Tbaud transmitter optimization and receiver OTDM demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose chip-based Tbaud processing for all-optical performance monitoring, switching and demultiplexing. We demonstrate the first transmitter optimization and receiver-end demultiplexing of 1.28 Tbit/s OOK signals. Both exploited Kerr nonlinearity in dispersion-engineered As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> planar waveguide.

articleTitle: Ultra wide range tunable delay line using dynamic grating reflectors in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel technique to realize a tunable delay line based on dynamic Brillouin gratings in a high birefringence fiber. A 8 ns pulse signal is continuously delayed up to 184 ns with minor distortion.

articleTitle: Terabit-scale compact hierarchical optical cross-connect system employing PLC devices and optical backplane
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
