abstract: The first practical hierarchical optical cross-connect system is developed and its feasibility confirmed using field-installed fibers. Fully-implemented equipment requires a 16-U chassis to manage 4.8-Tbit/s signals from 8 WDM lines and 160 client ports.

articleTitle: Real-time prototypes for digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review real-time and off-line processing techniques for the proto-typing of a digital coherent receiver.

articleTitle: Fast-tuning 224-Gb/s intradyne receiver for optical packet networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a digital coherent 224-Gb/s (56-Gbaud PDM-QPSK) packet receiver that selects packets using a fast wavelength-switching local oscillator. A novel three-stage CMA enables blind packet recovery in less than 200 ns.

articleTitle: Optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides about optical interconnects is presented by the author.

articleTitle: Transmission of a 448-Gb/s reduced-guard-interval CO-OFDM signal with a 60-GHz optical bandwidth over 2000 km of ULAF and five 80-GHz-Grid ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation and detection of a novel reduced-guard-interval CO-OFDM signal at 448 Gb/s, occupying 60-GHz optical bandwidth. We transmit this signal over 2000 km of ULAF with five 80-GHz-grid WSS-based ROADM passes.

articleTitle: Transponder pool sizing in highly dynamic translucent WDM optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a methodology for sizing optical network node transponder pools to meet network call blocking requirements. The methodology is practical and adaptable for use in virtually any carrier's optical network capacity planning process.

articleTitle: High-speed electronic circuits for 100 Gb/s transport networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An overview of state-of-the-art high-speed electronic circuits for major 100 G modulation schemes is given. The results show the trade-off between electrical performance and energy efficiency and lead to design considerations for future transceiver electronics.

articleTitle: 240-Gb/s on-board optical transmitters and receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed compact 12-channel, on-board optical transmitters and receivers. The assembly size was 9 mm × 14 mm. Error-free transmission up to 20 Gb/s/ch was achieved, which will enable us to construct a high density optical interconnect.

articleTitle: PCE-based vs. distributed set up of bidirectional lightpaths in GMPLS-controlled optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and evaluate a PCE-based architecture for bidirectional lightpath set up in GMPLS-controlled optical networks. The proposed architecture strongly improves the performance of the distributed architecture with both standard and enhanced signaling schemes.

articleTitle: Transmission of 240 Gb/s PM-RZ-D8PSK over 320 km in 10 Gb/s NRZ-OOK WDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first demonstration of 40 Gbaud PM-RZ-D8PSK and its successful transmission in a 100 GHz-spaced 10 Gb/s NRZ-OOK WDM system over a 320-km transmission link along with the studies of WDM nonlinear crosstalk.

articleTitle: Selective multicast in a dynamic wavelength router for DWDM converged wired/wireless access networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transmission of selective multicast services has been demonstrated in a cost-effective dynamic channel allocation router. The approach envisions heterogeneous infrastructures with unicast, broadcast and multicast-related functions on a radio over fiber access network.

articleTitle: Silicon integrated waveguide devices for filtering and wavelength demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Following different approaches, we have realized a number of different silicon integrated demultiplexers for WDM-based on-chip optical interconnects. We compare these devices based on their size, transmission loss, pass-band shape and tolerance against process variations.

articleTitle: Remote amplified modulators: Key components for 10 Gb/s WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Amplified electro-absorption modulators provide a realistic solution for colorless 10 Gb/s uncooled ONUs. Being compatible with current packaging technologies they will bring the required cost reduction. Still, an increased power budget capability has to be demonstrated.

articleTitle: PLC-based eight-channel OFDM demultiplexer and its demonstration with 160 Gbit/s signal reception
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An integrated-optic demultiplexer for 8 × 10 Gbaud OFDM sub-carrier channels is realized, which comprises a PLC-based 8 × 8 optical FFT circuit. It is successfully used to demultiplex a 160 Gbit/s OFDM signal optically.

articleTitle: Ultrasmall arrayed waveguide grating multiplexer using InP-based photonic wire waveguide on Si wafer for III-V CMOS photonics
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Extremely compact low-loss 4 channel arrayed waveguide grating with 147×92 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> device size was demonstrated using ultrahigh index contrast InGaAsP photonic wire waveguides on Si, compatible for the monolithic integration of high-performance III-V CMOS transistors.

articleTitle: Link performance improved 16QAM-OFDM 60-GHz Radio-over-Fiber system employing convolutional codes
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated the first transmission of 750-Mb/s 16QAM-OFDM signal over 1-km SMF-28 and 6-m air-link with 60-GHz ROF technology. The system improvement and low-power efficiency of RF transmitter are studied based on the convolutional code.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide coupled resonator infrared detector
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a silicon photodiode implemented in a waveguide coupled ring resonator structure. Infrared detection was achieved by Si<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ion implantation. A 15 μm-radius ring-based detector demonstrated an equivalent responsivity to a 3 mm straight waveguide device.

articleTitle: 200-Gb/s, 430-km PDM-RZ-DQPSK (4 bit/symbol) transmission with 10 krad/s endless polarization tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report agile endless optical polarization demultiplex, free of polarization channel jumps, over a 475 Mrad long Poincaré sphere trajectory at 10 krad/s speed, in a 50-Gsymbol/s, 4-bit/symbol realtime data transmission over 5 fiber spans.

articleTitle: Power efficiency of next-generation optical access architectures
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A theoretical model for the power consumption of access networks is presented. The analysis based on this model provides insights into optimal number of lines per equipment and the use of active vs. passive equipment.

articleTitle: Optical flow switching
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Present-day networks are being challenged by dramatic increases in bandwidth demand of emerging applications. We will explore a new transport, "optical flow switching," that will enable significant growth, power-efficiency and cost-effective scalability of next-generation networks.

articleTitle: Penalty-free transmission of 127-Gb/s coherent PM-QPSK over 1500-km of NDSF with 10 cascaded 50-GHz ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate penalty-free transmission of 127-Gb/s coherent PM-QPSK through a cascade of ten commercial 50-GHz WSS over 1500-km NDSF. Simulation results show that cascades of 40 such 50-GHz liquid-crystal based ROADMs is feasible.

articleTitle: Required resolution of digital-analog-converter for optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The required resolution of digital-analog-converter for optical OFDM was evaluated through simulation and experiment. Signal degradation caused by quantization was independent of subcarrier modulation, and the performance improvement saturates with increasing bit resolution.

articleTitle: Trends and future directions in optical interconnects for datacenter and computer applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The underlying technology trends that have enabled optics to displace copper in telecommunications, datacommunications, and datacenters are discussed. Future directions are outlined that will drive optical interconnects further into the fabric of computer systems.

articleTitle: Optical phase and amplitude control for beamforming with cascades of Gires-Tournois Bragg grating filters
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report experimental results on an optical beamformer capable of independent amplitude and phase control of RF signals fed to an antenna array. We investigate its performance for beam direction adjustment and side lobe suppression.

articleTitle: Fast implementation of the Split-Step Fourier Method using a graphics processing unit
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe how simulations based on the Split-Step Fourier Method can be significantly accelerated by using commodity graphics hardware. Results for a benchmark scenario are provided to highlight performance and accuracy.

articleTitle: Optical packet ring network offering bit rate and modulation formats transparency
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of a bit rate transparent ring packet network based on a Packet-OADM technology. A lab network has been successfully evaluated at 10, 40 and 100 G.

articleTitle: High speed silicon microring modulator based on carrier depletion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a high-speed silicon microring modulator with a low voltage swing and ultralow energy consumption, with the refractive index modulation achieved by carrier depletion in a lateral pn diode embedded in the ring.

articleTitle: Recent progress on nonlinear compensation technique in digital coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Enhanced digital signal processing algorithms are proposed and evaluated experimentally in order to improve the tolerances to intra-channel and inter-channel nonlinear effects of intradyne receiver and thus to extend the reach of WDM transmission systems.

articleTitle: Characterization of a novel three-section tunable slotted Fabry-Perot laser
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel three-section tunable slotted Fabry Perot laser has been examined. Characterizations of the linewidth, SMSR and RIN indicate that this type of laser may be a suitable source for dynamic networks employing advanced optical modulation formats.

articleTitle: Progress of visible light communication
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This article introduces "visible light communication" using visible light sources as transmitters and discusses its applications and standardization activities.

articleTitle: Generation and detection of 2.56 Tbit/s OTDM data using DPSK and polarisation multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Error free and low penalty generation and detection of 2.56 Tbit/s serial data is demonstrated. 1.28 Tbaud pulses are modulated with DPSK and polarisation multiplexed to achieve 2.56 Tbit/s with record low penalty.

articleTitle: Routing and wavelength assignment for transparent optical networks with QoT estimation inaccuracies
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show how inaccuracies of Quality of Transmission (QoT) estimations, caused by imperfect models and lack of monitors in transparent optical networks, can be mitigated using a novel routing and wavelength assignment algorithm.

articleTitle: An ultra-small, low-power all-optical flip-flop memory on a silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 7.5pm-diameter InP microdisk laser, integrated on an SOI waveguide is demonstrated as all-optical flip-flop working in continuous-wave regime with an electrical power consumption of several mW, and allowing switching in 60ps with pulses of 1.8fJ.

articleTitle: 107Gb/s DPSK-3ASK optical transmission over SSMF
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the transmission of a 107Gb/s DPSK-3ASK optical channel over 335km, fiber (SSMF). DPSK-3ASK is targeted to meet the requirements of a metro network.

articleTitle: Quantum communications in reconfigurable optical networks: DWDM QKD through a ROADM
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate coexistence of classical and quantum signals for quantum key distribution in a DWDM reconfigurable networking environment using a ROADM. We show how the limiting noise mechanism can depend on the link configuration.

articleTitle: Multiple optical private networks over EPON using optical CDMA technique
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel architecture of multiple optical private networks (PNs) on EPON independent of OLT is experimentally demonstrated. Two active PNs are established using OCDMA, which ONUs within a PN are interconnected sharing the same codeword.

articleTitle: Optimization of cost efficient multilevel-ASK modulation formats under the constraint of chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Due to their narrow spectrum, multilevel modulation ASK-formats can increase the chromatic dispersion tolerance of optical systems. Since they suffer more from inter-symbol interference than binary signals, optimization of the amplitude levels is necessary.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects prediction in ultra-dense WDM systems using volterra series
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Volterra Series Transfer Function method is investigated to analyze fiber nonlinearities in ultra-dense WDM systems. For 340×1Gb/s at 3GHz grid using intensity-modulated signals, the method enables fast analysis of the induced nonlinear distortion impact.

articleTitle: Relationship between optical wiring conditions and MPI degradation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical wiring conditions are investigated numerically and experimentally with a viewpoint of MPI induced transmission performance degradation. We reveal the impact of the interval of the bending portion on MPI degradation for the first time.

articleTitle: 10 × 224-Gb/s WDM transmission of 28-Gbaud PDM 16-QAM on a 50-GHz grid over 1,200 km of fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate ten-channel wavelength-division-multiplexed long-haul optical networking of 28-Gbaud PDM 16-QAM signals on a 50-GHz grid (spectral efficiency of 4 b/s/Hz). We achieve transmission over 1,200 km of ultra-large-area fiber, including three wavelength-selective-switch passes.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated InP wafer-scale 100-channel × 10-GHz AWG and Michelson interferometers for 1-THz-bandwidth optical arbitrary waveform generation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss monolithic integration of a 100-channel AWG with a 10-GHz channel spacing with 100 Michelson-interferometer-based phase- and amplitude-modulators. The AWG showed approximately 10 dB crosstalk, and the twin-integrated devices comprise a 2¿ InP wafer.

articleTitle: High-speed optical/electrical devices and their integration for highly-efficient lOOGbE
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent challenges facing research and development on high-speed optical and electrical devices, and their integration for 100 GbE are explained. The prospects regarding low-power-consumption technology and optical and electrical integration technology are verified.

articleTitle: 100 GHz ultra-wideband wireless system for the fiber to the antenna networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical ultra-wideband (UWB) (75 GHz-110 GHz) fiber-to-the-antenna (FTTA) system using our developed W-band near-ballistic unitraveling-carrier photodiode (NBUTC-PD) based photonic transmitter (PT). 2.5 Gb/s and 1.5 Gb/s UWB-FTTA systems with 1,024 high split-ratio are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Wavelength-space permutation switch with coherent PDM QPSK transmission for supercomputer optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally study the performance of an economically-viable, high-capacity supercomputer optical interconnect employing wavelength-space optical packet switching, polarization division multiplexed (PDM) quadrature phase shift keying (QPSK) modulation and coherent detection.

articleTitle: 1060-nm VCSEL-based parallel-optical modules for short link application
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes advantages of 1060-nm optical interconnect employing parallel-optical modules. 1060-nm optical signals contribute to power budget increase and excellent transmission performance with existing MMFs. 1060-nm VCSELs also contribute to reducing optical link power.

articleTitle: Novel OSA-based method for in-band OSNR measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new approach for in-band OSNR measurements in narrow DWDM channels is described, which is robust to PMD and enables rapid measurement of accurate OSNR values of > 20 dB without need for polarization extinction.

articleTitle: Impact of moving to 100Gbps on the cost per bit of a USA national network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 40 Gbps and 100 Gbps line rate transport networks can take advantage of hybrid electrical/optical network architectures that employ selective sub-wavelength grooming and optical bypass to achieve better wavelength utilization and lower overall network costs.

articleTitle: Cost efficient directly modulated DPSK downstream transmitter and colourless upstream remodulation for full-duplex WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We implement a cost efficient 10.7 Gb/s directly modulated DPSK transmitter in a bidirectional WDM-PON, which also remodulates the downstream phase encoded signal for 2.5 Gb/s OOK upstream transmission.

articleTitle: Coherent CD equalization for 111Gbps DP-QPSK with one sample per symbol based on anti-aliasing filtering and MLSE
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a coherent detection scheme with one sample per symbol. MLSE is used to compensate for ISI introduced by anti aliasing filtering. 50,000 ps/nm of CD is fully compensated with only 1 dB penalty.

articleTitle: A framework for regenerator site selection based on multiple paths
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a framework for regenerator sites selection based on multiple paths which can easily be extended to include several important features required by operators and discuss the initial results obtained from extensive simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Homing architectures in multi-layer networks: Quantifying the effect of ODU switching
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Alternative homing architectures can lead to significant cost reductions. Using linear programming we quantify these reductions for IPoWDM and IPoOTN networks under a multi-layer consideration for a reference network topology and varying traffic demand.

articleTitle: Sub-rate sampling in 100 Gb/s coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the feasibility of ADC sampling rate below 2x versus optical/electrical bandwidths in 100 G-PM-QPSK coherent receivers. We find <0.5 dB penalty for rates down to 5/4x even for dispersion as high as 24,000 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Implementation of high-speed buffer management for asynchronous variable-length optical packet switch
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We develop an FPGA-based buffer management hardware with 8 input ports, which implements a parallel and pipeline mechanism to support over-200-Mpacket/s/port asynchronous variable-length optical packet switching. Optical buffering for asynchronous variable-length packets is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Network architecture and test-bed demonstration of wavelength-striped packet multicasting
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new architecture for broadband multicasting of optical messages is proposed and demonstrated on a programmable optical packet switching test-bed. Optical packets with wavelength-striped 8 × 10 Gb/s payloads are successfully multicasted and routed error-free.

articleTitle: 230 Mbit/s via a wireless visible-light link based on OOK modulation of phosphorescent white LEDs
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a first indoor wireless visible-light link operating up to 230 Mbit/s by use of on-off-keying and with bit-error-ratios below 2·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. The results were achieved for illuminance levels recommended by lighting standards.

articleTitle: Concurrent processing of multiple LSP request bundles on a PCE in a WDM network
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Concurrent RWA algorithm for differentiated services to process multiple LSP bundles at PCE is proposed. Significant blocking probability reduction has been observed at the expense of slightly increased LSP setup-time compared to a sequential approach.

articleTitle: OFDM spectral efficiency limits from fiber and system non-linearities
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Coherent optical OFDM systems offer a straight-forward approach to address high spectral efficiency. Non-linear impairments set limits to the maximum spectral efficiency. The limiting effects are explored by simulations, calibrated from published experimental results.

articleTitle: Burst-mode optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A series of technologies burst-mode amplification are described. We optimize EDFA design to establish transient-suppressed EDFA (TS-EDFA) and discuss two scenarios of burst-mode amplification in WDM environment. We also investigate supplementary transient-suppression with optical-feedback.

articleTitle: Continuous, real-time, full-field waveform measurements via spectral slicing and parallel digital coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Single-shot, amplitude and phase characterization of 160-GHz bandwidth optical waveforms with 2-μs record lengths using a bandwidth- and time-record scalable technique based on parallelized balanced four-quadrature homodyne detection and DSP reconstruction.

articleTitle: The role of Arrayed Waveguide Gratings in energy-efficient optical switching architectures
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The power consumption of large IP routers is increasing too fast with the increase of Internet traffic. This power consumption can be reduced if Optical Switching Fabrics (OSFs) are used instead of electronic backplanes and interconnects. And Arrayed Waveguide Gratings (AWGs) exhibit interesting properties for the design and implementation of OSFs. The paper studies how OSFs based upon AWGs scale in terms of aggregate switching capacity and power consumption.

articleTitle: In-service OTDR for passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel in-service optical reflectometry based on the correlation detection using a pseudo-noise signal superimposed on the downstream signal. Using the proposed technique, we demonstrate the in-service monitoring of TDM and WDM PONs.

articleTitle: A new scheme for regenerative 40 Gb/s NRZ wavelength conversion using a hybrid integrated SOA-MZI
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new NRZ wavelength conversion scheme based on SOA-MZI. Experimental verification of its superior 2R regenerative capabilities are demonstrated for 40 Gb/s NRZ data signals.

articleTitle: Bidirectional 3.125 Gbps downstream / 2 Gbps upstream impulse radio ultrawide-band (UWB) over combined fiber and wireless link
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate bidirectional fiber and wireless transmission of impulse radio ultra-wideband at 3.125 Gbps downstream and 2 Gbps upstream. After transmission over 50 km fiber and 1.85 m wireless link both signals are recovered without errors.

articleTitle: Impact of ROADM in-band crosstalk on 40G DPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transmission penalties of ROADM isolation functions in high capacity systems are quantified using a weighted crosstalk. Excellent correlation between the weighted crosstalk and the OSNR penalty of 40 G DPSK is found in diverse crosstalk scenarios.

articleTitle: Monolithic InP multi-wavelength coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel four-channel monolithic polarization-diversity dual-quadrature coherent receiver with balanced detection in InP. It uses an interleave-chirped arrayed waveguide grating that acts simultaneously as a demultiplexer, 90° hybrid, and polarization splitter.

articleTitle: Photonic network optimization via resource and LSPs concurrent allocation: A PCE+ concept
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes the concept of PCE+:a path computation element that performs a concurrent impairments aware routing and regenerator location for a WSON network using a fast analytical assessment of the optical lightpath feasibility.

articleTitle: Photonic spectral processor employing two-dimensional WDM channel separation and a phase LCoS modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a spectral phase and amplitude modulator spanning full 2D-space by crossing a 100 GHz WGR and a 1200 gr/mm bulk grating. We address individual WDM channels with high resolution (4.5 GHz) and addressability (0.2 GHz).

articleTitle: Demonstration of compact hierarchical optical path cross-connect utilizing wavelength/waveband selective switches
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a compact wavelength/waveband selective switch based hierarchical optical cross-connect (HOXC) system for the first time. Its performance confirms that the HOXC will be applied to create cost-effective metro-core and metro-edge ring interconnections.

articleTitle: High symbol rate OFDM transmission technologies
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper we discuss high symbol rate all-optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM), focusing on phase optimisation, optimum symbol rate for dispersion managed systems, and Ethernet performance.

articleTitle: Record 5.3 Gbit/s transmission over 50m 1mm core diameter graded-index plastic optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: H. P. A van den Boom

abstract: We report multi-Gbit/s capacity in 1-mm diameter graded index plastic optical fiber exploiting low-cost eye safe compliant transceivers. Transmission rates between 5.3 and 7.6 Gbit/s are achieved for lengths between 10 and 50 m using DMT.

articleTitle: Quadrature duobinary modulation for 100G transmission beyond the Nyquist limit
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Quadrature duobinary (QDB) modulation with coherent detection is proposed for 112-Gb/s transmission systems. With proper system design for maximum spectral efficiency, we show that dual polarization QDB can achieve 112-Gb/s transmission on 25-GHz channel spacing.

articleTitle: Key roles of green technology for access network systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: ICTs are expected to reduce their own equipment and service energy consumption and mitigate GHG emissions through use of ICTs in other relevant sectors. Standardization activities of green ICTs in ITU-T will be outlined.

articleTitle: Inter-wavelength transfer of digital lightpath labels induced by stimulated Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: WDM systems using digital lightpath labels can experience modulation transfer among wavelengths due to stimulated Raman scattering (SRS), creating label replicas. We present pump-probe measurements of 10.24 Gb/s OOK and DPSK transmission to assess the system effects.

articleTitle: Symmetric 10G-EPON ONU transceiver integrated with newly-developed burst-mode pre-bias timing control IC
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed symmetric 10G-EPON ONU transceiver fully compliant with IEEE802.3av PR30. Output power of +5 dBm, sensitivity of -32.4 dBm, and fast LD turn-on/off time of 10 ns/7 ns were successfully achieved by newly-developed burst-mode pre-bias timing control IC.

articleTitle: A digital subcarrier multiplexing technique for increased spectral efficiency in optical systems using direct detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel technique that allows direct detection of multicarrier signals without using DSP at the receiver. Performance at 55.5 Gb/s, back-to-back and after 1040 km of dispersion uncompensated link is assessed by simulations.

articleTitle: Tunable free space optical delay interferometer for demodulation of differential phase shift keying signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With a continuously tunable free space optical delay interferometer and direct detection D(Q)PSK signals can be received at varying symbol rates or under optimized conditions. The interferometer's phase is stabilized and its polarization dependence mitigated.

articleTitle: Double pulse pumping on all-optical sampling using electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Double-pulse pumping improves the temporal resolution of cost-effective all-optical sampling using an electroabsorption modulator. A shortened sampling gate width was demonstrated using two double-pulse generation methods.

articleTitle: Transmission of 640 Gbps RZ-OOK channel over 100 km of SSMF by wavelength-transparent conjugation
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first uncompensated transmission of a 640 Gbps RZ-OOK channel over 100 km of standard SMF. The error-free performance of the ultrafast link was achieved by a new, wavelength-transparent and polarization-invariant signal conjugation scheme for the first time.

articleTitle: Data-aided vs. blind single-carrier coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication (OFC/NFOEC), collocated National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Blind and data-aided single-carrier receivers are discussed for high-speed optical coherent receivers. Equalization concepts are presented and evaluated regarding the implementation complexity and overhead for time-domain and frequency-domain equalization techniques.
